Hybrid mod primarily built around a gradually branching campaign that expands in multiple directions.

The mod adds a new planet, Gelion, featuring its own campaign, star system, research tree, and gameplay mechanics.

The planet offers over 90 blocks to research, 12 units each with their own unique abilities, 12 campaign sectors, more than 6 new mechanics, and plenty of room for map creation.

On top of that, the campaign also stands out with absolutely BRUTAL visual effects. Every texture was made with care and dedication.

THIS MOD IS STILL IN DEVELOPMENT!

The current completion percentage is approximately 57%, with plenty of room to grow!

Help me develop the mod! Join the Azimuth Discord server using the link in the README file on the mod's official GitHub page.

///////////////////////////////

Land on a sub-cryonic terra slowly heating up beneath its unstable star. The celestial body is suffering from global warming — glaciers are melting, atmospheric pressure is rising, and temperatures continue to climb.

Exterminate the enemy faction. Turn the planet into a temporary source of raw materials. Witness a world that will soon become ash.

If you enjoyed the mod, please consider giving it a star!

Thank you for playing.

///////////////////////////////

docs.title: Fortification station

docs.title: Repairing station

docs.title: Orbital regeneration station
docs.text: Produces orbital regeneration drones. The drones create an accretion disk of projectiles. The accretion disk has storage capacity and can regenerate blocks. If a regeneration drone already exists, the block stops consuming resources.

docs.title: Swartzite

docs.title: Northern Pass
docs.text:
Set out for the coldest, snow-covered regions of the planet to extract a new type of resource.

The harsh climate and confined terrain will create resource scarcity — use what you have wisely.

docs.title: Thicket
docs.text:
In this temperate climate, vegetation is becoming increasingly widespread. The name of this place is no coincidence—it comes from the rapid and abundant growth of flora here.

Begin investing in the decoder. Establish your defenses. Make use of the unique resource for research.

docs.title: Tight Caverns
docs.text:
Within vast mountain ranges, sun-exposed fissures are often found.

Use technological superiority to destroy the enemy base and advance forward.

docs.title: Arrival
docs.text:
Low enemy activity makes this sector ideal for researching early technologies.

Automate production and push forward.

docs.title: Wilderness
docs.text:
This sector’s ruins contain technologies that will support your future expansion.

Expect heavy enemy resistance as they attempt to safeguard this information.

docs.title: Cold Spot
docs.text:
In the cold haze, an enemy base exists.

Study the new gold-like material and create the Arbiter, a heavy ground unit, to capture the enemy base.

docs.title: Frozen Frontier
docs.text:
A chain of archipelagos spreads along the flooded channels.

The enemy stronghold maintains control of the airspace, cutting off the route to the north. A successful assault will require deploying two different types of combat units. Stay alert — the enemy will put up heavy resistance.

docs.title: Melting Channels
docs.text:
Where ancient glaciers once stood, a vast network of flooded channels now stretches across the region.

Due to the rugged terrain, you will need to rely on hovers — agile combat units capable of traversing most obstacles.

docs.title: Estuary
docs.text:
Further along the equator, there is a recently formed estuary.

No enemy activity has been detected in the sector. Turn the sector into a resource outpost and advance further.

docs.title: Cold Harbor
docs.text:
The flooded harbor severely limits your choice of combat units. To destroy the two enemy cores, you will have to rely on ships.

Use the long-range capabilities of ships to gain the upper hand in the siege of the enemy base.

docs.title: Arched lakes
docs.text:
The thicket borders a pair of stagnant lakes that are periodically replenished by local rains. The arches that loosely divide the lakes appear to be supported by cobalt rods.

Destroying the enemy base will firmly secure our position in this region. Use “Ferrymen” - long-range naval units that will put heavy pressure on the enemy base’s logistics.

docs.title: Coastal zone
docs.text:
Amid the mountainous terrain lies a vast coastal zone.

Enemy presence is blocking further advancement. Research and produce a new resource. Defend against the waves, destroy the enemy base, and advance further.

docs.title: Adder
docs.text: Defends the "Forum" core from enemies. The primary construction unit. Repairs allied structures using fractional homing projectiles.

docs.title: Akarius
docs.text: Defends the "Network" core from enemies. The primary construction unit. Repairs allied structures using a beam. Summons two satellites that orbit the unit and repair allied structures.

docs.title: Toroid
docs.text: Automatically repairs structures and assists other units in construction. Stuns enemy blocks and heals allies using its energy field.

docs.title: Pilgrim
docs.text: Fires a massive energy sphere that expands over time. If the sphere does not pass through 4 enemy blocks or units, it accumulates energy and triggers a massive explosion. Can step over most terrain.

docs.title: Tyris
docs.text: Shoots shotgun laser beams and energy bolts with penetrating ability.

docs.title: Feather
docs.text: Fires a salvo of five homing projectiles. Can hover over liquids.

docs.title: Flow
docs.text: Fires a barrage of homing bullets. Can hover over liquids. Leaves a decaying husk that continues fighting.

docs.title: Argoy
docs.text: Fires both incendiary and standard projectiles at ground targets. Both types create puddles of flammable substance. On impact, there is a chance to ignite only one puddle. If a projectile hits conveyors or liquid pipelines, the puddle is always ignited.

docs.title: Teliff
docs.text: Fires a three-round burst sequentially. While firing, it gains the “Ram” effect, which increases its rate of fire but reduces its movement speed. Can provide a shield to allied units.

docs.title: Arbiter
docs.text: Fires a volley of lasers. Can provide a shield to allied units. Can step over most terrain.

docs.title: Sigil
docs.text: Fires a pulsed energy orb at enemy targets. Destroys incoming enemy projectiles using energy point defense. Can hover over liquids.

docs.title: Retention
docs.text: Fires powerful high-explosive shells that split into mines and shoots shrapnel.

docs.title: Breach
docs.text: Fires an extremely powerful artillery shell that splits over 6 minutes at the end of their lifespan they create a huge explosion. and fires slowing explosive projectiles.

docs.title: Compass
docs.text: Fires long-range artillery at ground targets. Can apply the “Tow” effect to allied units.

docs.title: Drift
docs.text: Sequentially fires a burst of two long-range bullets. Creates a small localized explosion upon destruction.

docs.title: Ferry
docs.text: Fires long-range missiles that stun everything within their energy field. The missiles repair allies.

docs.text: The primitive version of the spinner, still has the same functionality. Can spin up to 14 blocks in front around, the cog itself as the axis. Click to change the rotation direction. Can drop blocks to payload blocks, and with spore slimes can spin multiple blocks.

docs.title: Infinite Piston
docs.text: Can push up to 512 blocks. Cannot push thorium walls. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Infinite Sticky Piston
docs.text: Can push or pull up to 512 blocks. Cannot push thorium walls. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Sticky Piston
docs.text: Can push or pull up to 16 blocks. Cannot push thorium walls.

docs.title: Piston
docs.text: Can push up to 16 blocks. Cannot push thorium walls.

docs.title: Plastanium Cog
docs.text: A cog 1.5 times as fast as a copper cog. Slower than the titanium cog, but can spin the most blocks, up to 25 blocks in front around. Click to change the rotation direction.

docs.title: Infirtia Spinner
docs.text: Can spin up to 120 blocks in front around. This version keeps spinning even when picked up by other spinners. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Inertia Spinner
docs.text: Can spin up to 16 blocks in front around. This version keeps spinning even when picked up by other spinners.

docs.title: Infinite Spinner
docs.text: Can spin up to 120 blocks in front around, the spinner itself as the axis. Click to change the rotation direction. Can drop blocks to payload blocks, and with spore slimes can spin multiple blocks. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Spinner
docs.text: The most advanced version of the cog, 4 times as fast as a copper cog. Can spin up to 16 blocks in front around, the spinner itself as the axis. Click to change the rotation direction. Can drop blocks to payload blocks, and with spore slimes can spin multiple blocks.

docs.title: Sided Spore Slime
docs.text: Only one side of it is sticky. Sticks to adjacent blocks. Does not stick to phase coating.

docs.title: Spore Slime
docs.text: Sticks to adjacent blocks. Does not stick to phase coating.

docs.title: Surge Slime
docs.text: Sticks to adjacent blocks, just like spore slimes. Conducts power to adjacent blocks. Does not stick to phase coating.

docs.title: Titanium Cog
docs.text: A cog twice as fast as a copper cog. Can spin up to 16 blocks in front around, the cog itself as the axis. Click to change the rotation direction.

docs.title: Wooden Cog
docs.text: A cog twice as slow as a copper cog. Can spin up to 18 blocks in front around, the cog itself as the axis. Click to change the rotation direction.

docs.title: Antique Shop
docs.text: Buy classic, retro and ancient legendary blocks with Anucoins. Merchandise changes every day! Some items may require bittrium, and Portal Invasion related merchandise can also be bought here.

docs.title: Anubank
docs.text: Central building responsible for managing the economy and the Anucoins. Can be linked to blocks that produce or consume Anucoins. Connect Anuvaults to increase capacity.

docs.title: Anusafe
docs.text: Increases the maximum anucoin capacity of the linked Anubank. Coins are transferred to the bank when unlinked, not left behind.

docs.title: Anuvault
docs.text: A larger Anusafe. Increases the maximum anucoin capacity of the linked Anubank. Coins are transferred to the bank when unlinked, not left behind.

docs.title: Byterium Shard
docs.text: A crystallized form of bittrium. Can be harvested with mynamites.

docs.title: Box
docs.text: A cardboard box used for shipping merchandise all over the universe. One-use, automatically despawns once you take its contents.

docs.title: Cafe
docs.text: Buy beverages and snacks. Buy items using Anucoins. Get Anucoins with a Trading Post and distribute them with Anubanks.

docs.title: Campfire
docs.text: Burns items and warms up nearby units. Handle with care, as pushing or spinning this block may result in fires spreading. Can hold more coal.

docs.title: Anucoin Source
docs.text: Maintains the Anucoin balance, removing or creating endless Anucoins when connected to an Anubank. Sandbox only. Get Anucoins with a Trading Post and distribute them with an Anucoin Node.

docs.title: Ion Source [accent]Beta[]
docs.text: Creates a resonating field of flowing ions, which causes all types of bullets to gain velocity in its general direction. The strange physics at effect here may cause unintentional behavior. The strong field of charge also push airborne payloads. Can be controlled by processors for more precise angles. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Icy Quartz
docs.text: A crystallized form of cryonite. Can be harvested with mynamites.

docs.title: Discharger
docs.text: Stores power, but with a twist. Handle with care, as pushing or spinning this block will discharge its stored power in electric arcs.

docs.title: Extra Shop
docs.text: Buy item packages and perks using Anucoins. Buy items using Anucoins. Get Anucoins with a Trading Post and distribute them with Anubanks.

docs.title: Coal Can
docs.text: Burns items and warms up nearby units. Handle with care, as pushing or spinning this block may result in fires spreading.

docs.title: Yutnori Stick Thrower
docs.text: Sticks of the Yutnori, a Korean traditional board game. Game Rules:  Do. Move one space forward.  Ge. Move two spaces forward.  Geol. Move three spaces forward.  Yut! Move four spaces forward, and roll again.  Mo! Move five spaces forward, and roll again.  Back-do. Move one space backward. If you are at the first space, your position will underflow and go right to the goal! You should also roll again when your move lands on an enemy space, sending the enemy to the start too. Rerolls stack, meaning one can win this game in just one turn, but extremely unlikely.

docs.title: Ion Jet
docs.text: Creates a field of flowing ions, which causes small bullets to gain velocity in its general direction. Can be controlled by processors for more precise angles.

docs.title: Ion Thruster
docs.text: Creates a stronger field of flowing ions, which causes small bullets to gain velocity in its general direction. The strong field of charge also push airborne payloads. Can be controlled by processors for more precise angles.

docs.title: Item Shop
docs.text: Buy items using Anucoins. Get Anucoins with a Trading Post and distribute them with Anubanks.

docs.title: Omega Rune
docs.text: A stone rune that can convert kinetic energy into mana. Join the BetaMindy Omega Server to use this block.

docs.title: Present
docs.text: A holly jolly block. Click to unwrap, you don't know what's inside!

docs.title: Pressurised Container
docs.text: Stores items, and provides higher crafting output rates in payload furnaces.

docs.title: Sunstone
docs.text: A crystallized form of pyratite. Can be harvested with mynamites.

docs.title: Scalar Crystal
docs.text: A crystallized form of raw scalar. Can be harvested with mynamites. Has special conductive properties, depending on the number of adjacent power blocks.

docs.title: Silo
docs.text: Stores an enormous amount of items of each type. Contents can be retrieved with an unloader.

docs.title: Space Opal
docs.text: A crystallized form of space matter. Can be harvested with mynamites.

docs.title: Spotlight
docs.text: Lights up the area in front of it. Can be controlled by processors for more precise angles.

docs.title: Tensor Crystal
docs.text: A crystallized form of raw tensor. Can be harvested with mynamites. Has special conductive properties, depending on the number of adjacent power blocks.

docs.title: Trading Post
docs.text: Sell items for Anucoins. Connect to an Anucoin Node to distribute Anucoins.

docs.title: Unit Shop
docs.text: Buy units using Anucoins. Get Anucoins with a Trading Post and distribute them with Anubanks.

docs.title: Vector Crystal
docs.text: A crystallized form of raw vector. Can be harvested with mynamites. Has special conductive properties, depending on the number of adjacent power blocks.

docs.title: Warehouse
docs.text: Stores an extraordinary amount of items of each type. Contents can be retrieved with an unloader.

docs.title: Color Module
docs.text: Sets the color of adjacent pen blocks. Accepts hex color codes.

docs.title: Cooling Fan
docs.text: Cools down up to 5 adjacent processors with the flow of air, boosting their speed. Consumes a lot of power.

docs.title: Audio Dome
docs.text: Affects the sounds heard by players in range.

docs.title: Heat Sink
docs.text: Cools down up to 2 adjacent processors, boosting their speed.

docs.title: Link Pin
docs.text: Can be linked to a processor to display all of its links, even disabled ones. Invalid links will have a red name, inactive links will have a black square. When pushed by a piston, the linked processor's links will also be shifted.

docs.title: Message Source
docs.text: Outputs random text.

docs.title: Message Void
docs.text: Consumes all message input.

docs.title: Note Block
docs.text: Plays a note when powered or configured by players. config: octave.semitone e.g. 0.00 (C1), 0.01 (C1#), 3.11(B4) color: instrument pitch[[0, 84)

docs.title: Nullifier
docs.text: Controls adjacent buildings, disabling them when powered and enabling them otherwise. Can also disable claws and inertia spinners that are spinning in the air right above it.

docs.title: Pen
docs.text: Draws on the fourth wall when moved. The pen color and stroke can be changed by the corresponding modules.

docs.title: SFX Block
docs.text: Plays a sound effect when powered or configured by players.

docs.title: Note Block Plus
docs.text: Plays a note when powered or configured by players. Notes can be heard throughout the map when powered, which is affected by its volume. config: octave.semitone e.g. 0.00 (C1), 0.01 (C1#), 3.11(B4) color: instrument pitch[[0, 84) volume [[0, 100]

docs.title: Starry Pen
docs.text: Draws on the fourth wall when moved. The pen color and stroke can be changed by the corresponding modules. The ink glows!

docs.title: Stroke Module
docs.text: Sets the stroke of adjacent pen blocks.

docs.title: Waterblock
docs.text: Cools down up to 6 adjacent processors with the high heat capacity of liquids, boosting their speed. Consumes a lot of liquid. The speed boost will vary depending on the type of liquid supplied.

docs.title: Accelerator
docs.text: Outputs power when moved, usually by pistons.

docs.title: Large Button
docs.text: Produces power when clicked. Now easier to tap!

docs.title: Button
docs.text: Produces power when clicked.

docs.title: Large Pressure Plate
docs.text: Produces power when stepped on. Also can detect flying units on top. Spans multiple tiles.

docs.title: Pressure Plate
docs.text: Produces power when stepped on.

docs.title: Button Distributor
docs.text: Produces power when items are inputted. Behaves like a normal distributor...or does it?

docs.title: Button Router
docs.text: Produces power when items are inputted. Behaves like a normal router.

docs.title: Isotope Generator
docs.text: Generates power using exotic radioactive ores.

docs.title: Mega Driller
docs.text: An upgraded version of the mini driller. Drills nearby ores or blocks automatically. Cannot drill items that are too soft.

docs.title: Mini Driller
docs.text: Drills nearby ores or blocks automatically.

docs.title: Large Mynamite
docs.text: Blows up, mining nearby ores and crystals using the force of the explosion. Mined items will be transferred to nearby blocks, excluding conveyors. Better at mining ores, but items that are too soft will be blown away. Provide power to blow it up. It will also blow up automatically when placed on hot floor.

docs.title: Mynamite
docs.text: Blows up, mining nearby ores and crystals using the force of the explosion. Mined items will be transferred to nearby blocks, excluding conveyors. Tap it, or provide power to blow it up. It will also blow up automatically when placed on hot floor.

docs.title: Anchor
docs.text: Fires anchor-shaped piercing shots at naval enemies. Shots travel best on a body of liquid, and will have very limited range otherwise.

docs.title: Astro
docs.text: Fires spikey spheres of void energy, which shoot lightnings at enemies.

docs.title: Backdoor
docs.text: Hijacks linked ally turrets, consuming their ammo and shooting their bullets. Shot bullets are much faster and stronger.

docs.title: Bermuda
docs.text: Fires large anchor-shaped piercing shots at naval enemies. Shots travel best on a body of liquid, and will have very limited range otherwise.

docs.title: Brokerage
docs.text: Fires highly charged anucoins at enemies. Deals heavy damage, but cannot target enemies that are too close.

docs.title: Credit
docs.text: Fires anucoins at enemies. High damage, but also very hard to afford.

docs.title: MasterKey
docs.text: Hijacks linked ally turrets, consuming their ammo and shooting their bullets. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Nebula
docs.text: Sprays mid-fusion siloxol mist at enemies. While more damaging than fire, it does not last nor inflict statuses.

docs.title: Payload Cannon
docs.text: Can launch payloads. The higher the health of the payload, and the more blocks it travels, the more damage it deals, but consequently, the more damage the payload itself takes. The payload can be launched safely without damage in the inner range.

docs.title: Payload Catapult
docs.text: Can launch bigger payloads in higher velocities. Devastating news for the enemy.

docs.title: Phisher
docs.text: Hijacks linked 1x1 ally turrets, consuming their ammo and shooting their bullets. The range and inaccuracy depends on this turret, not the links. Has boosted reload but slows down hijacked turrets in return. All required coolant is used from this turret in parallel, so make sure to supply enough.

docs.title: Propaganda
docs.text: Fires harmful sound waves at enemies.

docs.title: Ray
docs.text: Focuses an ion beam, which gets stronger over time. Targets only units, and prioritizes foes with high health.

docs.title: Sequence
docs.text: Fires a main sequence star sphere, using hydrogen-rich siloxol as a fusion catalyst and reactant. The stars deal more damage the farther they travel.

docs.title: Spectrum
docs.text: Shoots ionized, accelerated elements at high speed and energy.

docs.title: Spyware
docs.text: Hijacks linked ally turrets, consuming their ammo and shooting their bullets. Shoots hijacked bullets in a spread pattern.

docs.title: Taxation
docs.text: Fires multiple rounds of anucoins at enemies. Deals massive damage both to close-range units and your wallet.

docs.title: Trojan
docs.text: Hijacks linked ally turrets, consuming their ammo and shooting their bullets. Shoots hijacked bullets in a burst pattern.

docs.title: Boost Panel
docs.text: Units on top are accelerated, and applied a speed boost for a short duration.

docs.title: Blue Bumper
docs.text: Units are bounced back in high velocities when they touch this block. Temporarily deflates after bumping an unit.

docs.title: Bumper Plus
docs.text: Units are bounced back in even higher velocities when they touch this block.

docs.title: Bumper
docs.text: Units are bounced back in high velocities when they touch this block.

docs.title: Claw
docs.text: Grabs a nearby unit and tries not to let go. Grabs allies, players and foes alike. Can be controlled by logic or players, in which case it can be controlled to grab blocks or units on non-solid payload blocks, too. Even functions partly on spinners or cogs. Cannot grab other claw blocks or itself.

docs.title: Glass Pipe
docs.text: Made with treated Anuglass, allows bidirectional transport of units, from one end to another. Can output units to payload blocks.

docs.title: Drift Panel
docs.text: Units on top are accelerated, losing control and drifting uncontrollably to the direction the panel faces.

docs.title: Mega Fan
docs.text: Blows stronger wind, pushing units in front. Accepts liquids, which will be sprinkled with the wind. Wind is obstructed by solid blocks. Can be controlled by processors for more precise angles.

docs.title: Fan
docs.text: Blows wind, pushing units in front. Wind is obstructed by solid blocks. Can be controlled by processors for more precise angles.

docs.title: Grand Constructor
docs.text: Fabricates structures up to 6x6 tiles in size. Needs coolant to forge blocks.

docs.title: Small Deconstructor
docs.text: Deconstructs structures and units. Returns 100% of build cost.

docs.title: Disassembler
docs.text: Even bigger version of the deconstructor. Deconstructs structures and units. Returns 100% of build cost.

docs.title: Payload Packer
docs.text: Loads liquids and items into larger blocks.

docs.title: Rail
docs.text: Transports blocks and units. Rail Roombas will pick up a block in front, carry the block, and place it down at its destination.

docs.title: Payload Unpacker
docs.text: Unloads liquids and items into larger blocks.

docs.title: Phase Claw
docs.text: Grabs a nearby unit and tries not to let go. Grabs allies, players and foes alike. This claw needs power to function, except on spinners where it generates its own power from its momentum. Cannot grab other claw blocks or itself.

docs.title: Rail Sorter
docs.text: Distributes blocks and units. Acts as a router when no configuration is selected. Can be configured to sort only blocks, only units, or a specific type of block/unit.

docs.title: Rejuvenator
docs.text: Continuously repairs the closest damaged unit or building in its vicinity. Units are prioritized.

docs.title: Teleporter
docs.text: Teleports players to another teleporter connected to the same power grid. Also teleports ground units. When disabled by logic processors, it only sends players to other teleporters, like a one-way gate.

docs.title: Mini Portal
docs.text: Teleports players to another mini portal. Also teleports ground units.

docs.title: Unit Duct
docs.text: Allows bidirectional transport of units, from one end to another. Only the entrance block needs power to input units. All other blocks do not consume power, even when connected to the grid, so do not worry.

docs.title: [#f3e979]Bedrock[]
docs.text: Used in environmental walls.

docs.title: Bittrium
docs.text: Obtained in Portal Invasions. Used as currency or in ancient inventions.

docs.title: Cryonite
docs.text: Used in freezing weapons and advanced defences.

docs.title: Scalar Ore
docs.text: A natural algebraic material containing a physical quantity of a real number and only that. Can also be described as only having a magnitude.

docs.title: Tensor Ore
docs.text: A natural algebraic object describing a multilinear relationship between sets of algebraic objects related to a vector space, including vector and scalar.

docs.title: Vector Ore
docs.text: A natural algebraic material that has two independent properties, magnitude and direction.

docs.title: [#f3e979]Pixellium[]
docs.text: Used in ancient blocks and floors.

docs.title: Scalar Alloy
docs.text: A refined material processed from scalar ore.

docs.title: Source
docs.text: An algorithm formed by fragments of code storing an amount of information and/or an instruction to run.

docs.title: Space Matter
docs.text: Used in endgame blocks, weapons and antimatter technology.

docs.title: Luminite
docs.text: Used in foreign blocks with special behaviors.

docs.title: Tensor Compound
docs.text: A refined material processed from tensor ore.

docs.title: [#f3e979]Tungsten[]
docs.text: Used in various electrical structures. Heats up and illuminates when under high voltages.

docs.title: Vector Alloy
docs.text: A refined material processed from vector ore.

docs.title: [#f3e979]Wood[]
docs.text: Use unknown.

docs.title: [#f3e979]Zinc[]
docs.text: Used in exotic turrets and high-tier structures.

docs.title: Coffee
docs.text: Somewhat edible programmer fuel.

docs.title: Colloid
docs.text: A high-density coolant with both solid and liquid properties. Used as turret coolant and crafter lubricant.

docs.title: Force Fluid
docs.text: A condensed fluid form of bulletproof force. Used as fuel for advanced bulletproof measures.

docs.title: Siloxol
docs.text: A silicon compound rich in hydrogen. Used as fusion reactant, lubricant, or filtered to obtain water and silicon.

docs.title: [sky]Lunar Colony Ruins[]
docs.text: During the research of the planetary launch systems, a strange signal was received from Serpulo's moon, Shar. Shar was thought as a lifeless moon but patterned radio waves suggest otherwise. Investigate.

docs.title: Amnesia
docs.text: Forgets all abilities.

docs.title: Bane of Resolution
docs.text: It is kill or be killed. Both deal and take infinite damage.

docs.title: Flowery Aura
docs.text: Applies Spring Breeze to nearby ally units.

docs.title: Boosting
docs.text: Fast. Cannot stop.

docs.title: Creative Shock
docs.text: Building blocks is banned.

docs.title: Dissonance
docs.text: Resonating sound waves damage fragile mechanisms.

docs.title: Drifting
docs.text: Swerving uncontrollably. Cannot stop.

docs.title: Forward Biased
docs.text: Circuitry has been enhanced. Applies Reverse Biased to nearby enemy units.

docs.title: Glowing
docs.text: Cells emit a bright glow. Useful in dark areas.

docs.title: Ideology
docs.text: "We." Has a chance to turn enemy units into our team.

docs.title: Paused
docs.text: Cannot do anything.

docs.title: Reverse Biased
docs.text: Circuitry has been hindered. Attempting to shoot will result in damage.

docs.title: Selfless Decay
docs.text: Materials and nanoparticles are leaking. Applies Selfish Repair to nearby enemy units.

docs.title: Warped
docs.text: The runes of the altar opened a portal... to the other side.

Property Value Repository https://github.com/dong-wo-long/betterdustrymod Stars 33 Last updated 2026-03-22T14:50:18Z

I'm too lazy to work on this mod 24/7, so don't expect frequent updates. The reason is simple: no spriters, no testers, no moral support... in short, we endure and we carry on

= = = = = О моде / About mod = = = = =

RU: Очень опасный мод, который влияет на баланс и механику игры, добавляет новый контент в виде статус эффектов и оборонительных сооружений (башен, мин и т.д.).

Рекомендуется перед установкой сделать сохранение (чтобы откатиться назад), если в случае вам не понравится то, что может сделать данный мод. И лучше в самом деле не рискуйте лишний раз и поверьте на слово: МОД. МЕНЯЕТ. МНОГОЕ.

Важно: Описание некоторых юнитов не корректно, либо и вовсе неправильное.

ENG: A highly dangerous mod that affects game balance and mechanics, adding new content in the form of status effects and defensive structures (towers, mines, etc.).

It is highly recommended to create a backup save before installation (so you can revert), in case you don't like what this mod might do. And really, it's better not to take unnecessary risks and just take our word for it: THIS MOD. CHANGES. MANY THINGS.

Important: The descriptions for some units are incorrect or entirely wrong.

Особая благодарность для людей / A Special Thank You to people:

  • inflarespirit (eve_light)

  • ARmOrDer

Статисты / Playtesters: kakoy-to Nekit, a takze nytiki i haters

(Nekit, don't be offended, it's a joke. You are also worthy of special thanks on the same level as ARmOrDer)

docs.title: Small Blast Door
docs.text: A small wall that opens when allied ground units are in range. Cannot be manually controlled.

docs.title: Small Shielded Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles, reflecting most bullets upon impact. Deploys a shield that absorbs most projectiles when power is provided. Conducts power.

docs.title: EMP Mine
docs.text: On contact with the enemy, the mine explodes and incapacitates units for 2.5 seconds. The mine can also deal electricity damage and reduces the units combat effectiveness for an additional 5 seconds.

docs.title: Frag Mine
docs.text: Used against infantry and heavy enemy troops. Upon contact with the target, it explodes and splits into 9 fragments, causing damage over an area.

docs.title: Small Force Projector
docs.text: A small analog version of «Power Projectors». Compact, easy to use and fast shield recharge - together give indispensable help in the defense of important facilities. Cannot be improved, only coolant acceleration is possible.

docs.title: Armored Large Power Node
docs.text: Armored power node with even greater durability and power transmission range.

docs.title: Armored Power Node
docs.text: An armored power node with a slightly longer power transfer range, but at the expense of fewer possible connections.

docs.title: Medium Solar Panel
docs.text: Provides a small amount of energy from the sun. A more efficient solar panel model. Produces about 5 times more energy.

docs.title: Fragment
docs.text: Smaller, cheaper and more compact version of «Segment». Damages and destroys approaching projectiles. Does not interact with laser beams.

docs.title: Small reinforced payload conveyor
docs.text: Designed for faster and more compact transportation of units and objects.

docs.title: Small reinforced payload router
docs.text: More quickly and compactly distributes the load to the three possible free routes.

docs.title: Large reinforced payload conveyor
docs.text: Designed for heavier transportation of units and large objects.

docs.title: Large reinforced payload router
docs.text: Allocates a heavier load to three possible free routes.

docs.title: Locus wreck
docs.text: The wreckage of an medium tank

docs.title: Precept wreck
docs.text: The wreckage of an tank

docs.title: Stell wreck
docs.text: The wreckage of an tank

docs.text:
Property Value Repository https://github.com/undaria/mindustry-calamity-mod Stars 33 Last updated 2025-09-07T06:11:57Z

A mod based on the old legend of the Terraria Calamity is being continuously updated and currently has over 300 contents!

The Mod campaign emphasizes blitzkrieg, please pay attention to it when playing for the first time.

If you encounter any problems during the gameplay, please provide feedback to the author.

docs.title: Alloy Casting Furnace
docs.text: Casts Surge Alloy in a high-temperature environment.

docs.title: Atmospheric Separator
docs.text: Fractionates Nitrogen from the atmosphere using boiling point differences.

docs.title: Explosive Mix Furnace
docs.text: Combines Spores and Sulfides into an explosive and unstable mixture.

docs.title: Chip Printer
docs.text: Manufactures precision chips using semiconductor materials.

docs.title: Advanced Chip Printer
docs.text: Reprocesses chips to enhance computing power.

docs.title: Cyanogen Reaction Chamber
docs.text: Combines Nitrogen and Hydrogen into Cyanogen.

docs.title: Refiner
docs.text: Separates different minerals from Slag Liquor.

docs.title: Electrolytic Chamber
docs.text: Electrolyzes water into Hydrogen and Oxygen.

docs.title: Electromagnetic Alloy Furnace
docs.text: Produces alloys in a Helium environment. More efficient and safer.

docs.title: Energy Core Factory
docs.text: Produces Energy Cores.

docs.title: Cryo Chamber
docs.text: Manufactures Cryofluid. Requires significant Hydrogen.

docs.title: Fusion Furnace
docs.text: Fuses Lithium and Nitrogen nuclei into Helium.

docs.title: Glass Kiln
docs.text: Smelts Sand and Nickel into Tempered Glass.

docs.title: Graphite Stamping Furnace
docs.text: Used when there is no surface Graphite ore, to manufacture Graphite.

docs.title: Heat Conduit Router
docs.text: Distributes heat equally in three directions.

docs.title: Heat Conduit
docs.text: Transfers heat.

docs.title: High-Pressure Crusher
docs.text: Crushes Scrap into Sand.

docs.title: Hydrogen Heater
docs.text: Generates heat by igniting a Hydrogen-air mixture using an electric spark.

docs.title: Laser Incinerator
docs.text: Incinerates any input item using a laser.

docs.title: Neutron Irradiation Chamber
docs.text: Irradiates Uranium in a reactor, altering its proton count to produce Plutonium.

docs.title: Nitride Extractor
docs.text: Uses Nitrogen to separate and purify Lithium from water.

docs.title: Oil Desulfurizer
docs.text: Extracts Sulfur from Oil.

docs.title: Partial Pressure Smelting Furnace
docs.text: Refines and separates Iridosmine Ore into Iridium and Osmium metal.

docs.title: Phase Loom
docs.text: Weaves phase matter from Uranium and Silica in a high-temperature ozone environment.

docs.title: Plastanium Stamping Press
docs.text: Polymerizes raw materials into Plastanium under high pressure.

docs.title: Scrap Melter
docs.text: Melts Scrap into Slag.

docs.title: Thermal Silicon Furnace
docs.text: Refines Graphite and Sand into Silicon.

docs.title: Snowmaker
docs.text: Sublimates water into snow.

docs.title: Large Cultivator
docs.text: Cultivates Spore Pods more efficiently.

docs.title: Spore Stamping Press
docs.text: Compresses Spores into Oil under high pressure.

docs.title: Thermal Heater
docs.text: Generates heat by burning Sulfides.

docs.title: Union Silicon Furnace
docs.text: Inputs Sand and Graphite, outputs Silicon and Glass.

docs.title: Uranium Centrifuge
docs.text: Separates impurities from Uranium Ore to purify Uranium.

docs.text: MinBOSS Map A desert occupied by several Wulfrum bases, showing signs of past wars. Data indicates Oil resources beneath the sand. Surface traces of underground lava flows exist. Use lava for power generation. Extract Oil to produce Plastanium. Surface Coal deposits can be utilized. Water must be somewhere.

A peaceful campaign mod which focuses on factory building.

Build production lines, decode archives, and launch landing pods across the sectors of Asphodel, a cold planet ravaged by the forces of war. Salvage what remains of the Coalition, and restore their industry to its former glory.

This mod is mostly complete in terms of implemented content, but its campaign is still unfinished. Either way, I hope you'll enjoy what the mod has to offer.

docs.title: Forward Outpost
docs.text:
The way forward. A humble outpost located on a river near the reserve, built by the Coalition during the war in order to expand their forces. The base has long since been reduced to rubble, though there may still be some important structures left in the ruins.

A more advanced landing pod will be necessary to continue from here. Assemble and launch a Guided Landing Pod using the technology found in this sector.

docs.title: The Reserve
docs.text:
A time capsule hidden far away from the rest of the planet, only to be booted up in case of an emergency.

Something must have gone horribly wrong here.

Begin building factories and automating products. Explore the land, searching for anything that can be salvaged. Figure out how to construct and launch a Crude Landing Pod in order to move on to the next sector.

docs.title: Scrap
docs.text: A common material composed of many different metals. It's used in general building and in unit production.

docs.title: Copper
docs.text: A soft metal with small electric charge and conductivity. Used primarily in electronics, general building, unit production and ammunition and can also be used as an ingredient for more advanced resources.

docs.title: Soft Coal
docs.text: A simple fuellant, acquired through refinement processes as a byproduct. Composed of mostly carbon and oxygen, it's an essential rudimentary feul due to it's flammability.

docs.title: Alluminum
docs.text: A charged, soft and light metal extracted from bauxitic ground. Rather than being mined from surface ore deposits, it's extracted from bauxitic floor. Used in building, unit production, power generation, as ammunition for turrets and also as an ingredient for advanced resourses, it's an extremely versatile metal you'll always need later on.

docs.title: Cupride
docs.text: A slightly charged product acquired through oxidizing copper. Cupride has an unique property that makes it able to redirect or contain gas inside it. These properties make it useful in building (especially gas-based turrets) and as corrosive and expansive ammunition.

docs.title: Europium
docs.text: A strongly charged metal, robust and slightly radioactive metal. It's robust structure requires a Blast Drill to mine. It's primarily used in building, advanced unit production and as ammunition for turrets. It's also able to be used as an ingredient for mass Neutrilizer production due to it's usually cold state when acquiring it.

docs.title: Polycarbonate
docs.text: A kind of plastic synthesized through infusing liquid petroleum gas with soft coal and letting it solidify. Used primarily in building and unit production.

docs.title: Sulphur
docs.text: A highly flammable material extracted through splitting hydrogen sulfide into hydrogen and sulfur particles and then binding the sulfur particles into a usable resource. Due to it's high flammability it's used primarily as flammable or explosive ammunition in turrets or as a fuellant.

docs.title: Echo Shard
docs.text: A charged, radioactive, and durable pile of metals infested with exotic nanomachines left behind by ancient civilisations. This resource is found on ruined structures and requires a dedicated mining unit to extract. It's charged, radioactive and robust properties make it an excellent material for a variety of uses, like advanced structures, electronics, unit production, ammunition for turrets or creation of advanced components/alloys. It's high radioactivity also makes it an efficient material in power generation through radioactive decay.

docs.title: Echo Circuit
docs.text: An electronic component dedicated to handling precise and complex tasks. Made by layering down Copper, Alluminum and Echo Shards and using hydrogen sulfide to carve out and shape the circuit creates better environment for the nanomachines found inside echo shards, thus, increasing their computing capabilities. It's used in building more advanced structures, advanced unit components and for making guided missles in specialized turrets.

docs.title: Alluminum Polycarbonate
docs.text: A highly charged reinforced plastic. It's made through bonding Polycarbonate with Alluminum, smelting and solidifying them in a specialized mold, creating this highly impact resistant and lightly flammable material. It's generally used in late-game building and high-tier unit production. On some occasions it can be used as high-knockback ammunition in a small variety of turrets due to its impact resistance.

docs.title: Resonance Matrix
docs.text: An unstable and highly radioactive Alloy, fabricated through an immense reaction process. By melting massive amounts of Echo Shards and Europium, charging the melted mass with extreme amounts of electricity, soldifying it and then coating the resulting mass with Hydrogen Sulfide, you get this Alloy with its wild properties. Depending on how you use it, it can be utilized in building highly advanced structures, fabricating High-Tier units, as ammunition for late-game turrets, and even as a fuellant for a sophisticated reactor type.

docs.title: Crude Oil
docs.text: A naturally occurring viscocious mass of carbon and flammable or corrosive components. It has very little uses in its raw state, and has to be processed for later stages of the game.

docs.title: Contaminated Water
docs.text: A darkened version of regular Water exclusive to the rocky bodies of the Epsilon Boötis A system. It's unpurity is easy to spot due to its slightly darker color and composition of extreme amounts of minerals, toxic metals, and other things. Its main uses are in power generation and in early game cooling as it's still able to capacitate heat even if it's not strong. It can be purified, however, to create a better cooler.

docs.title: Purified Water
docs.text: A purified version of Dirty Water, with way more heat capacity than it's Dirty counterpart. It's great heat capacity is the reason why it's used extensively on both kaltos and aetheria allowing for great cooling in buildings and turrets. It can also be used as ammunition for fluid-based turret. It also creates way less pollution than dirty water when boiled into vapor, making it use less Neutrilizer.

docs.title: Slag
docs.text: A molten mass of a variety of metals. It's an essential liquid when playing your campaign, due to it's wide usage field. Used in refinery, power generation, alloy coating, mining and as ammunition for incendiary, melting or fluid-based turrets.

docs.title: Liquid Petroleum Gas
docs.text: A product of refining crude oil. It's high flammability makes it a hard Liquid to work with, but it's a crucial part in the creation of stable polymers and mid-range power generation.

docs.title: Sulphuric Acid
docs.text: A highly corrosive acid made by binding Sulphur with bare Ozone or purified water. It's great inside its limited usage field, providing as an excellent kickstarter for some power generators, as well as being great at chipping down metallic layers, corroding surfaces. Hence why they're also used in liquid- or corrosion-/ effect-application- based turrets.

docs.text: A tanky crab unit with no offensive capabilities. Can repair allied structures.

docs.title: Magnum
docs.text: Fires several artillery shells at medium distances.

docs.title: Hogleg
docs.text: Fires barrages of piercing high-speed rounds. Pew pew pew.

docs.title: Blaze
docs.text: Has a single flamethrower.

docs.title: Singe
docs.text: Has 2 plasma cannons.

docs.title: Bonfire
docs.text: A heavy unit capable of generating large explosions that leave behind large amounts of fire. It is suggested you get rid of them as soon as possible because they can ignore your defences.

docs.title: Mabuz
docs.text: Fires alternating clusters of bullets. Cannot cross terrain.

docs.title: Keres
docs.text: Fires clusters of homing projectiles. Cannot cross terrain.

docs.title: Ephai
docs.text: Fires alternating piercing rounds. Cannot cross terrain.

docs.title: Fester
docs.text: Equipped with a medium railcannon and a few support-fire weapons. Cannot cross terrain.

ATTENTION:

From now on, the mod goes into experimental mode - this means that the balance may not be balanced, such as a Toxopid with a Corvus, whose attack radius go far beyond 60 cells!!!!!

Nevertheless, I advise you to calm down: when the mod reaches its peak (despite my crazy plans for it, the result of which you are already watching), I will make several versions to meet the needs of as many people as possible. In the meantime, it remains to wait. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Important:

This mod does not bring anything radically new to the game, but only expands the combat functionality of existing combat units.

Please pay attention:

The mod significantly redesigns units, changes the balance and generally complicates the game. Don't forget to make a backup in case you don't like the changes that the mod itself makes.

P.S. The mod is made for ALE maps.

Add the new sectors and content on Erekir

docs.title: Bperill Extractor

docs.title: Tungsten Kiln
docs.text: A small factory that make tungsten oxide.

docs.title: Hydrogen Heater

docs.title: Replacer

docs.title: Bolster

docs.title: Rubidium Launch Pad

docs.title: Striker

docs.text: Creates a directional force field in front of itself, protecting structures from enemy projectiles. Expect time-consuming repairs when the shield is brought down.

docs.title: Heat Pump

docs.text: Fires large piercing beams that bend the fabric of reality within it's victims and summon equally deadly missiles, from its barrel, all the way to the insides of an enemy Conquer tank. Requres 2 Neoplasia Reactors worth of power. (untested)

docs.title: [cyan]Time Launcher
docs.text: Launches missiles introduced from another timeline. Requires power.

docs.text: Upgrades inputted repair units to the second tier

docs.text: Upgrades inputted tank units to the alternative second tier

docs.text: Toxic byproduct of the replacer structure. Uses by the turrets.

docs.title: Abandoned Factory
docs.text: There was a factory, where technology is researched. Use it to give the Malis base a taste of their own medicine.

docs.title: Blade Base
docs.text: This place has extremely large deposits of bare thorium. Collect, capture and move on.

docs.title: Cores Trap
docs.text: Extensive scans show that the landing position is conveniently in between two enemy cores. Do not underestimate this base unless you know what you're doing.

docs.title: The Fort
docs.text: This place has a fort. Survive.

docs.title: The Armored Centre
docs.text: After careful consideration, we have realised that this "armored centre" is a trap made by the router entity. Prepare for the worst.

docs.title: Connection
docs.text: This sector will be a great place to use payload related mechanics. A lesser enemy base has also been found.

docs.title: Omega Outpost
docs.text: A not-so well-fortified fortress is found in this sector, providing a convenient boost in resources. Destroy the base, leaving nothing behind.

docs.title: Rubidium Fortress
docs.text: A new material has been detected — rubidium. Get this material and destroy the erected malis fortress.

docs.title: Great Rubidium Wall
docs.text: There was a big red stone wall placed there. The beryllium and tungsten walls there have anomalous species, basically rendering walls of said resources less doable to use. All attacks are expected to be flying units.

docs.title: The Source
docs.text: The source of hacking has been detected. Destroy the aforementioned source, leaving nothing behind and permanently deleting the enemy's power source.

docs.text:
This sector have some unstable power units indirectly controlling the sector. It seems that something has already took control even though no enemy base is present. Prepare.

You will be lended a helping hand (three allied conquer units) for capturing said sector.

docs.text: Repairs allied damaged buildings with a beam.

docs.title: Regeneration
docs.text: Quickly repairs allied damaged buildings with a beam.

A mod that was originally meant to add liquid related stuff to erekir but i ended up having too many ideas.

helpers: GameStuffOfficial, @mr_shapka228, @smolkeys_

special thanks to u/WishboneOk8660 on reddit, who made amazing fanart of the mod and the og idea for the support boat line.

Mod kind of abandoned, will just move it up to newer versions anytime one comes out

docs.title: Azpacite Cooler
docs.text: uses nitrogen in a powerful heatsink to cool azpanogen and crystallise it into azpacite.

docs.title: Azpanogen evaporator
docs.text: Creates azpanogen from silicon and hydrogen. Requires heating.

docs.title: Carbide Blast Crucible
docs.text: Makes larger amounts of carbide while burning hydrogen and ozone to produce extra heat. Can be boosted further than a conventional crucible.

docs.title: Cesium Crystallizer
docs.text: crystallizes cesium out of slag.

docs.title: Cyanogen Condenser
docs.text: Produces cyanogen by directly reacting graphite with gases from vents, but requires a lot of power.

docs.title: Neoplasia Cultivator
docs.text: Creates neoplasm in a safe environment, cannot explode but needs a lot of power.

docs.title: Phase Chainer
docs.text: Creates a lot more phase fabric by assembling it on a baseplate of carbide and phase fabric and then cutting it. This substrate allows phase fibers to grow quicker and as such make it a lot better for large scale production.

docs.title: Phosphine Reactor
docs.text: Uses atmospheric gases in a reaction with living beings to make phosphine.

docs.title: Polymer Phostosynthesis Panel
docs.text: Uses a few materials and a large amount of heat to create diluted goop.

docs.title: Silicon Arc Crucible
docs.text: Makes massive amounts of silicon and some tungsten from sand residues.

docs.title: Surge Induction Smelter
docs.text: Uses powerful magnetic fields to melt slag, silicon, and extra tungsten into larger amounts of surge alloy.

docs.title: Warped Heater
docs.text: Uses dilute polymer fiber to produce large amounts of heat and polymer goo.

docs.title: Warped Weaver
docs.text: Creates warped polymer fabric from dilute and concentrated polymer fibers, using some other materials as catalysts for the reaction.

docs.title: Azpacite wall
docs.text: A small wall that absorbs ennemy bullets and stops laser projectiles.

docs.title: floating beryllium wall
docs.text: A wall that blocks ennemy projectiles and can be built on liquids.

docs.title: Warped Wall
docs.text: A large and strong wall that blocks ennemy projectiles and lasers.

docs.title: Large azpacite wall
docs.text: A large wall that blocks incoming ennemy projectiles and stops lasers.

docs.title: large floating beryllium wall
docs.text: A wall that blocks ennemy projectiles and can be built on liquids.

docs.title: Large Warped wall
docs.text: A huge wall that blocks lasers and has a chance to deflect bullets. Also has a directional single use shield whenever it is powered.

docs.title: Large shielded wall
docs.text: A large wall that projects an absorption shield around itself and reflects most bullets. Unlike its smaller variant, does not require power.Blocks lasers.

docs.title: Advanced Assembler Module
docs.text: Increases an assembler's assembly tier to tier 2 if a basic assembler module is already on it.

docs.title: phase duct
docs.text: Moves items over large distances using small amounts of power.

docs.title: Regen Dome
docs.text: Slightly more efficient than a normal regen projector, but also has a much larger range.

docs.title: Geothermal Steam Extractor
docs.text: Injects highly explosive cesium to break the ground underneath itself and extract steam, wich it then uses in a turbine to produce power.

docs.title: Amp
docs.text: shoots a long-range piercing emp pulse at ennemy targets that constantly fires lasers to its sides.

docs.title: Differentiate
docs.text: Shoots differently depending on the ammunition provided to it. Gets a very large firerate boost when supplied with water

docs.title: Fission
docs.text: shoots a large incendiary laser beam by causing fission within the atoms composing the air, dealing massive damage to ennemy targets.

docs.title: Hellfire
docs.text: The reward for beating the basaltoid, fires a massive stream of damaging flames at ennemy ground targets.

docs.title: Hellstorm
docs.text: shoots innacurate fragmentary artillery at ennemy ground targets.

docs.title: Jet
docs.text: A large long-range liquid turret, fires an orb that fires massive amounts of liquid orbs around itself.

docs.title: Ohm
docs.text: Fires a bunch of bullets wich explode into lasers, requires large amounts of power.

docs.title: Overseer
docs.text: A superweapon that shoots a massive v o i d spear. Can be boosted with water.

docs.title: Permeate
docs.text: A superweapon that hurls powerful balls of fragmenting impervium alloy at ennemy targets, dealing massive damage upon impact.

docs.title: Pulse Sender Tower
docs.text: Used to transfer massive loads of energy beetween different bases on different planets.

docs.title: Resonance
docs.text: shoots a bullet wich bounces backwards a few times upon impact and then explodes.

docs.title: Scald
docs.text: Summons accelerating bullets that rush outwards in a line.

docs.title: shatter
docs.text: Shoots tungsten bolts that weaken and pierces ennemy air unit's armors.

docs.title: shelling
docs.text: fires large salvos of long-range artillery shells. some shells may fail and not fire.

docs.title: Spray
docs.text: shoots huge salvos of gas-powered missiles.

docs.title: Stream
docs.text: a medium ranged turret that fires a superheated liquid spike. Can use slag to speed up the heating process.

docs.title: Volt
docs.text: fires an electrically charged long-range missile that carries a strong electric field.

docs.title: Watt
docs.text: ionizes air to create a path for 3 powerful electric discharges to take to deal large damage to ground targets. Can optionally use nitrogen to help with the creation of the conductive plasma.

docs.title: Xerturn
docs.text: Fires a massive tungsten bolt at the weakest ennemy target it detects. The bullet can't be absorbed by shields and does not pierce buildings. Made to eliminate large groups of small units. Idea from @smiler4 on discord.

docs.title: Advanced special assembler
docs.text: assembles tier 6 units.

docs.title: Advanced combat assembler
docs.text: assembles tier 6 air and tank units.

docs.title: Advanced mech assembler
docs.text: assembles tier 6 mech units.

docs.title: Advanced naval assembler
docs.text: assembles tier 6 naval units.

docs.title: chemical assembler
docs.text: assembles large chemical crab units using payload as input. Requires cyanogen.

docs.title: Chemical fabricator
docs.text: Produces chemical insectoid units

docs.title: Complex Specialist Assembler
docs.text: Assembles tier 7 units of 3 different lines. Requires a lot of power and some phosphine.

docs.title: Specialist ship assembler
docs.text: assembles large naval units using payload as input. Requires cyanogen.

docs.title: Naval fabricator
docs.text: Produces pyrolobus units.

docs.title: naval refabricator
docs.text: Upgrades naval units to their second tier.

docs.title: Specialist ship assembler
docs.text: assembles large specialist ships using payload as inputs. Requires cyanogen.

docs.title: Specialist ship fabricator
docs.text: Produces specialized flying units units.

docs.title: Support Naval Assembler
docs.text: Assembles large support naval units using payload as input. Requires cyanogen.

docs.title: Support ship assembler
docs.text: assembles large support ships using payload as inputs. Requires cyanogen.

docs.title: Azpacite
docs.text: A cristalline superconductor used in high-tier electrical applications.

docs.title: Cesium
docs.text: An easily moldable metal that reacts with water and is used inhigh-tier chemistry applications.

docs.title: Warped Polymer Fabric
docs.text: Very strong fabric with weird properties.

docs.title: Azpanogen
docs.text: a reactive and hot gas that is used in different applications. Can be cooled to form azpacite.

docs.title: Diluted polymer fiber
docs.text: Weird and goopy, emanating a lot of heat and radiation.

docs.title: Phosphine
docs.text: A gas produced by organic beings. Used in a few important things.

docs.title: Polymer goo
docs.text: A very thick semi-fluid substance.

docs.title: alpha outpost
docs.text: A small asteroid with some ennemy forces and a semi-abandoned base. Its proximity to the sun makes it extremely hot.

docs.title: [#efb044]Commarchya
docs.text: An asteroid on a low orbit around erekir, very hot due to tidal forces. Has an ennemy base that might be difficult to deal with.

docs.title: Chasm
docs.text: A deep ravine through wich a small amount of ennemy units go.

docs.title: Concave
docs.text: A small ennemy base with a bit of unit production capacity is here.

docs.title: Cornered
docs.text: A sector with plentiful ressources and high ennemy presence. Take over the sector and research the Shatter turret to deal with the latter waves.

docs.title: Desolate Corridor
docs.text: A seemingly abandoned outpost from an obsolete team has been detected here. Attacking it may cause retaliation from large waves of different types of units, including potential tier 6 units.

docs.title: Erebus
docs.text: A stalemate beetween an ancient team's stronghold and a malis base. End it and take the sector's plentiful ressources.

docs.title: Junction
docs.text: The intersection beetween two small ravines. A small malis production outpost has been detected here along with the passage of units from an unknown team.

docs.title: Faultline
docs.text: A system of rifts and fissures has caused a depression to form, giving way to a slag river through wich ennemy boat units will pass. Research the Shelling turret to better deal with the great amounts of ennemies of the later waves.

docs.title: Fissure
docs.text: 2 intersecting fault lines have caused a deep depression to open in the ground. A large amount of ennemy units come through here. The afflict turret and surge walls will be required to stand a chance against the later waves.

docs.title: Interlude
docs.text: The malis is on its last leg. Destroy the large amount of high tier units here and go on.

docs.title: Ovoid
docs.text: No usual radar signatures detected, however there might still be an ennemy base here. You will be attacked immediatly upon landaing, be careful.

docs.title: Magmatic Sinkhole
docs.text: A massive lava tube caved in here, revealing a base from an unknown ennemy. research the naval refabricator and deinoco units to crack the small fortress.

docs.title: Blazing River
docs.text: The river feeding into the slag lake of a nearby sector has a few small ennemy bases.

docs.title: Swamp
docs.text: A sector with plentyful arkycite. Upon landing you will be under threat from ennemy boat units and ennemy mechs.

docs.title: Amborella
docs.text: A small support unit that heals blocks while protecting them with a small forcefield.

docs.title: Amputate
docs.text: A powerful unit that has an electric field and shoots a long-range continuous laser wich pierces dealing very high damage.

docs.title: Areca
docs.text: A support unit that drops bombs with a large hit radius, healing allied targets. Can carry payload.

docs.title: Austroba
docs.text: A small support unit that heals blocks and units while protecting them with a small forcefield. Can build.

docs.title: [#ff8046]Basaltoid
docs.text: An ancient flagship covered in rocks to protect it from erekir's harsh conditions, although over half of it has been destroyed, it still is a threat.

docs.title: Cupressa
docs.text: A large flying unit with high health and armor that posseses a strong shield and powerful healing and building capabilities. Can carry large payloads.

docs.title: Disfigure
docs.text: A massive airship, made to demolish an ennemy base to rubble with its massive continuous laser beam.

docs.title: Dismember
docs.text: A strong specialist air unit that shoots 2 powerful long-range piercing lasers, but has low health.

docs.title: Dissonance
docs.text: Fires ballistic missile and massive damaging orbs at ground targets.

docs.title: Eclipse
docs.text: uhhhhhh how did this get here...

docs.title: [#6efff0]Eviscerate
docs.text: The last hope of the Blue Batallion, a massive airship made to demolish entire fortresses in an instant, and that while unfinished, still has insane firepower and range that make it the most formidable oponent you'll ever meet.

docs.title: [#ff6161]Eviscerate
docs.text: Assembled in high orbit, out of the sight of anyone, has now come down upon you to end your efforts after you failed to destroy the last consciousness.

docs.title: Huerta
docs.text: A large support unit that protects and heals allied blocks and units. Can carry large payloads and is equipped with two rocket boosters that allow it to go quite fast..

docs.title: Incise
docs.text: A more bulky air specialist that charges and fires damaging lasers and occasional bursts of missiles.

docs.title: mutilate
docs.text: A very large flying unit that posseses some serious firepower as well as a powerful electric field and force field.

docs.title: Distortion
docs.text: A very large flying unit that shoots large volleys of missiles and constant missile fire at ennemy targets. Posseses destructive main missile that deals massive damage and disables regeneration for a long time.

docs.title: Sever
docs.text: a simple and fast air specialist that shoots a piercing laser at ennemy targets.

docs.title: Laceration
docs.text: Shoots a continuous laser and 2 smaller lasers at ennemy targets.

docs.title: Tomaxella
docs.text: A massive airship with a lot of health and armor that shoots a bunch of lasers at ennemy targets

docs.title: Tsuga
docs.text: A huge flying support unit that shoots long range twisting bullets and a large laser at ennemy targets while protecting allies under its powerful healing field and forcefield.

docs.title: Action
docs.text: Shoots salvos of firey projectiles at ennemy targets.

docs.title: Atomize
docs.text: Has a mounted malign and a bunch of small cannons for the annihilation of ennemy targets.

docs.title: Colonize
docs.text: A very large and powerful tank with a mounted miniaturized smite that can crush ennemy defenses.

docs.title: combust
docs.text: Shoots a small short range flame at ennemies.

docs.title: Ionize
docs.text: Rapidly shoots piercing ionizing bullets. Becomes faster when shooting. Posses great firepower.

docs.title: Irradiate
docs.text: A very large 12 legged unit that while it moves slowly, summons a bunch of long range weapons to destroy ennemy targets.

docs.title: Lucana
docs.text: Fires a large fragmenting missile at ennemy targets periodically.

docs.title: Oxidize
docs.text: Shoots salvos of oxidizing bullet at ennemy targets.

docs.title: Reaction
docs.text: A large unit with powerful, large legs that give it a very fast speed for its size. Can boost to go faster. Shoots 2 strong plasma flames and 2 sapping lasers.

docs.title: Xenoid
docs.text: has gone horrible wrong.

docs.title: Audax
docs.text: A medium sized ship that shoots long range missiles at ennemy ground targets.

docs.title: Carphania
docs.text: A medium, light, and fast naval support unit, shoots a fragmentary orb, and can heal allies.

docs.title: Deinoco
docs.text: a small ship immune to burning and melting damage that shoots a spread of missiles.

docs.title: Hyperthermophile
docs.text: The final tier of slag boat units, possessing massive firepower and long range to destroy things quickly.

docs.title: Lepido
docs.text: A huge and well armored ship that has an explosive core and long-range missile launcher.

docs.title: Phagotenia
docs.text: A large very well armored ship that shoots a massive swarm of missiles at ennemy targets. Also occasionaly releases a massive lightning explosion.

docs.title: Pompeja
docs.text: A large ship that shoots like a volcanic eruption.

docs.title: Pyrolobus
docs.text: a small ship immune to burning and melting damage that rapidly shoots small bullets at ennemy targets

docs.title: Ruffoi
docs.text: A bit larger support boat unit. Burns ennemies with a small laser, still pretty fast and can turn quickly thanks to jet propulsion.

docs.title: Ryani
docs.text: A small support boat unit. Shoots ennemies with small artillery, capable of turning on the spot thanks to jet propulsion.

docs.title: Sigismund
docs.text: A large, but still fast support ship, with a bit worse attack capability than its assault counterpart, but still good firepower.

docs.title: Trinacria
docs.text: A large but still quite fast jet propelled support boat, has really great healing capabilities as well as two piercing spear launchers.

docs.title: Vulgaris
docs.text: A powerful support ship equipped with a segmented shield and electric field. Fires powerful damaging orbs and missiles at close ennemy targets.

A mod that adds in a butt load of content

docs.title: Alloy Kiln
docs.text: An upgrade of the alloy smelter that is able to produce more surge at the cost of extra materials.

docs.title: Electro Arc Forge
docs.text: Uses lightning arcs to melt and supercharge materials to create Vanstarium Steel.

docs.title: Calamity Forge
docs.text: An Ancient forge. This forge cannot be deconstructed after its built. Condenses down large amounts of cold plasma and energy to create a powerful alloy.

docs.title: Cold Plasma Chamber
docs.text: Uses water and Astrolite to create cold plasma.

docs.title: Cold Energy Fuser
docs.text: Infuses materials together with hydrogen to form a special metal.

docs.title: S.D Refinery
docs.text: Takes siradamite and crushes and refines it into Siratla diamond.

docs.title: Crystallizer
docs.text: Compresses and energises Graphite with cold plasma to form a crystal like mineral.

docs.title: Cold Plasma Splitter
docs.text: Splits cold plasma into hydrogen.

docs.title: Plasma Fusion Forge
docs.text: Uses axin gas to produce intense fusions materials. Creates several types of materials.

docs.title: Silicon Kiln
docs.text: Burns astralite and sand into silicon

docs.title: Silicon Oven
docs.text: Burns astralite and sand into silicon

docs.title: Stellar Furnace
docs.text: Melts togther titanium and astrolite to forge Stellar steel. Creates silicon as byproduct.

docs.title: Blast Compressor
docs.text: Mixes together Blast Compound, Pyratite and Coal to create a highly explosive compound, Azidoazide.

docs.title: Blast Factory
docs.text: An upgrade of the blast mixer able to produce more Blast Compound, but needs more materials to create it.

docs.title: Osmium Mixer
docs.text: Mixes in Osmium with Cryofluid to create a more effective coolant.

docs.title: Dismantler
docs.text: A massive structure that can sieve through Slag, pulling out small amounts of different resources. Can be quite useful.

docs.title: Crystaltion Core
docs.text: melts titanium, graphite and lead togther to form metallic crystalline material. Forms a bit of silicon as by-product.

docs.title: Forge of Annihilation
docs.text: An Ancient forge Thought to be built by the Solrans. This forge cannot be deconstructed after its built. Consumes large amounts of resources and power to create a powerful crystal.

docs.title: Furnace
docs.text: An upgrade of the kiln able to produce more Metaglass, but at the cost of more materials.

docs.title: Fuser Oven
docs.text: Fuses together materials with heat and electric arcs to create Oltuxium.

docs.title: Gamma Radiation Forge
docs.text: Uses extreme amounts of gamma radiation to irradiate and melt materials in to Lumianite Alloy.

docs.title: Giga-plex Sifter
docs.text: A massive separator, which sifts through large amounts of slag pulling out many materials, such as osmium, thorium, urbium and dytrix.

docs.title: Gigavolt Forge
docs.text: Uses high voltages to energize and melt materials to create more Vanstarium Steel than a normal Arc Forge.

docs.title: Hadel Furnace
docs.text: Able to produce more Alphandax Iron through extreme temperatures, but uses more materials to do so.

docs.title: Ignition Forge
docs.text: Melts materials in to Volcanite.

docs.title: Ionizer
docs.text: Ionizes materials with radiation to create Valvanite.

docs.title: Irradiation Kiln
docs.text: Uses mini gamma ray bursts to irradiate and melt materials to create Lumianite Alloy. Requires water.

docs.title: Jupiteium Furnace
docs.text: Rapidly decays Thorium and melts it together with Titanium and Silicon to form Jupiteium.

docs.title: Kiloton Forge
docs.text: uses high heat and pressure to create osmium. more heat input makes it produce faster.

docs.title: Nuclei Oven
docs.text: Induces nuclear fusion in thorium and creates titanium as by-product.

docs.title: Phase Loom
docs.text: An upgrade of the Phase Weaver able to produce more Phase Fabric but requires more materials and uses a bit of Silicon in the process.

docs.title: Plastanium Press
docs.text: An upgrade of the Plastanium Compressor thats able to produce more Plastanium, but requires more materials and some Lead.

docs.title: Nuclear Fusion Furnace
docs.text: Superheats materials to the point of fusion to create Alphandax Iron.

docs.title: Pyratite Factory
docs.text: An upgrade of the Pyratite Mixer able to produce more Pyratite at the cost of more materials.

docs.title: Ton Forge
docs.text: Melts together materials under tons of pressure to create Osmium.

docs.title: Voltirium Forge

Property Value Repository https://github.com/tnmspiroct/exoprosopa Stars 58 Last updated 2026-06-27T13:18:45Z

Exoprosopa adds Frostnova as a third planet into the game alongside with its own unique techtree and environment.

Polished content & linear campaign progression.

Capture and conquer with over 22 campaign maps.

Over 21 items to be discovered, 265 blocks to be researched. and 30 different units to build!

Harvest the planet with your technology before Astral Infection awaken and conquer the entire planet.

Thankyou for playing this mod!

You can contributes maps or gives suggestions by join Exoprosopa Discord Server!

Check it on my profile. My username is TnmSpiroct.
