docs.text: Connect non-powered blocks, useful while checking enemy bases in editor playtesting.

docs.title: Small Powerbank
docs.text: A battery capable of storing large amounts of power.

docs.title: Powerbank
docs.text: A battery capable of storing massive amounts of power.

docs.title: Power Redirector
docs.text: Moves battery power in a single direction only if the other side has less power stored.

docs.title: Burner Generator
docs.text: Burns flammable materials using elixir to generate power.

docs.title: Burner Reactor
docs.text: Burns flammable materials to generate power, requires cryogenics and chromium to function.

docs.title: Geothermal Generator
docs.text: Uses miasma and cryogenics to heat the ground and generate power.

docs.title: Exosphere Panel
docs.text: Produces small amounts of power passively.

docs.title: Tokamak Reactor
docs.text: Generates large amount of power via morphitix plasma and ichor. Explodes violently if has no sufficient fluids.

docs.title: Necroplasia Reactor
docs.text: Uses necroplasm's radioactivity to generate power and ectoplasm as a byproduct. Explode violently if ectoplasm reaches above the threshold.

docs.title: Hybrid Reactor
docs.text: Uses various fluids to diffuse pyroxene.

docs.title: Necrogenerator
docs.text: Generates power using necroplasm. Astral exclusive blocks.

docs.title: Power Nylon
docs.text: Transmits power to other blocks orthogonally. Astral exclusive blocks.

docs.title: Elixir Collector
docs.text: Extracts elixir from vents, requires power to operate.

docs.title: Elixir Extractor
docs.text: A better elixir extractor, requires power to operate.

docs.title: Ore Extractor
docs.text: Extracts ore in its direction, requires elixir and power to operate.

docs.title: Ore Blaster
docs.text: A better ore extractor, requires cryogenics to function.

docs.title: Tantrium Crusher
docs.text: Extracts tantrium from tantrium walls.

docs.title: Tantrium Extractinator
docs.text: Extracts tantrium from tantrium walls, faster than a tantrium crusher.

docs.title: Aquamarine Crusher
docs.text: Crushes down aqua walls to extract aquamarine.

docs.title: Aquamarine Extractor
docs.text: Slowly extracts aquamarine from aqua tiles, requires hydryite to operate.

docs.title: Bore Jet
docs.text: Uses a high-pressure jet of elixir to mine ground ores.

docs.title: Ichor Rig
docs.text: Slowly extracts ichor from ichor tiles, requires large amounts elixir to operate.

docs.title: Nucridscrap Crusher
docs.text: Extracts nucridscrap from nucrid walls.

docs.title: Nucridscrap Shredder
docs.text: Extracts nucridscrap from nucrid walls. Faster than a regular nucridscrap crusher. Requires elixir and power to operate.

docs.title: Discharge Bore
docs.text: Making use of the unique properties of gravitix, ichor is dissected by enormous localized gravitational fields. The resulting reaction is carefully contained and directed towards the ground where it turns much of what was there to less than dust.

docs.title: Necroplasm Extractor
docs.text: Extracts necroplasm from vents.

docs.title: Impale
docs.text: Fires a piercing compound shell.

docs.title: Anvil
docs.text: Fires five homing bullets at enemies.

docs.title: Shellcore
docs.text: Launches exploding shells towards enemies.

docs.title: Earthmover
docs.text: Slams down to generate a shockwave that slows down enemies and decrease their reload speed.

docs.title: Spewer
docs.text: Rapidly fires drops of liquid at enemies. Capable of extinguishing fires.

docs.title: Vulcan
docs.text: Shoots a laser that pushes enemies away.

docs.title: Torrefy
docs.text: Fires explosive cluster grenades that scatter into puddles of slag and inflict melting effect. Deals more damage with a direct hit.

docs.title: Influx
docs.text: Charges up and discharges electrical arcs in a cone.

docs.title: Typhoon
docs.text: Rapidly fires bolts at enemy targets.

docs.title: Deprive
docs.text: Fires barrages of bullets at enemy targets over long distances, dealing massive AoE damage.

docs.title: Equinox
docs.text: Fires volleys of charged piercing projectiles.

docs.title: Continuum
docs.text: Fires a slow-moving single-target laser at enemy targets.

docs.title: Phalanx
docs.text: Fires plasma bullets at enemy aircraft.

docs.title: Voyage
docs.text: Fires a missile over vast distance, cannot damage air units.

docs.title: Phantasm
docs.text: Rapidly blasts bullets at enemies. Specialized at dealing with single enemies, head-on. Less efficient against swarms.

docs.title: Skyhammer
docs.text: Fires explosive artillery at enemies.

docs.title: Vertex
docs.text: Launches high-energy projectiles at enemies, pierces through armored enemies.

docs.title: Havoc
docs.text: Fires barrages of grenades at enemies. Spawns baron when destroyed.

docs.title: Heavy Armored Treads
docs.text: Heavy armored treads used in tank unit production.

docs.title: Hyperspace Thruster
docs.text: High-tech thruster used in ship unit production.

docs.title: Geopowered Mechlegs
docs.text: Geothermal powered mechanical legs used in mech unit production.

docs.title: Multi Batteries
docs.text: Multi batteries used in walker unit production.

docs.title: Tankbay
docs.text: Used to produce the first tier of tanks.

docs.title: Shipbay
docs.text: Used to produce the first tier of airships.

docs.title: Mechbay
docs.text: Used to produce the first tier of mechs.

docs.title: Walkerbay
docs.text: Used to produce the first tier of walkers.

docs.title: Tankbay Upgrade Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades inputted tanks to the second tier.

docs.title: Shipbay Upgrade Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades inputted airships to the second tier.

docs.title: Mechbay Upgrade Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades inputted mechs to the second tier.

docs.title: Walkerbay Upgrade Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades inputted walkers to the second tier.

docs.title: Tank Assembly Station
docs.text: Creates advanced tanks using payloads.

docs.title: Ship Assembly Station
docs.text: Creates advanced airships using payloads.

docs.title: Mech Assembly Station
docs.text: Creates advanced mechs using payloads.

docs.title: Walker Assembly Station
docs.text: Creates advanced walkers using payloads.

docs.title: Basic Expansion Module
docs.text: Increases an assembler tier by 1 when placed next to its bounding box. Can be used as an additional payload input.

docs.title: Advanced Expansion Module
docs.text: Increases an assembler tier by 2 when placed next to its bounding box. Can be used as an additional payload input. Requires previous expansion module to be placed.

docs.title: Regenerator
docs.text: Constantly repairs all units in its range. Requires power and elixir.

docs.title: Prime Regenerator
docs.text: Constantly repairs all units in its range at faster rate. Requires ichor and power to operate.

docs.title: Large Transporter
docs.text: Transports units and blocks.

docs.title: Large Splitter
docs.text: Distributes inputted payload to up to three output directions.

docs.title: Surge Launcher
docs.text: Launches payloads to another connected surge launcher in range.

docs.title: Large Surge Launcher
docs.text: Launches payloads to another connected large surge launcher in range.

docs.title: Block Fabricator
docs.text: Crafts walls for unit assembly, requires power.

docs.title: Large Block Fabricator
docs.text: Crafts factory blocks. Requires elixir and power.

docs.title: Advanced Fabricator
docs.text: Crafts unit part for unit assembly, requires power and necroplasm.

docs.title: Material Disassembler
docs.text: Disassembles blocks and units, returns 100% of the build cost. Requires elixir and power to operate.

docs.title: Large Material Disassembler
docs.text: Disassembles large blocks and units, returns 100% of the build cost. Requires elixir and power to operate.

docs.title: Cobalt
docs.text: Used in basic construction and as ammunition.

docs.title: Nickel
docs.text: Used in basic electronics and factories.

docs.title: Anthracite
docs.text: Used in generators for burning and heating.

docs.title: Aquamarine
docs.text: Aquatic material, similar to tantrium.

docs.title: Lamine
docs.text: High-explosive material, used in heat-related blocks and explosive ammo.

docs.title: Tantrium
docs.text: Mostly used to purifying elixir, has some other uses.

docs.title: Aluminium
docs.text: Mainly used in units and electronic parts.

docs.title: Nichrome
docs.text: Fused nickel and chromium, known as nichrome. Can be separated using elemental separators.

docs.title: Chromium
docs.text: Tough and strong material used in many buildings and ammunition.

docs.title: Clevorite
docs.text: Super conductive material that is used in many advanced buildings.

docs.title: Nucridscrap
docs.text: Strong material originating from nucrid walls, can be strengthend more with petal fragments.

docs.title: Petal Fragment
docs.text: Extracted flower petal, can be processed with nucridscrap to produce bloodstone.

docs.title: Bloodstone
docs.text: High durability material used in advanced unit assembly and gravity manipulation.

docs.title: Morphite
docs.text: Crystallic, high energy material from highly accelerated low-tier material. Used in electric-based component blocks and weaponry.

docs.title: Gravitix
docs.text: Strong material used in gravity manipulation based technology and advanced component parts.

docs.title: Pyroxenes
docs.text: High-tech material used in self-healing components.

docs.title: Technoscrap
docs.text: Bunch of metal scraps, needs filtering before it is usable.

docs.title: Techno Plating
docs.text: Stores decent amount of information and data, used in logic-related blocks.

docs.title: Gryphic
docs.text: Refined cobalt, more durable thanks to the added necroplasm.

docs.title: Crystallic Geode
docs.text: Crystalline morphite, it is unknown how they form.

docs.title: Morphitix Crystal
docs.text: Another morphite form, uses accelerated crystal instead of normal material.

docs.title: Elixir
docs.text: Contaminated water mixed with biomass, can be filtered for coolant or used in factories.

docs.title: Cryogenics
docs.text: Filtered elixir, able to operate advanced factories. Can be used as turret coolant.

docs.title: Ichor
docs.text: Truly purified fluids, self-healing technology and stable regeneration.

docs.title: Necroplasm
docs.text: Biological mutated liquids, grows slowly until it gained its intelligence mutation.

docs.title: Miasma
docs.text: Uncontrollable mass of sulfuric acid, can spread into elixir.

docs.title: Hydryite
docs.text: Used in cleaning aquamarine, an elixir counterpart.

docs.title: Morphitix Plasma
docs.text: Plasma created by heating and discharging morphite.

docs.title: Ectoplasm
docs.text: A deadly liquid created from miasma, highly explosive. Can spread into elixir.

docs.title: Nucliogen
docs.text: Slimy substance, byproduct from surrounding petal flower.

docs.title: Frostnova
docs.text: The rampant, filled with dangerous natives.

docs.title: Newgrounds
docs.text:
The Mothership sent you to this sector as your first mission.

Analyze available resources and build infrastructure to protect yourself.

docs.title: Mountain Ridge
docs.text:
The only path available from sector Newgrounds.

This sector is rich in tantrium and anthracite. Research the Elixir Purifier and the Burner Generator to weather the enemies.

docs.title: Encampment
docs.text:
This sector is scarce in cobalt and anthracite deposits in the walls. Bore Jets are required to mine ores from the ground.

The enemy has built a small outpost here with lots of defence. Mech and Walker units will be required to increase your offensive ability.

docs.title: Cliffside
docs.text:
This sector contains deposits of chromium. Use Bore Jet to mine it from the ground.

The enemy will send one of their elites to protect this sector.

docs.title: Crest
docs.text:
This sector is very rough and cramped. Mech units are the only choice to take down the enemy base here.

Push them back in the limited space provided. Claim this sector for yourself.

docs.title: Botanical Garden
docs.text:
This sector contains large deposits of chromium on the opposite side of the island. Perfect to test out new transport tech.

Research Surge Driver and Shipbay Upgrade Chamber to capture the enemy outpost nearby.

docs.title: Escarpment
docs.text:
An important transportation route between outposts used by Rhodes. To make up for the lack of tantrium in the area, research the Tantraformer to create tantrium as the replacement.

Rhodes does not take kindly to you being here and will do their utmost to stop you.

docs.title: Cornerstone
docs.text:
You land on a sector filled with mountainous terrain. The enemy base is hidden deep within. Tier two units may prove necessary to take down their fortifications.

Research the Tankbay Upgrade Chamber and the Walker Upgrade Chamber.

docs.title: Hazardous Wasteland
docs.text:
Rich in miasma but starved of anthracite, this sector is very treacherous. Build Geothermal Generator to generate power.

The enemy has built a strong base with advanced tech in this sector. Capture this sector and acquire the technology.

docs.title: Precipice
docs.text:
A jagged, fractured canyon formerly used as Mech Testing Grounds by Rhodes. The unsupported terrain makes it very hard to build and operate a base.

Utilize Surge Launcher for transporting resources across the winding terrain. Be prepared for attacks from multiple directions.

docs.title: Creek
docs.text:
A ravine carved by flowing hydryite and rich aquamarine deposits. Research the Aquamarine Filter and the Elemental Separator as an alternative ways to produce basic materials.

Our radar detected several Rhodes activity in this sector. Do not give them time to send their strongest units.

docs.title: Marshlands
docs.text:
This sector is very large and rich in resources, but will be attacked by the enemy once a new core lands.

Utilizes morphite for further colonization. Rhodes will send a large punitive force in order to stop your conquest.

docs.title: Pier
docs.text:
This sector was used by Gowa Industries long ago, it has been claimed by Rhodes over the course of countless wars. The pier and its facility became abandoned and decayed.

Astral naval units have been sighted on the radar, no further data available. It might be stronger than normal units.

Unidentified aircraft detected.

Utilize morphitix plasma to create even stronger defences. Use your best strategy against them.

docs.title: Bioproject Core
docs.text:
An abandoned research facility, toxic and unhabitable. Vent is scarce and separated across several islands, analyze the remaining tech to survive.

Utilize Miasma Filtration Unit as an alternative solution. Additionally, research Cargo Bay as a main drone-based transportation.

Landing area is unstable, disallowed additional starting blocks.

docs.title: Eridanus
docs.text:
A zigzag pattern, forces enemy units to take a very long path take out your base in this sector. Dont be fooled by its large wave spacing, Rhodes will send their units faster the more you progress.

Produce gravitix. Fend off the enemy.

WIP

docs.title: Luminary
docs.text:
Due to lack of vents, you will need a better source of power. It might be a good idea to have air defence around the edges.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Foggy Fields
docs.text:
Due to a great number of vents present, the sector has occasional foggy episodes. The enemy has built a giant base here. It is recommended to bring large amounts firepower.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Abandoned Reservoir
docs.text:
You land in a cramped sector filled with miasma. The sensor detects an enemy base in this sector.

Unfortunately, you must build your production and defence between a lake and distorted environment. Use ship units to dismantle the enemy base before the enemy dismantles you.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Trekker Campsite
docs.text:
This is the campsite of the mountain trekker, controlled by Rhodes. Use various units to eliminate all enemy cores.

Intel suggests the enemy has nuclear weapons of some form, stay alert for a potential strike!

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Ridgeline
docs.text:
Rhodes have built a heavily guarded stronghold here. It remains undefeated for years. Your goal is to find any exploit and all weaknesses in order to make it fall.

Modifiers: - Terraformic Basin, Terrafilter & Nichrome Dissembler are unavailable.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Clover Springs
docs.text:
Hotspring occupied by the Rhodes Facility. The lakes generates at the central area, creating almost perfect four clover leafes with several twists.

You will land on a pre-built base from another agent. Advance to the crater and eliminate all enemy cores.

WIP

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Myrra Heights
docs.text:
The highest mountain range in frostnova. A home to the Rhodes mightiest operation known. The enemy have been constructing an experimental gravitix warhead.

BEWARE OF POTENTIAL STRIKE.

We will attempt to sent units to aid your endevors of conquest, by contacting Signal Transmission Station. The enemy values this sector with all of their might. So expect large amounts of resistance and strife in a myriad of ways.

WIP

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Ending
docs.text: Are we reaching The.. End.. ??

docs.title: Breached
docs.text: Whenever a unit gets breached, its health gets slowly drained.

docs.title: Immunity
docs.text: Increases unit health and movement speed, but decreases the damage output.

docs.title: Discharge Overload
docs.text: Whenever a unit gets discharge overload, its health drains very fast.

docs.title: Boosted
docs.text: Increases movement speed and firerate.

docs.title: Overboosted
docs.text: Increases movement speed and firerate significantly.

docs.title: Contaminated
docs.text: Whenever a unit gets contaminated, its health gets slowly drained and gains increased attack speed.

docs.title: Ground Shock
docs.text: Shocks enemies and drains unit health slowly.

docs.title: Stunned
docs.text: Disarm and stuns units in place.

docs.title: Doom
docs.text: Slows units and slowly damaging them.

docs.title: Rogue
docs.text: Protects the Apex Core, can build and retrieve resources. Can heal allied structures.

docs.title: Pioneer
docs.text: Protects the Empower Core, can build and retrieve resources. Can heal blocks.

docs.title: Trailblaze
docs.text: Protects the Apeirogon Core, can build and retrieve resources. Can heal blocks very fast.

docs.title: Suzuran
docs.text: Used for insta-healing blocks and scouting, sandbox only.

docs.title: Huntress
docs.text: Fifth generation of helicopter tech. Equipped with mounted missile and machinegun.

docs.title: Strike
docs.text: Fires pairs of plasma bolts at enemy targets.

docs.title: Skyblade
docs.text: Charges and fires high damage piercing plasma orb over long distances. Has dual laser canons attached on the sides and a shield in the front.

docs.title: Archangel
docs.text: Fires a long-range piercing round. Equipped with dual suppression missiles launcher.

docs.title: Beth
docs.text: Protects the Astral core, can mine and build. Astral exclusive units.

docs.title: Coronis
docs.text: Protects the Crest Core, can build and retrieve resources faster. Can attack enemy units.

docs.title: Sepia
docs.text: Protects the Boundless Core, can build and retrieve resources faster. Can attack enemy units.

docs.title: Locust
docs.text: Protects the Ultimatum Core, can build and retrieve resources faster. Equipped with additional mount weapon.

docs.title: Honsha
docs.text: Third generation of tank tech. Equipped with mounted missile and piercing gun.

docs.title: Craig
docs.text: Launches artillery shells at enemy ground targets.

docs.title: Bastion
docs.text: Fires piercing bullets at enemy targets.

docs.title: Bulwark
docs.text: Fires cluster bombs over large distances.

docs.title: Fortis
docs.text: Fires cluster shells that creating caustic lava puddles upon impact at enemy ground targets.

docs.title: Rancor
docs.text: Fires powerful cluster shells and piercing bullet at enemy targets.

docs.title: Baron
docs.text: Torches enemy targets with a short range laser. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Tribune
docs.text: Fires missiles from a twin missile launcher. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Archon
docs.text: Fires barrages of missiles at enemy targets. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Emperor
docs.text: Fires a piercing bolt at enemy targets. Will dash every second shot. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Monarch
docs.text: Fires piercing shrapnel at multiple enemies in range. Has mounted seeking missiles suited for medium range and lower. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Spark
docs.text: Fires electric arcs at enemies, able to float over bodies of liquid.

docs.title: Sora
docs.text: Fires short electric beams at enemies, able to float over bodies of liquid.

docs.title: Byte
docs.text: Fires electric bullets at enemies. Protects itself with a directional shield.

docs.title: Syntax
docs.text: Fires electric orbs that inflict a stunned effect at enemies. Protects itself with a directional shield.

docs.title: Decode
docs.text: Fires piercing laser that inflict a stunned effect at enemies. Protects itself with a directional shield.

docs.title: Matrix
docs.text: Fires pulsing bullets that inflict a stunned effect at enemies. Creates strong energy shields to nearby units. Damages nearby units when destroyed.

docs.title: Program
docs.text: Fires impaling bullets that explodes upon contact. Equipped with point-defense turret. Capable to self regenerate. Damages nearby units when destroyed.

docs.title: Blastum
docs.text: Explode violently damaging enemies in area.

docs.title: Scorcher
docs.text: Fires flames at enemies.

docs.title: Bulbhead
docs.text: Fires exploding bullet at enemies. Astral exclusive unit.

docs.title: Hammerhead
docs.text: Fires missile at enemies. Astral exclusive unit.

docs.title: Narhwal
docs.text: Fires electric bullets at enemies. Astral exclusive unit.

docs.title: Freesia
docs.text: Fires multiple exploding bullet at enemies, can also heal allied units. Astral exclusive unit.

docs.title: Large Cryofluid Mixer
docs.text: Mixes water and fine titanium powder with higher efficiency to produce cryofluid.

docs.title: Detonation Mixer
docs.text: Mixes pyratite and blast compound into detonation compound. Requires logic alloy to control the explosion.

docs.title: Metaglass Plater
docs.text: Plates glass with lead into metaglass.

docs.title: Mirrorglass Polisher
docs.text: Polishes metaglass into mirrorglass.

docs.title: Electrothermal Silicon Furnace
docs.text: Refines silicon from sand. Requires massive amounts of power.

docs.title: Conductor Former
docs.text: Forms copper and silicon into conductor.

docs.title: Electromagnetism Diffuser
docs.text: Diffuses electromagnetism from magnetic alloy onto flamefluid crystal, forming surge alloy.

docs.title: Flesh Synthesizer
docs.text: Synthesizes flesh from plastanium, phase fabric and spore pod.

docs.title: Slag Cooler
docs.text: Produces flamefluid crystal by cooling a large amount of slag.

docs.title: Hardened Alloy Crucible
docs.text:
Fuses thorium, plastanium into hardened alloy. Requires really-massive amounts of power to create high-temperature conditions. Will explode violently if there's another crucible producing nearby, or destroyed while producing.

"More efficient, more dangerous... More deadly."

docs.title: Hardened Alloy Smelter
docs.text: Fuses thorium, plastanium and kindling alloy into hardened alloy.

docs.title: Kindling Extractor
docs.text: Extracts sulflame alloy into pure kindling alloy.

docs.title: Sulflame Extractor
docs.text: Extracts combustible from coal and spore pods, and mixes it with slag into sulflame alloy.

docs.title: Logic Alloy Processor
docs.text: Processes copper, silicon and titanium into logic alloy.

docs.title: Magnetic Alloy Former
docs.text: Forms surge alloy, conductor and hardened alloy into magnetic alloy.

docs.title: Magnetic Ring Synthesizer
docs.text: Utilizes the strong magnetic field generated by the magnetic ring to synthesize thorium and sand with higher efficiency into phase fabric.

docs.title: Magnetism-Concentrated Rolling Mill
docs.text: Utilizes the magnetic field generated by magnetic alloy, applying an electric field force to microscopic oil particles and compress them into titanium with higher efficiency to produce plastanium.

docs.title: Melting Furnace
docs.text: Consumes massive power to generate heat, melting down input materials into slag. Open-top design allows partial combustion of flammable materials due to extreme temperatures.

docs.title: Thermal Kiln
docs.text: Smelts sand and coal into glass. More efficient in hot locations.

docs.title: Timber Burner
docs.text: Burns timber into coal and generates power.

docs.title: Crusher
docs.text: Crushes copper and lead into scrap. Used in locations with no surface scrap available.

docs.title: Liquid Nitrogen Compressor
docs.text: Collects nitrogen in atmospheric. Uses blast compound and kindling alloy to create high-pressure conditions, with a large amount of cryofluid as coolant to compress nitrogen into liquid nitrogen.

docs.title: Large Hardened Wall
docs.text:
Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Absorbs lasers and electric arcs. Blocks automatic power connections. Can be placed on liquids.

Reconstructs itself depending on the degree of damage, further improving the ability to withstand pressure.

docs.title: Hardened Wall
docs.text:
Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Absorbs lasers and electric arcs. Blocks automatic power connections. Can be placed on liquids.

Reconstructs itself depending on the degree of damage, further improving the ability to withstand pressure.

docs.title: Dam Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Can only be placed on water.

docs.title: Large Dam Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Can only be placed on water.

docs.title: Flesh Wall
docs.text:
Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Reflects most bullets upon impact, meanwhile repairs itself depending on bullet damage.

Has the ability to repair itself. Optionally uses water to boost efficiency; transfers water input to nearby blocks of the same type.

docs.title: Adaptive Source
docs.text: Automatically fills nearby necessary buildings and infinitely outputs power and heat. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Composite Bridge Conveyor
docs.text: Instantly transports items over terrain or buildings. Longer range than the item bridge.

docs.title: Composite Router
docs.text:
Instantly distributes input items to 3 output directions, however max consecution is limited. Distributes randomly in singleplayer games, however in order to avoid synchronization issues, equal distribution is used instead in multiplayer games.

Support linkage operations with Logic Processor. When controlled by the instruction "Control-config", allows directional distribution with specific values: 0 -> Right 1 -> Up 2 -> Left 3 -> Down

docs.title: Composite Unloader
docs.text: Unloads the selected item from the block behind it. Unload speed will hardly be affected by low FPS.

docs.title: Composite Conveyor
docs.text: Transports items forward. Faster than a titanium conveyor.

docs.title: Hardened Alloy Conveyor
docs.text: Transports items forward in batches. Accepts items at the back, and unloads them in three directions at the front. Requires multiple loading and unloading points for peak throughput. Faster than a plastanium conveyor.

docs.title: Melted Sand
docs.text: A kind of glass melted from sand.

docs.title: Building Healer
docs.text: Slowly repairs allied structures in a square perimeter. Optionally uses silicon to boost efficiency.

docs.title: Campfire
docs.text: Uses lots of flammable materials to ignite campfire, increases the speed of nearby buildings. Inspire allied unit and sap enemy unit nearby.

docs.title: Javelin Pad
docs.text: Provides transformation into a quick, lightly-armored interceptor. Consumes power when using.

docs.title: Build Indicator
docs.text: Automatically rebuilds structures and assists other units in construction in range.

docs.title: Numb Delusion
docs.text:
Stores a large amount of items of each type. Expands storage when placed next to a core. Contents can be retrieved with an unloader.

A by-product of Fire Company's research on "timelines". By paying a certain cost, it can revive structures based on their "Concept", while compressing excess matter into the current timeline as bullets against enemies. However, reviving structures with complex "Concept" can cause severe temporal disturbances, resulting in spawning bullets that attacks indiscriminately.

Warning: NEVER attempt to revive any living beings! The previous trial annihilated the entire spatial sector of Struct Planet. The area remains a massless void to this day-anything entering it vanishes for reasons unknown.

docs.title: Primary Interplanetary Accelerator
docs.text:
Primary electromagnetic railgun tower. Accelerates primary cores to the Planet Faraway to escape velocity for interplanetary deployment.

Used to unlock the Planet Lysetta faraway, beginning your journey of Mod Fire.

docs.title: Sky Dome
docs.text: Creates a hexagonal force field around itself, protecting buildings and units inside from damage. More practical than a force projector.

docs.title: Core: Bulwark
docs.text: Core of the base. Exceedingly well armored. Stores less resources than a Nucleus. Creates a hexagonal force field around itself, protecting buildings and units inside from damage.

docs.title: Composite Bridge Conduit
docs.text: Transports liquids over terrain or buildings. Longer range than the bridge conduit.

docs.title: Composite Liquid Router
docs.text: Accepts liquids from one direction and outputs them to up to 3 other directions equally. Can also store a sizeable amount of liquid.

docs.title: Hardened Liquid Tank
docs.text: Stores excess amount of liquid. Outputs to all sides, similarly to a liquid router. Possessing considerable resistance to external pressure impacts.

docs.title: Liquid Unloader
docs.text: Let the selected liquid which is in the nearby buildings in an average level. Unknowingly, sometimes it doesn't work to the Plated Conduit.

docs.title: Magnetic Ring Pump
docs.text: Pumps and outputs liquids in a much greater efficiency. Requires power.

docs.title: Burst Reactor
docs.text:
Uses detonations to produce massive amounts of power. Needs liquid nitrogen for coolant. The detonations contained in it is not funny, so you must make perparations to repair it in time...

The top technology in magnetic. While running, it will produce much power according to the power consumed by the surrounding devices. However, it will produce less power when damaged. Randomly spawns a wave of magnetic after completely starts, which will not only increase its power production but also damage itself. It won't spawn the wave when in low health.

docs.title: Large Hydroelectric Generator
docs.text: Utilizes water flow to impact fan blades and generate power. The faster the water flow velocity, the greater the power generation.

docs.title: Hydroelectric Generator
docs.text: Utilizes water flow to impact fan blades and generate power. The faster the water flow velocity, the greater the power generation.

docs.title: Flame Generator

docs.title: Conductor Power Node
docs.text: A long-range power node with fewer available connections than large power node. Can store an amount of power.

docs.title: Constraint Extractor
docs.text: Focuses a beam for long-distance mineral mining. Requires power. Due to the large amount of heat generated while working, mining can only be carried out at a lower speed. Needs to configure desired mineral manually, and the extractor will automatically search for and mine the nearest target. Optionally uses cryofluid to boost efficiency.

docs.title: Chopper
docs.text: When placed facing a tree, chops and outputs timber indefinitely.

docs.title: Focusing Extractor
docs.text: Focuses a beam for long-distance mineral mining. Requires an amount of power. Equipped with more focusing devices and improved heat dissipation structure, allowing for further increase in extraction speed. Optionally uses liquid nitrogen to boost efficiency.

docs.title: Fission Drill
docs.text: Uses a large amount of thorium to lead to fissions, leading ores escape from its position. (I'm kidding)

docs.title: Tree Farm
docs.text: Breeds trees with water, and processes it into timber.

docs.title: Vapour Condenser
docs.text: Collects a large amount of water vapor in the atmosphere, and condenses it into water. Require large amounts of power.

docs.title: Stacked Cultivator
docs.text: Extracts nearby tainted water sources through the built-in water extractor, directly outputting spore pods after further cultivation. Outputs surplus water while meeting its own cultivation needs.

docs.title: Biomass Cultivator
docs.text: Collects tiny concentrations of atmospheric spores, and cultivates them into spore pods with advanced technology. More efficient than cultivator.

docs.title: Aerolite

docs.title: Blossom

docs.title: Cumulonimbus

Fires powerful energetic bullets. The bullet will be stronger if turret keeps shooting.

"It resonates with otherworldly energy."

docs.title: Ignition

docs.title: Fulmination

docs.title: Gambler

"It resonates with otherworldly energy."

docs.title: Grudge

docs.title: Smasher

docs.title: Magnetic Domain

docs.title: Magnetic Rail

docs.title: Magnetic Sphere
docs.text:
Fires a charged, decelerated sphere at aerial enemy targets. The sphere will detect whether there's a target nearby and release directional lightning attacking target. The sphere will select and chase a target nearby if it comes to the end.

"It resonates with otherworldly energy."

docs.title: Obstruction

Fires energetic balls, destroying nearby bullets and damaging gathered units.

"It resonates with otherworldly energy."

docs.title: Distance

docs.title: Scab
docs.text: Fires homing flesh bullets at enemy targets.

docs.title: Nightmare
docs.text: Fires overpowered pierce beams at enemy targets rapidly.

docs.title: Flesh Reconstructor

docs.title: Fractal Unit Factory

docs.title: Conductor

docs.text: Used in highly-durable structures.

docs.text: Slag, but frozen and able to ignite.

docs.title: Lysetta
docs.text:
A planet with intricate connections to Serpulo, while possessing more advanced technology than it. Unfortunately, a certain force has already taken the lead.

More campaign maps will be available in the future.

docs.title: Branched Rivers
docs.text:
A section of the Eteriver. River there branches into multiple tributaries, providing rapid access to surrounding sectors. However, the turbulent currents here appear to have swept away most mineral deposits, and the crisscrossing waterways grant enemy naval forces exceptional mobility, making the region strategically vulnerable. A covert base along the riverbank had been established. Detectors have scanned unidentified type of liquid pumps and tanks nearby. While enemy forces are unlikely to arrive imminently, if the base is detected, they could swiftly deploy via the river to besiege us.

Secure the area to research advanced water extraction, purification, and storage technology. Establish a forward operating base for expanded territorial control.

docs.title: Spore Fiord
docs.text:
After Darksand Peak-forest, this sector was detected. An amount of enemy force has been already stationed here. The detection signs indicate that there was already some kind of force trying to confront the enemy before out arrival, but they failed. Eradicate enemies, capture the sector and research advanced material processing technology and primary spore cultivation technology.

Enemies will begin their attack in a short time, build up defenses as soon as possible.

docs.title: Desert Wastes
docs.text:
Desert's central zone. Numerous factories were once built here, but few remain. Resources are scarce, yet wastes are vast, and criss-crossed with derelict sector structures.

Enemies have seized the initiative, establishing small-scale material processing facilities. Main forces haven't yet reached this remote site - defenses remain lax. HQ will dispatch reinforcements to clear the area. Stay vigilant against enemy reserves, destroy their main forces, and research advanced material processing tech.

docs.title: Frozen Wall
docs.text: This sector is a canyon. The high mountains on both sides stretch out, eventually enclosing the sector ahead. Radar cannot penetrate these mountains to scan the sector ahead,which has caught our attention.This is the only route to that sector. The enemy has built massive defenses here, seemingly to guard against something coming from ahead.Regardless, we must thwart all the enemy's schemes. Moreover, the enemy here is using two new turrets, so we must capture this place.

docs.title: Glaciated Peaks
docs.text:
Breaking through the blockade north of the enemy in Dark Workshop, HQ dispatched a large number of detectors to confirm whether there were any enemy forces continuing to advance. One of the detectors went missing while passing through the area, and the last image it transmitted was of an electromagnetic razorblade tearing it in half.

The enemy has established a large base on the peaks, take it down. HQ will constantly dispatch reinforcements.

docs.title: Dark Workshop
docs.text: Further inland lies the enemy factories. There seems to be abandoned, but still has enemy units and installations. There also contains lots of production facilities. Capture enemy cores, leave nothing standing, research their tech. Allied units are strengthened, try using units to attack.

docs.title: Eteriver Stronghold
docs.text:
One of many parts of Eteriver. Tt is detected that enemy has used a kind of new turret that we have never seen. Capture the area to clear the threats around the Darksand Peak-forest, and research the new turret.

Detection radar indicates that an unknown large unit skulks there, build high-tier turrets to defend enemy's sudden attack.

docs.title: Darksand Peak-forest
docs.text:
Having broken through the outpost base, we arrived at this area of peak forests. The mineral resources here are relatively abundant, with a large number of thermal resources waiting to be developed. However, the bad news is that an enemy force has stationed on the other side of the river, enabling them to quickly launch counterattack measures.

Utilize the existing technology and resources to annihilate the enemies, occupy here and develop as much as possible.

docs.title: Beach Landing
docs.text:
After occupying the Frozen Ground, several construction ships were dispatched, which drifted here along the river. The enemies here possess knowledge of timber processing technology and hydroelectric generation technology. Destroy the enemy base, attempt to research their technologies, and use this place as a springboard to advance into the Antarctic region.

We have also detected several unknown types of turrets. However, due to the lack of materials, we are unable to conduct research on them.

docs.title: Landing Base
docs.text: Shortly after capturing the planetary launch terminal, the near-serpulo satellite received an unknown hostile signal. After investigation, it was found that the signal was transmitted from this distant planet. After multiple scans, this location was selected as the landing point. Destroy the base, capture the sector.

docs.title: Lava Stronghold
docs.text:
Having disintegrated the enemy forces in Scorching Volcano, it's time to deal a counter-blow to the North Pole. Enemy forces have built a complete defence and coupled the high temperature. Large allied units were unable to be delivered here, making the stronghold hard to capture.

However, remember the blue, light strike ships in Desolate Fortification? They were actually the elite units seized by allied forces in the latest attack here. Anyway, flying detector has found the equipment used to summon these strike ships here.

Allied forces have established a base here. Take over the base, leave nothing standing, research their tech.

docs.title: Chilly Mountains
docs.text:
The lifeless mountains. Records show here contains the tech of a brand-new, efficient generator.

Here stands reinforced enemy forces, don't be fooled by the long spacing between enemy attacks.

docs.title: Frozen Ground
docs.text:
After eliminating the threat in the Darksand Peak-forest, an old workshop site was detected. It is suspected to have been a private workshop belonging to the original inhabitants of this planet, but was later abandoned due to the area's barrenness. The returning detector brought us the news we were looking for: there is a new type of factory ruin here that we have never seen before, but it is also occupied by enemies that pose a deadly threat to the research team.

Occupy this site and provide more advanced factories for logistical support.

docs.title: Rubble Ridge
docs.text:
Amidst the mountain ranges, we discovered the remnants of a concealed factory complex. Despite the severely depleted mineral resources in this area, the scale of the ruins is unexpectedly vast, raising significant suspicion. Our analysis suggests two hypotheses: 1. The site may have once been resource-rich, but geological shifts buried the mineral veins beneath the mountains. However, the structural coherence of the ruins contradicts this theory, as the materials’ durability would not withstand such cataclysmic changes. 2. The site likely employed a brand-new extraction facility capable of bypassing conventional mining limitations. Preliminary scans strongly support the second hypothesis. Capture this sector and research the extraction facility.

Note that the region’s unique topography is dominated by an anomalous electromagnetic cloud. Any attempt to deploy overmass cores (e.g. Core: Nucleus, Core: Bulwark) will trigger immediate detonation when making landing. Reinforcements cannot be dispatched either.

docs.title: Stormy Coast
docs.text:
Following a tributary of the Eteriver, we arrived in this coastal area where the detector indicated a small enemy force stationed nearby. After a fierce battle, this is now the last remaining stronghold.

However, the enemy's reinforcements far exceeded our estimates, with the radar map showing a large enemy force swarming towards the area, including elite force. Additionally, through the images transmitted back by the detector from behind enemy lines, we discovered it appears to be a spore contamination source, where the enemy has established a small flesh research facility.

Regardless, repelling enemy's attack and capture this sector, research th e preliminary tech of Flesh, and gain an advantage for future maritime operations.

The weather may be quite severe, please take necessary preparations.

docs.title: Tainted Estuary
docs.text: Having captured Branched Rivers, HQ had continuously deployed detectors to survey upstream conditions, with this estuary area being one of the results. Blanketed with spores, this sector proves ideal for mycological research. Regrettably, enemy forces have already established a stronghold here, fortifying the area with exceptionally high defensive measures. Previous detector deployments have alerted the enemy, leaving us limited operational time. Employ the technology researched from Branched Rivers to completely eradicate all their cores and attain critical information regarding Flesh-about technology. HQ will transmit relevant technical data shortly after landing - ensure to take research promptly. Be advised that enemy forces periodically activate Javelin pads to summon strike ship reinforcements. Maintain constant anti-air readiness to counter these aerial threats.

docs.title: Desolate Fortification
docs.text: After Dark Workshop, allied forces were sent to develop the sectors nearby. This sector seems to have been developed by enemy. As a consequence, this sector was taken over quickly. But now, it has been detected that enemy forces are approaching here. Fend off the enemies and capture this sector. The original frontline will be soon destructed after ~10 waves, build up defense made up of missile turret "Distance" asap.

docs.title: Scorching Volcano
docs.text:
As we went deeper into the North Pole, the volcanic zone in this area was located, which is one of the most violent plates in Lysetta. "A pure hell..."This is what flying detector showed on its screen after returning from there.

Pay attention to repairing buildings damaged by the earthquake in time, and defend the large number of troops sent by enemy.

Extremely shielded, the force shield reflects most bullets upon impact, and releases lightning if overheated, additionally absorbs bullets nearby for a short time to deal counter-attack. Can step over most terrain.

docs.title: Pluto
docs.text: Shoots electrical bullets and powerful bombs.Also carries a pair of point defence turrets. It has a special shield, which can boost the unit a lot when it's in good shape, but can also weaken the unit when destroyed.

docs.text: A heavy self-destruct unit, fire a small sun upon destroyed. That small sun can burn the unit around, and finally it'll explode to give the enemies nearby a critical damage. It has a special shield, which can boost the unit a lot when it's in good shape, but can also weaken the unit when destroyed.

docs.text: Basic ground supporting unit. Shielded. Can step over most terrain.

docs.title: Garrison
docs.text: Enhanced ground supporting unit. Overdrives allied units. Targets enemy projectiles with two point defense turrets. Well shielded. Can step over most terrain.

docs.text: Fires a massive laser blast that damages enemy targets and repairs allied structures, spliting into large piercing cascades of bullets. Constructs cyerce units.

Property Value Repository https://github.com/coaldeficit/moredefences Stars 38 Last updated 2026-06-10T16:22:02Z

A mod made by CD, meowkitty and 7rodo that overhauls the campaign, significantly modifying Serpulo's campaign and adding a new planet, Fieros.

Amidst the features in this mod are:

  • 18 New Turrets to defend with

  • 21 New Units to attack with

  • 16 New campaign Sectors to play on, including 2 Remakes of vanilla sectors

  • Post-Surge Alloy-tier content for Serpulo

  • 12 New Miscellaneous blocks to mess around with on Serpulo

⚠ This mod moves Serpulo sectors around without moving their saves, backup your game data in [ SETTINGS > GAME DATA ] before enabling/disabling this mod to prevent campaign corruption if you have any campaign saves. ⚠

Discord: https://discord.gg/9YHA3q8HHq

Please note that the Serpulo research tree has

been moved into it's own tree because it was

too large.

To get to the Fading Revelations Serpulo

research tree, please switch to it the same way

you would switch between the Erekir and Serpulo

research trees.

On that menu, a new button will be available

that takes you to the Fading Revelations

Serpulo research tree.

Features

Two new planets and many blocks,

units, items, liquids, schematics

& ammo types.

Languages

  • English

  • German

  • Spanish (WIP)

  • Ukrainian (WIP)

  • Russian

Check Discord / GitHub

for more information!

docs.text: A sedimentation of living steel. Can be mined but beware as it damages units walking over it and slows them.
