docs.title: Acid
docs.text: A puddle of acid liquid. Beware!

docs.title: Tiny Mass Driver
docs.text: Short range item transport structure. Collects small batches of items and shoots them to other tiny mass drivers.

docs.title: Titanium Bridge Conveyor
docs.text: Transports items over terrain or buildings. Faster than the regular bridge conveyor.

docs.title: Titanium Distributor
docs.text: Distributes input items to 7 output directions equally. Faster than the regular distributor.

docs.title: Titanium Junction
docs.text: Acts as a bridge for two crossing titanium conveyor belts.

docs.title: Titanium Router
docs.text: Distributes items to 3 output directions equally. Faster than the regular router.

docs.title: Blast Compound Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for blast compound.

docs.title: Advanced Launch Pad
docs.text: Uses technology infused with living steel to launch items faster than the regular launch pad. Can be boosted by using water

docs.title: Coal Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for coal.

docs.title: Construction Pylon
docs.text: Automatically builds and destroys structures and supports the player.

docs.title: Core: Atom
docs.text: Core of the base. Very well armored and stores a good amount of resources.

docs.title: Core: Element
docs.text: Core of the base. Extremely well armored and stores a huge amount of resources.

docs.title: Dark Mender
docs.text: Heals nearby blocks in great amounts but needs a constant supply of living steel to do so .

docs.title: Depository
docs.text: Stores a gigantic amount of items of each type, akin to a vault. Expands storage when placed next to a core. Contents can be retrieved with an unloader.

docs.title: Repair Dome
docs.text: Heals nearby blocks rapidly.

docs.title: Advanced Unloader
docs.text: An unloader that unloads items way faster than the normal one and can also buffer some items.

docs.title: Force Dome
docs.text: A better Force Projector with more range and shield health. Cannot be boosted with Phase Fabric.

docs.title: Copper Exchange Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges copper for gold.

docs.title: Thorium Exchange Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges thorium for gold.

docs.title: Titanium Exchange Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges titanium for gold.

docs.title: Graphite Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for graphite.

docs.title: Lead Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for lead.

docs.title: Main Core
docs.text: Core of the base. Unbelievably well armored and stores vast amounts of resources. Isn't defended by a unit but can instead build, mine and defend itself.

docs.title: Metaglass Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for metaglass.

docs.title: Tiny Overdrive Projector
docs.text: A tiny overdrive projector. Makes everything in its range faster but be aware that it also increases energy consumption!

docs.title: Outpost
docs.text: An outpost that can be built anywhere on the map and transfers all items that are inputted directly to the main core.

docs.title: Phase Fabric Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for phase fabric.

docs.title: Plastanium Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for plastanium.

docs.title: Pyratite Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for pyratite.

docs.title: Sand Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for sand.

docs.title: Silicon Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for silicon.

docs.title: Spore Pod Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for spore pods.

docs.title: Surge Alloy Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for surge alloy.

docs.title: Isolated Conduit
docs.text: A decently fast conduit made from plastanium.

docs.title: Steel Pump
docs.text: A pump made using living steel that uses power to pump great amounts of liquid.

docs.title: Steel Tank
docs.text: A liquid tank made from living steel that has more capacity than a regular liquid tank but the same size.

docs.title: Advanced Solar Panel
docs.text: A better solar panel that takes up the same amount of space as a regular one.

docs.title: Advanced Surge Tower
docs.text: A power node with a lot of range but a max of 2 connections. A better surge tower.

docs.title: Living Steel Thermal Generator
docs.text: Produces heat in hot locations using intelligent spore steel activity. Is more efficient than the normal thermal generator.

docs.title: Power Reserve
docs.text: A HUGE battery capable of storing vast amounts of power.

docs.title: Pyratite Generator
docs.text: Uses the high flammability of pyratite to make a decent amount of power.

docs.title: Reinforced Large Power Node
docs.text: A large power node reinforced using titanium. Is a lot more durable than a regular beam node while also maintaining slightly more range.

docs.title: Reinforced Power Node
docs.text: A power node reinforced using titanium. Is a lot more durable than a regular beam node while also maintaining slightly more range.

docs.title: Slag Generator
docs.text: A generator that uses the heat of Slag to make power.

docs.title: Slag Reactor
docs.text: A reactor that uses the heat of Slag to make power.

docs.title: Solar Array
docs.text: A solar panel with a large surface area, enabling a high energy output.

docs.title: Steam Turbine
docs.text: A better version of the Steam Turbine built using Living Steel. Uses more water in exchange for greatly improved power output. Slowly produces steam and builds up pressure. Explodes when the pressure reaches a critical point.

docs.title: Amalgam Generator
docs.text: Uses the high flammability of Steel Amalgam to create large amounts of power from it.

docs.title: Tiny Thermal Generator
docs.text: Produces power in hot locations.

docs.title: Titanium Solar Panel
docs.text: A better solar panel made with titanium. Produces more power than a regular solar panel.

docs.title: Turbine Concentrator
docs.text: Similar to a Turbine Condenser but creates larger amounts of power and more water.

docs.title: Nuclear Reactor
docs.text: A reactor that uses uraniumrods to create a lot of power. Explodes violently when it is not cooled extensively!

docs.title: Advanced Water Extractor
docs.text: Extracts large quantities of groundwater. Used in locations with no surface water available..

docs.title: Cliff Grinder
docs.text: A faster Cliff Crusher.

docs.title: Cliff Miller
docs.text: A faster Cliff Grinder.

docs.title: Compact Laser Drill
docs.text: Allows small-scale drilling via laser technology, but requires power. Capable of mining thorium.

docs.title: Greenhouse
docs.text: A better cultivator that creates a lot more spore pods.

docs.title: Ground Crusher
docs.text: Quickly grinds up the ground it sits on to produce sand. Requires large quantities of power.

docs.title: Ground Grinder
docs.text: Slowly grinds up the ground it sits on to produce sand. Requires power.

docs.title: Ground Miller
docs.text: Grinds up the ground it sits on to produce sand. Requires a hefty amount of power.

docs.title: Hyper Drill
docs.text: The magnum opus of drill technology. Incapable of mining sand, but mines other ores at massive rates, consuming cryofluid in the process.

docs.title: Mechanical Sieve
docs.text: Slowly filters gold out of water.

docs.title: Oil Bore
docs.text: A better oil extractor that runs more efficiently.

docs.title: Pneumatic Sieve
docs.text: Filters gold out of water.

docs.title: Steel Sieve
docs.text: The largest sieve. Rapidly filters gold out of water.

docs.title: Tiny Mechanical Drill
docs.text: A tiny version of the mechanical drill.

docs.title: Tiny Plasma Bore
docs.text: A small version of the Plasma Bore.

docs.title: Tiny Pneumatic Drill
docs.text: A tiny version of the pneumatic drill.

docs.title: Titanium Drill
docs.text: A cheap drill for everything.

docs.title: Titanium Sieve
docs.text: Swiftly filters gold out of water.

docs.title: Tungsten Bore
docs.text: A Plasma Bore made from Tungsten. Has more range than a normal Plasma Bore.

docs.title: Vent Concentrator
docs.text: A better Vent Condensator that creates more water.

docs.title: Absole
docs.text: Inflicts a high energy burn upon enemies via a highly concentrated laser.

docs.title: Accel
docs.text: Marks a path with a damaging high-precision laser before firing an expanding electric round that explodes on impact.

docs.title: Air Arc
docs.text: Fires arcs of electricity at airborne targets.

docs.title: Batter
docs.text: Shoves back enemies using bolts consisting of various liquids.

docs.title: Arc Storm
docs.text: Swiftly fires powerful arcs of electricity at ground targets.

docs.title: Deracination
docs.text: Beams out an intense tractor beam that pulls in air targets, dealing heavy damage in the process.

docs.title: Shatter
docs.text: Fires various powerful clumps of flak at enemy aircraft.

docs.title: Fragment
docs.text: Damages and destroys incoming projectiles, akin to the segment. Laser projectiles are still not targeted.

docs.title: Assail
docs.text: Launches a flurry of homing missiles at enemies, akin to the swarmer.

docs.title: CAATS
docs.text: Even if the name might sound cute, this is Cerbero's proudest anti-air invention: The Cerberian Anti Air Turret System.

docs.title: Cavalry
docs.text: Launches a rapidly pulsating, cascading plasma orb.

docs.title: Hurricane
docs.text: Fires many clumps of explosive flak at enemies, akin to the cyclone.

docs.title: Diffract
docs.text: Fires high-grade piercing shells that split into more shells.

docs.title: Gattling
docs.text: Pelts nearby enemies with a storm of bullets. Good luck feeding this.

docs.title: Ignitor
docs.text: Fires many close-range piercing bolts at nearby enemies, akin to the fuse.

docs.title: Interitus
docs.text: Deploys a singular homing missile at faraway enemies.

docs.title: Kugelblitz
docs.text: Launches powerful lightning orbs via supercharging of metal.

docs.title: Lightning Chaingun
docs.text: Gradually escalates in firerate, decimating enemies with a flurry of lasers.

docs.title: Armageddon
docs.text: Charges and fires three persistent laser beams at nearby enemies. Requires high quantities of coolant to operate.

docs.title: Landmine Launcher
docs.text: Deploys landmines that stick to the ground for a short while. Mines explode on contact.

docs.title: Missile Battery
docs.text: Deploys ballistic drones that fire a large barrage of homing rockets. Cannot rotate while charging.

docs.title: Nuclear Launch Silo
docs.text: Launches nuclear warheads that disable healing blocks and deal heavy damage to enemies caught in its radius. Low rate of fire.

docs.title: Mortar
docs.text: Flings incendiary cannon shells at nearby enemies. Has a blind spot.

docs.title: Itemslinger
docs.text: Slingshots pieces of raw material at enemies.

docs.title: CBST
docs.text: Cluster bomb strike turret. Fires fragging shells that cover a wide area.

docs.title: Sear
docs.text: Singes nearby enemies, akin to the scorch.

docs.title: Shotgun
docs.text: Fires many rounds at point-blank range. Deals more damage up close.

docs.title: Sniper
docs.text: Long range, high damage. Useful for point defense and securing vulnerable areas.

docs.title: Sprinkler
docs.text: Puts out nearby fires at high efficiency. Not useful in combat, as it deals no damage.

docs.title: Sunflare
docs.text: Incinerates any and all enemies that walk nearby, akin to the sear.

docs.title: Trio
docs.text: Fires rounds utilizing three barrels as opposed to the duo's two.

docs.title: Uhlan
docs.text: Charges and fires three powerful beams of energy at ground targets.

docs.title: Van Turretheim
docs.text: Fires bursts of powerful rounds, akin to a more concentrated shotgun.

docs.title: Weave
docs.text: Fires two weaving shots of water at enemies.

docs.title: Zephyr
docs.text: Fires non-damaging, high-concentration blasts of steam, dealing heavy knockback.

docs.title: Advanced Reassembly Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades units to the 3rd tier. These upgraded units may be upgraded a final time.

docs.title: Basic Reassembly Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades units created in the Basic Factory to the next tier. Units produced by this Reassembly Chamber may be further upgraded.

docs.title: Primary Factory
docs.text: Creates small and light units which may be upgraded using Reassembly Chambers.

docs.title: Progressive Assembly Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades units to the 4th and final tier.

docs.title: Regenerator
docs.text: A tower that continuously heals all allied units in its range. Requires Cryofluid.

docs.title: Copper Ammo
docs.text: Simple, boring ammo with absolutly no effects whatsoever.

docs.title: Titanium Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from titanium. Decent damage and has pierce.

docs.title: Explosive Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from blast compound. Decent damage and has a frag effect in some turrets.

docs.title: Cryogenic Alloy
docs.text: A shock-cooled, highly durable metal made from Igneous Alloy, Cryogenic Gel and Neutron Fluid. Useful in advanced electronic components.

docs.title: Cryogenic Gel
docs.text: A very cold material made from mixing cryofluid and silicon. Used as one of the components to create Cryogenic Alloy.

docs.title: Fuel Rod
docs.text: A fuel rod constructed from layering thorium on a durable plastanium and lead core.

docs.title: Gold
docs.text: A shiny piece of metal! Can be traded to get other resources.

docs.title: Healing Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from spore pods. No damage but heals hit allied blocks.

docs.title: Homing Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from thorium. Good damage and has a homing effect.

docs.title: Igneous Alloy
docs.text: A very hot material smelted from surge alloy and titanium using slag. Used as a component needed to create Cryogenic Alloy.

docs.title: Hardened Living Steel
docs.text: Living steel that was infused with thorium to make it more durable.

docs.title: Living Steel
docs.text: A living piece of metal. Titanium infused with spores.

docs.title: Nano Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from living steel that infects enemies with nano bots which burn them from the inside.

docs.title: Nuke
docs.text: A nuclear warhead made using graphite and fuel rods.

docs.title: Steel Amalgam
docs.text: A compound material made from Copper, Living Steel and Surge Alloy.

docs.title: Acid
docs.text: A dangerous liquid.

docs.title: Living Steel Liquid
docs.text: Living Steel that was infused with oil thus making it a liquid. Spreads to nearby oil to 'self-replicate'.

docs.title: Neutron Fluid
docs.text: A highly potent coolant created by mixing oil, cryofluid and living steel liquid.

docs.title: Steam
docs.text: Evaporated water.

docs.title: Cangirus
docs.text: A lush planet that has land and water.

docs.title: Cerbero
docs.text: A barren planet where tragedy struck long ago. Nothing is left here besides destruction and death.

docs.title: Hathor
docs.text: A small piece of Cerbero created by the impact of a meteor. Nothing lasts here except an ancient Cerberian base built here before everything collapsed...

docs.title: Abandoned Battlefield
docs.text: The last sector before you conquer Cerbero. The instruments register many powerful foes here. Waves will be sent relentlessly. Try to survive!

docs.title: Dree
docs.text: The next step on your journey through Cerbero. This sector has coal and water. Use coal to create primitive power. Upgrade your resources.

docs.title: Etnatic Isles
docs.text: The Crux's primary manufacturing plant for flammables and circuitry. Eliminate the outposts, bust through the main gate and secure valuable resources.

docs.title: Exordium
docs.text: You arrive on Cerbero. This is the sector that the computer calculated the least danger for. Start your journey. Set up basic operations. Prepare for more difficult sectors.

docs.title: Spore Dunes
docs.text: The next challenging sector on cerbero. Has Titanium. Harder waves.

docs.title: [orange]Aedes
docs.text: Shoots swerving bullets at nearby targets. Rotors deal damage.

docs.title: [orange]Apis
docs.text: Fires small yet deadly precision laser blasts. Can hover.

docs.title: [orange]Armiger
docs.text: Equipped with rocket launchers and a minigun. Rotor deals decent damage to nearby targets.

docs.title: Penumbra
docs.text: A unit with technology similar to that of the Serpulo Antumbra but the main cannons shoot a laser instead of regular bullets.

docs.title: Veil
docs.text: Like the Eclipse unit but instead of shooting flak bullets, it shoots energy missiles. Also shoots stronger lasers. Sacrifices some of it's armor for more health and damage.

docs.title: Spark
docs.text: A unit similar to a Flare from Serpulo but with upgraded weaponry.

docs.title: Vista
docs.text: A Horizon-like unit that throws down stronger bombs.

docs.title: Summit
docs.text: A unit similar to a Zenith but the missile launchers fire barrages of missiles instead of single ones.

docs.title: [orange]Alopex
docs.text: Fires concentrated piercing lasers at nearby targets. Quick, but frail.

docs.title: [orange]Culiseta
docs.text: Equipped with fragging bombs, targetable missiles, railguns, and more. Manufactures assault and siege units on board to deploy upon destruction. Rotor deals damage to nearby targets.

docs.title: [yellow]Delta
docs.text: Defends the Atom core from enemies. Swiftly builds structures, and is equipped with healing beams.

docs.title: [yellow]Epsilon
docs.text: Defends the Element core from enemies. Rapidly builds a variety of structures, and is equipped with multiple healing beams.

docs.title: [purple]HIVE Heavy Assault Unit (HHAU)
docs.text: Equipped a high-velocity missile launcher.

docs.title: [orange]HIVE
docs.text: Frail, but has a powerful forcefield, alongside assault unit constructors. Boasts many highly effective laser weapons.

docs.title: [orange]Kestrel
docs.text: Equipped with onboard arc turrets and a concentrated laser beam. Forfeits agility and speed for power.

docs.title: [orange]Areus
docs.text: Fires a miniaturized laser beam at nearby targets.

docs.title: [orange]Onirion
docs.text: Equipped with a torpedo cannon, dual missile launchers, and swerving machine guns. Additionally, drops bombs on targets underneath it. Rotors deal large damage to nearby targets.

docs.title: [green]Sapling
docs.text: Capable of large-scale mining, building, and repairing. The penultimate support drone.

docs.title: [green]Sprout
docs.text: Capable of automatic mining, building, and repairing. Boosts nearby allied units' move speed.

docs.title: [green]Seed
docs.text: Capable of automatic mining, repairing, and building.

docs.title: [orange]Orbital Platform Strahl
docs.text: Boasts many highly concentrated laser beams, alongside point defense beam turrets. Rapidly builds and releases Alopex.

docs.title: [purple]Annax
docs.text: Deals medium-high damage via twin slag guns. Effective against enemy transport structures.

docs.title: Auctus
docs.text: A long, snake-like unit that stomps buildings.

docs.title: [purple]Auratus
docs.text: Utilizes slag and water orbs to neutralize enemy targets. Additionally, it is equipped with a main railcannon.

docs.title: Curtulus
docs.text: A unit with an appearance close to that of an Arkyid but instead of the main cannon shooting artillery bullets, it shoots a liquid shell.

docs.title: Hexathelid
docs.text: A unit type similar to an Atrax but shoots fragging slag bullets. Exchanges less health and armor for a lot more damage.

docs.title: Cerberian Behemoth
docs.text: A huge unit and Cerberos proudest invention. Shoots with a ginormous laser, huge fragging bullets, laser sweepers and smaller FLAK turrets.

docs.title: Straggle
docs.text: A cerberian version of the Crawler unit.

docs.title: Bayonet
docs.text: A stronger version of the Dagger unit typically found on Serpulo.

docs.title: Citadel
docs.text: An upgraded version of the Fortress that hails from Cerbero.

docs.title: Cudgel
docs.text: A unit similar to a Mace from Serpulo but stronger. Shoots with a different type of Flamethrower.

docs.title: Kaiser
docs.text: A unit inspired by the Reign from Serpulo but with upgraded technology. Hass massively increased health and armor at the cost of sacrificing some agility.

docs.title: Baton
docs.text: A re-manufactured version of the Scepter unit.

docs.title: Nephila
docs.text: Like the Spiroct unit but steals more life using enhanced sapping lasers.

docs.title: Setosus
docs.text: A Toxopid-like unit. The secondary cannons shoot out sapping lasers instead of normal ones. Equipped with significantly more armor and attack power than a regular Toxopid.

docs.title: [green]Corax
docs.text: Charges up a gigawatt laser that obliterates enemy structures and units alike. Additionally equipped with smaller artillery lasers.

docs.title: [purple]Reduct
docs.text: Freezes its targets alive via a frigid laser.

docs.title: [orange]Ducalis
docs.text: Equipped with rocket and proximity mine launchers. Powerful in sieges.

docs.title: [purple]Toruct
docs.text: Lights targets ablaze with a small, fiery laser.

docs.title: [orange]Onager
docs.text: Equipped with a homing rocket cannon and several smaller weapons. Obliterates all buildings in its path, but suffers against units. Can run over enemy structures.

docs.title: [orange]Procer
docs.text: Rapid-fires dual salvos of missiles at enemy targets. Is also equipped with a piercing laser.

docs.title: [orange]Sambuca
docs.text: Fires standard bullets at enemy structures. Less effective against units.

docs.title: [purple]Scofra
docs.text: Equipped with dual oil and slag guns. Can walk over walls and terrain.

docs.title: [orange]Scorpio
docs.text: Equipped with a railgun that pierces most laser-blocking defenses. Less effective against units.

docs.title: [orange]Springald
docs.text: Equipped with a rocket launching cannon and small laser arrays. Excels at siege against buildings, but is weaker against units.

docs.title: [purple]Lycosid
docs.text: Equipped with elemental cannons. Constructs and deploys Toructs and Reducts.

docs.title: [green]Aestiva
docs.text: Equipped with a shotgun capable of healing allied structures. Manufactures Albas on board.

docs.title: [green]Alba
docs.text: Equipped with a small regeneration projector, but no weapons.

docs.title: [green]Altaic
docs.text: Equipped with multiple healing and point defense weapons. Deploys Oxynoe. Damages and slows down enemies via an energy field, which additionally heals nearby allied units and structures.

docs.title: [orange]Arnux
docs.text: Launches a powerful plasma sphere at faraway targets. Also equipped with triple laser burst turrets.

docs.title: [green]Arvens
docs.text: Equipped with a healing mend projector. Boosts nearby allied units' build speed.

docs.title: [orange]Cromis
docs.text: Fires trios of missiles. Additionally, is equipped with a laser that inflicts EMP on hit targets.

docs.title: [orange]Japonica
docs.text: Boasts a homing missile launcher, several persistent laser beams, and numerous autocannons. Manufactures and deploys Rissos out to sea.

docs.title: [orange]Mela
docs.text: Swiftly fires cannon shells at nearby targets. Equipped with a mine launcher.

docs.title: Index
docs.text:
Property Value Repository https://github.com/sh1penfire/meld Stars 44 Last updated 2026-05-15T07:21:04Z

An experimental RTS mod. Features a rich environment and a unique cast of enemies to fight.

Trudge through Ikaru, home to Meld. Salvage the remains of previous incursions. Fend off the wildlife.

Play as a field commander. Rally tierless specialists to push back the flood of constructs.

DEFEND, TAKE GROUND, HARVEST, REPEAT

Campaign is a demo for what's to come. Refer to the custom game maps once you've finished.

This type of project takes lots of time to develop so if you wana know what's happening with the mod, join the Mindustry discord server and look for Meld in the fourm thread :D

Alternatively, join the Meld discord server!

https://discord.gg/eNynvuJXud

Translated to Russian by: Dovintc

Completion: ~6%

docs.title: Aether Cracker
docs.text:
Cracks Aether into Rift over ichor vents. Siphons some Ichor in the process. Shares Aether out the sides.

Excess fluids are released to avoid overpressurizing including input Aether!.

docs.title: Amalgam Decomposer
docs.text: Grinds Electrum down and blasts it using high amounts of Aspect till the remainder is pieces of Debris and Ichor.

docs.title: Bramble Press
docs.text:
Presses Bramble vines for Mercury, producing tiny amounts of Ooze. Acts as a fluid router for Mercury

Plated

docs.title: Conglomeration Rig
docs.text: Crushes up Carbolith and mixes it with vent fumes and Ichor, then presses the slurry into Bricks. Requires Aspect to run.

docs.title: Crush Weaver
docs.text: "Efficiently" weaves Dissonitre into Vitric Mesh. Requires Aspect to run.

docs.title: Dissonance Inducer
docs.text:
Mimics a sedentary Dissonitre incubation environment for Meld, growing batches of crystals, and offgassing some Aether in the process.

Requires Resonarum and Rift to run.

docs.title: Earthbound Infuser
docs.text:
Infuses Debris with vent fumes to synthesize Carbolith.

Requires Aspect to run.

docs.title: Electrum Amalgamator
docs.text:
Directly blasts native gold deposits with Aspect, using Mercury to extract an amalgam from the powder, then combines the mush with Silver and Debris to create Electrum.

Produces some Ichor as a byproduct.

Input liquid requirements based on efficiency.

docs.title: Glassblower
docs.text:
Melts down globules and extrudes them into a fine crystalline cloth, releasing Aether in the process.

Requires Riplom and power to run.

Input liquid requirements based on efficiency.

docs.title: Heating Basin
docs.text: Runs Nectar through pipes laced with Carbolith dust over geothermal sources to extract Mercury, producing loads of Debris as a byproduct.

docs.title: Peat Masher
docs.text:
Grinds up Compacted Masses extracting Bramble Vines and Starving Masses in the process.

Requires Aspect and Mercury to run. Acts as a fluid router for Mercury and Aspect.

Becomes net positive on Mercury when operated over geothermal sources

docs.title: Vitric Weaver
docs.text:
Weaves Dissonitre into a fine crystalline cloth.

Untangles Rift input into Aether in the process, requiring Riplom to run.

Input liquid requirements based on efficiency.

docs.title: Warp Aggregator
docs.text:
Processes massive batches of glass waste over heat sources producing Warp.

Returns noteable amounts of useful glass materials.

docs.title: Barricade
docs.text:
Provides cover against enemy projectiles. Quick to build.

Easy way to store Compacted Bricks/Stony Gloop outside of the core for onsite use.

Armored.

docs.title: Sandbank
docs.text:
Provides cover against enemy projectiles. Soaks a lot of damage, but takes extra damage each hit.

Squishi! (45)

docs.title: Silver Husk
docs.text:
Provides cover against enemy projectiles. Slowly regenerates when fed Aspect.

Plated

docs.title: Aether Compressor
docs.text: Houses Meld which compacts the surounding Aether into the insides of the construct.

docs.title: Chute Bridge
docs.text: Moves items over a single tile. Bypasses structures and terrain.

docs.title: Chute Crossing
docs.text:
Lets items cross through without intersecting with eachother.

This block is purely for fun and should not be used unless you really want it!

docs.title: Chute Overflow
docs.text: Routes items to the front, or to the sides if blocked.

docs.title: Chute Router
docs.text: Routes items to three sides. Only accepts items from the back. Can be configured as a sorter.

docs.title: Chute Unloader
docs.text: Unloads selected item out of adjacent blocks. Works on cores!

docs.title: Chute
docs.text: Transports items fowards. Only holds a single item.

docs.title: Glasswork Chute
docs.text: Forms, then transports batches of items. Conducts power like a wire, double in speed while fed.

docs.title: Large Meld Cluster
docs.text: A pile of Meld which has overgrown an Aether vent. Good source of starting debris.

docs.title: Meld Cultivator
docs.text: Houses blobs which release gasseous Meld.

docs.title: Meld Pumpjack
docs.text: Harvests industrial quantities of Ichor.

docs.title: Spawning Pool
docs.text: Uses massive amounts of Ichor to incubate batches of larva.

docs.title: Unloading Hub
docs.text:
Rapidly unloads the selected item out of adjacent blocks. Heavly Armored!

Works on cores!

Damages all neary buildings on destruction!

docs.title: Large Crystal Barrier
docs.text:
Nigh indestructable crystaline formation of Meld. Often demolished as a result of a broken Synapse, or from the floor melting underneath.

Heavly armored

docs.title: Crystal Barrier
docs.text:
Nigh indestructable crystaline formation of Meld. Often demolished as a result of a broken Synapse, or from the floor melting underneath.

Heavly armored

docs.title: Braig Coffer
docs.text: Bursts open into Braigs upon destruction. Locks onto a target's position, then fires a burst of rocks.

docs.title: Buffer
docs.text: Stores a small amount of items with separate capacities per type. Can be unloaded to empty its contents. Does not connect to the core.

docs.title: Core: Bunker
docs.text: Core of the base. Allows units to pass through freely. Once all are destroyed, the sector is lost.

docs.title: Core: Raftlightgray[]
docs.text: Core of the base. Allows units to pass through freely. Activates when inside a powered facility.

docs.title: Core: Raft
docs.text: Core of the base. Allows units to pass through freely. Once all are destroyed, the sector is lost.

docs.title: Craig Coffer
docs.text: Bursts open into Craigs upon destruction. Shoots nearby hostiles, taking damage in the process without Meld.

docs.title: Crate
docs.text: Stores a small amount of items with separate capacities per type.

docs.title: Data Coagulator
docs.text: Deposits mass amounts of data onto technoscrap. The process consumes excess technoscrap.

docs.title: Data Miner
docs.text: Connects to exposed data cores, and mines small amounts of Liquid Data.

docs.title: Decryption Module
docs.text: Connects to exposed data cores, and rapidly pulls Liquid Data from Technoscrap using small amounts of Liquid Data.

docs.title: Encrypter
docs.text: Harvests Fragments and Memory Shards.

docs.title: Environmental Drencher
docs.text: Continually charges up and fires a ring of pellets that spread liquid as they travel. Only functions above 83% pressure!

docs.title: Fluid Sprayer
docs.text: Continually charges up and fires a burst of pellets that spread liquid as they travel. Only functions above 75% pressure!

docs.title: Indoctrinator
docs.text: Enlightens Technoscrap into Grating Chunks

docs.title: Interface
docs.text:
Stores a small amount of items with separate capacities per type. Can be unloaded to empty its contents. Can connect to the core!

Ground units can walk over this.

docs.title: Jilla Coffer
docs.text: Bursts open into Jilla upon destruction.

docs.title: Large Mallow Barrier
docs.text:
Artificial formation of Mallow Sand. Often demolished as a result of a nearby explosion, or from sustained firepower.

Squishi! (60)

docs.title: Mallow Barrier
docs.text:
Artificial formation of Mallow Sand. Often demolished as a result of a nearby explosion, or from sustained firepower.

Squishi! (60)

docs.title: Large Mallow Cluster
docs.text: Explodes when destroyed, spraying Dissonitre onto all nearby units.

docs.title: Meld Amplifier
docs.text: Pulses Amplification to all allies in range.

docs.title: Meld Beacon
docs.text: Fumigates areas with Meld making nearby constructs very durable, while constantly chipping away at enemy targets within the cloud.

docs.title: Meld Capsule
docs.text: Projects a barrier against physical attacks. Requires gasseous Meld to run.

docs.title: Meld Node
docs.text: Keeps the surounding swampland frozen. Spawnpoint for Meld creatures during waves.

docs.title: Meld Surpressor
docs.text:
Keeps the surounding swampland frozen. Constructed on top of core zones. Spawnpoint for Meld creatures during waves.

Armored

docs.title: Meld Synapse
docs.text: Stabalizes surounding crystal barriers. Once no synapses remain, the entire wall crumbles.

docs.title: Mercurial Diffuser
docs.text: Puffs clouds which intoxicate Meld units. Applies a coating of Mercury to allied units.

docs.title: Metal Sieve
docs.text:
Filters through cracked industrial rubble for Silver and Electrum, producing some starving masses in the process.

Requires Mercury to run.

docs.title: Movement Anchor
docs.text: Pulses a field which Anchors units. Applies Rebound to allied units.

docs.title: [red]Nullifier
docs.text:
Constructs a devistating Aspect-filled paylod that decimates hostile buildings and units alike.

Annihilates its immediate surroundings on destruction, don't get too close!

docs.title: Overseer Fabricator
docs.text:
Uses debris pieces to passively fabricate limited-duration Overseers to assist in nearby construction and Rally nearby allies.

Requires a large amount of Aspect to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

docs.title: Pad: Trench
docs.text: Outpost of the base. Only one can be active at a time. Cannot support a base alone.

docs.title: Pad: Phi
docs.text: Outpost of the base. Only one can be active at a time. Cannot support a base alone.

docs.title: Pad: Psi
docs.text: Outpost of the base. Only one can be active at a time. Cannot support a base alone.

docs.title: Ping Tower
docs.text:
uses debris pieces to fire a burst of snoar pings which highlight enemies hit through fog.

Requires a large amount of Aspect to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

docs.title: Pointago Coffer
docs.text: Bursts open into multiple Pointago upon destruction. Locks onto a target's, then fires a 3 round burst of sharp rocks.

docs.title: Rubble Refinery
docs.text:
Blasts and centrifuges cracked industrial rubble for essential resources.

Requires Aspect to run.

docs.title: Shield Battery
docs.text: Spouts garbled Liquid Data, often connected to Force Barrier walls. Requires Aspect to run, and some starting Liquid Data.

docs.title: Sonar Spire
docs.text: Takes a moment to build upon itself, then periodically pulses sonar.

docs.title: Large Carbonic Barrier
docs.text:
Artificial formation of Carbon Stone. Often demolished as a result of a broken Synapse, or from sustained firepower.

Heavly armored

docs.title: Carbonic Barrier
docs.text:
Artificial formation of Carbon Stone. Often demolished as a result of a broken Synapse, or from sustained firepower.

Heavly armored

docs.title: Aspect Outlet
docs.text: Decompresses Aether into highly volatile Aspect. Works as an output terminal for a fluid network.

docs.title: Blossoming Channel
docs.text:
Acts as a conduit. Transmits fluid from one side to the other. Stores a small amount of fluid. Transports at 500% pressure.

Will chain destruct!

docs.title: Pressurized Channel Director
docs.text:
Acts as a conduit. Transmits fluid from one side to the other. Stores a tiny amount of fluid. Transports at 200% pressure.

Will chain destruct!

docs.title: Channel Director
docs.text:
Restricts the flow of fluids from its input to output by half.

Can detonate Channel Nodes full of Aspect. Transports at 50% pressure.

Will chain destruct!

docs.title: Channel Face
docs.text: Acts as a fluid junction. Transmits fluid without storing it. No risk of explosion.

docs.title: Channel Hub
docs.text:
Acts as a fluid router. Liquid can be input or output from any side.

Stores 100 nodes worth of fluid.

docs.title: Channel Node
docs.text: Acts as a fluid router. Liquid can be input or output from any side. Stores a small amount of fluid.

docs.title: Compartmentalized Node
docs.text:
Acts as a fluid router. Liquid can be input or output from any side.

Separately stores Nectar, Mercury, Blood and Ooze. When supplied Debris while full with all four fluids, slowly voids its contents.

docs.title: Displacement Pump
docs.text:
Dumps Debris into fluids to retrive a steady supply of fluid indefinitely. Requires Aspect to run.

Plated

docs.title: Filtration Unit
docs.text:
Acts as a filter. Outputs Mercury to any side.

When powered with Aspect while containing Mercury, filters out Debris and Starving masses from Blood and Nectar, producing some Mercury in the process.

Halts when fully pressurized with Mercury!

docs.title: Neutralization Chamber
docs.text:
Uses Mercury and Elderflesh to soak up Blood, producing miniscule amounts of power in the process. Acts as a fluid router for Blood.

Explodes when fully pressurized with Blood!

docs.title: Pipeline Crossing
docs.text: Meld construct which acts as a fluid junction.

docs.title: Pipeline Overpass
docs.text: Meld construct which acts as a bridge

docs.title: Pipeline Router
docs.text: Meld construct which acts as a fluid router..

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text: Meld construct which acts as a pipe.

docs.title: Conductive Pile
docs.text:
It's a pile of electrum coils which is conductive. Go figure what you can use this for.

And I guess it stores a tiny bit of power

...Squishi? (80)

docs.title: Connector
docs.text:
Projects lasers which share power between the node and its target.

Plated

docs.title: Discharge Outlet red
docs.text:
Crushes Dissonitre and focuses the resulting Aether into Aspect efficiently using resonarum lenses, producing some power in the process.

Explodes when fully pressurized with Aspect!

Placeholder Sprite!

docs.title: Glass Burner red
docs.text:
Burns Dissonitre based material with bits of Riplom stabalized with Rift, producing minute amounts of power.

Paceholder sprite!

docs.title: Powerbank
docs.text: Stores large amounts of power and releases it in times of defict.

docs.title: Purification Chamber
docs.text:
Blasts Starving Masses over high heat decomposing them into Blood, producing some power in the proceess.

Requires Mercury and Aspect to run.

Explodes when fully pressurized with Blood!

docs.title: Substation
docs.text:
Projects lasers which share power between the station and its target. Stores power in an internal buffer.

Plated!

docs.title: Thermo matting red[]
docs.text:
Passively obtains power from meld digestion over Ichor sources, extracting some Ichor in the process.

PLACEHOLDER SPRITE

docs.title: Access Point
docs.text: Plugs into an Encrypter to power it.

docs.title: Aether Accumulator
docs.text: Collects Aether from suitable sources.

docs.title: Aether Plug
docs.text: Siphons Aether from suitable sources.

docs.title: Crystal Cracker
docs.text: Breaks open Dissonitre crystals over aspect soil as a source of Aether.

docs.title: Earthen Grinder
docs.text: Crushes up earthen stone and mixes it with Nectar & Rift to make Stony Gloop.

docs.title: Elemental Blaster
docs.text:
Blasts deposits for items indefinitely. Requires Aspect to run.

Can be boosted with Meld to double harvesting speed.

docs.title: Elemental Sampler
docs.text:
Samples deposits for items indefinitely. Requires Aspect and Rift to run.

Can be boosted with Warp to double harvesting speed.

More efficient against soft tissue

docs.title: Filtrative Feeder
docs.text:
Processes batches of Ichor over meld floors, aquiring some Meld and pieces of Debris each batch processed.

Requires a tiny trickle of power.

Input liquid requirements based on efficiency.

docs.title: Flarestack Filter
docs.text:
Harvests Rift from suitable sources by neutralizing the impurities from the air.

Requires Resonarum and Riplom to run.

docs.title: Harbinger of Decay
docs.text: Channels meld from pools into itself.

docs.title: Sap Extractor
docs.text: Extracts Nectar from suitable sources. Needs to be attached to a Mangrove Heart or a Nectar Fissure over Nectar or Mercury floors.

docs.title: Siphon
docs.text:
Pumps Mercury fluid deposits at half pressure. Uses Compacted Bricks/Stony Gloop to repair stability.

Stability is limited and deposits will break open if exhausted!

Deposit repairing is a WIP and will only be added if there's enough of a need.

docs.title: Techno Dredger
docs.text: Collects massive amounts of lose pieces of technoscrap. Requires Aspect to run.

docs.title: Vitric Stimu1ator
docs.text:
Harvests Rift from suitable sources using Vitric Meshes to filter the air, producing a substantial amount of glass waste.

Requires Power to run.

docs.title: Downpour
docs.text: Barages ground targets with 30 Mercury-filled Silver thorns each burst. Slow reload speed. High burst damage and armor piercing. Inflicts Mercury Poisoning!

docs.title: Drill Turret
docs.text: Focuses Aspect into an armor piercing beam.

docs.title: Flurry
docs.text:
Charges and flings canisters of sticky Carbolith dust which spark on a delay. High damage vs force projectors

Warning: Putting hard matterials with sludge in will clog the machinery!

Armored!

docs.title: Grandeur
docs.text:
Flings a compacted ball of material at targets. over long distances Small amounts of armor piercing on hit

Effects vary based on ammo type

docs.title: Meld Cannon
docs.text: Lobs clusters of highly compressed Aether at enemies.

docs.title: Meld Spewer
docs.text: Sprays focused jets of Ichor toward targets doing huge focused knockback, healing any allied building in the way.

docs.title: Molotov
docs.text: Launches an Aspect-filled Silver shell at ground targets over long distances. High armor piercing damage on impact. Doubles the damage armoured units take!

docs.title: Scorcher Nest
docs.text: Crystalizes a scorcher crystal, which fuels 4 indipendantly targeted jets of flame. Bursts open into numerous Scorchers on destruction.

docs.title: Shredstorm
docs.text:
Sprays shrapnel at enemy targets with slight piercing. Spread is focused towards the aim direction

Effects vary based on ammo type

docs.title: Sunder
docs.text: Fires clumps of Debris flak at enemy targets. High damage versus flying targets

docs.title: Tantrum
docs.text: Compacts and puffs out clouds of Rift using a Silver piston, dealing heavy knockback. Reduces target's drag

docs.title: Tracker Encampment
docs.text:
Launches off larvel missiles which do bonus damage on direct hit. Dislodges from its base when destroyed.

Heavly armored

docs.title: Vivalo
docs.text:
Atomizes and fires a jet of crystalline particles which pierce armor.

Quick rotation speed and increased coolant effectiveness.

Effects vary based on ammo type, ranging from Laceration to Shattering

docs.title: Vivisection
docs.text: Assembles and launches Resonarum sawblades. Lacerates targets without armor

docs.title: Astrea Autoforge
docs.text:
Pumps out Astrea units using Debris and Electrum.

Requires a sizeable amount of Aspect and Mercury to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

docs.title: Craig Incubator
docs.text:
Forms a metalic shell around larvae trios in an Ichor environment to form Craig constructs. The residual stone is formed into an Afraig with each batch. Bursts open into several Craigs and Afraigs when destroyed.

Lightly Armored

docs.title: Gilla Incubator
docs.text: Entombs pairs of larvae in crystal inside Aether environment to form Gilla constructs. Bursts open into a Gilla and a pair of Killas when destroyed.

docs.title: Hammerhead Bioforge
docs.text:
Rapidly Gestates Hammerhead units using Debris, Riplom and Resonarum.

Requires a sizeable amount of Rift and a trickle of Aspect to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

docs.title: Jilla Incubator
docs.text: Entombs pairs of larvae in crystal inside Aether environment to form Jilla constructs. Bursts open into a Gilla and a pair of Killas when destroyed.

docs.title: Narwhal Autoforge
docs.text:
Pumps out Narwhal units using Carbolith, Compacted Bricks and Stony Gloop.

Requires a sizeable amount of Aspect and Ichor to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

Lightly Armored

docs.title: Remora Autoforge
docs.text:
Pumps out Remora units using Debris, Electrum and Vitric Mesh.

Requires a large amount of Aspect to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

docs.title: Shark Autoforge
docs.text:
Pumps out Shark units using Silver and Carbolith.

Requires a large amount of Aspect to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

docs.title: Abberation Core
docs.text: Used to defragment the database to unlock new technology, and in certain Liquid Data slources.

docs.title: Astral Fulgurite
docs.text: Refineable for a slew of glassy materials.

docs.title: Bioscrap Graft
docs.text: Used to defragment the database to unlock new technology, and in certain regenerative appliences.

docs.title: Blossoming Elderflesh
docs.text: Puffballs of fine biological grains and slits intertwined with larger strands. Edible to the Meld.

docs.title: Bramble Vine
docs.text: Thick biological strands coursing with Mercury. Contains trace amounts of Ooze

docs.title: Carbolith
docs.text: Used for structural support and as a fuel source.

docs.title: Clay-Mallow
docs.text: Clay from the Badlands. Easly moulded to form containers, but difficult to aquire by blasting soil.

docs.title: Coagulated Vigor
docs.text: An eternally burning daemon's flesh, constantly in a cancerous state. One must imagine Icarus happy. Edible to the Meld.

docs.title: Compacted Bricks
docs.text: Used as a form of concrete for building foundations and power infastructure alongside Stony Gloop and Electrum Sheets.

docs.title: Compacted Masses
docs.text: Cluster of biological material wrapped with Bramble Vines.

docs.title: Debris
docs.text: Used in many kinds of constructs on Ikaru. Refineable.

docs.title: Dissonitre
docs.text: Rare alternative source of Aether sourced from the Storm Planes and Badlands. Somewhat unstable.

docs.title: Elderflesh
docs.text: Twisted biological strands coursing with Nectar. Constitutes the flora of the Mercury Swamps.

docs.title: Electrum Sheet
docs.text: Refined material used in power transmission and advanced unit production.

docs.title: Elnar Dust
docs.text: Raw material, valued for its ability to conduct aspect.

docs.title: Fragment
docs.text: Used to defragment the database to unlock new technology, and in advanced unit production.

docs.title: Grating Chunk
docs.text: No apparent use found. Panneling for the floors of the facilities which dot Ikaru.

docs.title: Grazing Bar
docs.text: A bar of highly compacted dehydrated flora with a Nectar center. Fragments easly with a loud cracking sound, but soft on the inside.

docs.title: Homunculus Chunk
docs.text: Chunks of... something? Not quite human. Edible to the Meld.

docs.title: Industrial Rubble (Cracked)
docs.text: Refinable for a slew of essential materials.

docs.title: Industrial Rubble
docs.text: Lucrative source of essential materials when cracked. Edible to the Meld.

docs.title: Larva
docs.text: Writhing metalic hunk with segments. Often seen in incubation structures that manufacture new constructs.

docs.title: Larval Plating
docs.text: Some sort of juvinile plating piece. No uses found.

docs.title: Meld Shard
docs.text: Vague lifeform in crystal form. Use unknown.

docs.title: Memory Shard
docs.text: Used to defragment the database to unlock new technology, and in certain Liquid Data sources.

docs.title: Metalic Chunk
docs.text: Some sort of metalalic hunk. No uses found. Edible to the Meld.

docs.title: Metalic Globule
docs.text: Some sort of metalalic blob. No uses found.

docs.title: Resonarum
docs.text: Used in high-energy Aspect appliences such as Nullifiers.

docs.title: Riploko
docs.text: Riplom which has been infused with Aspect. Ready to explode!

docs.title: Riplom
docs.text: Shale from the Storm Planes. A great flux for glasswork, though not much practical use found. Slightly volatile.

docs.title: Shiny Globule
docs.text: Melted remains of glass hardened into shiny globules. Best disposed of safely, or recycled.

docs.title: Silver
docs.text: Used in electrical components and structures. Integral part in most basic units.

docs.title: Starving Masses
docs.text: Shriveled up cluster of biological material. Acts as a great filtratium medium. The texture's quite dry.

docs.title: Stony Gloop
docs.text: Used as a motar for building foundations and power infastructure alongside Compacted Bricks and Electrum Sheets.

docs.title: Stony Particulate
docs.text: Grains of carbon stone.

docs.title: Stormstruck Shell
docs.text: A crystalline weave of Dissonitre around a polished Resonarum clump. Highly unstable...

docs.title: Technoscrap
docs.text: Used in advanced storage logistics and basic Core blocks.

docs.title: Tenbris
docs.text: Raw material, valued for its ability to insulate aspect when refined.

docs.title: Vitric Mesh
docs.text: An intricate piece of glasswork which captures Aether when stimulated with power, building on itself.

docs.title: [#cb8650]Aether
docs.text: Passively collected by certain structures. Found in abundance from aether vents.

docs.title: [#cbdbfc]Aspect
docs.text: Unstable alternative power source. Refinable.

docs.title: [#7d312f]Blood
docs.text: ... what?

docs.title: Cold waste
docs.text: Cold slurry of unusable gunk

docs.title: [#e6c700]Ichor
docs.text: Major food source for the Meld. Fuels Meld construct birthing and a major component in sustainable power systems/mass-produced infastructure.

docs.title: [#9ccaed]Liquid Data[]
docs.text: Fluid form of data pulled from technoscrap and other related materials.

docs.title: [#ea9ad6]Meld[]
docs.text: Slowly disolves most metals and organics, save for a group of materials.

docs.title: [#89828c]Mercury
docs.text: Used as lubricant. Acts as a potent toxin inside creatures of Meld origin.

docs.title: [#b89f47]Nectar
docs.text: Used as a potent coolant. Can be refined into Mercury over high heat with the right reagents. Encourages a slight mending effect on units.

docs.title: [red]Null
docs.text: Byproduct of technoscrap cracking. Often vanishes without a trace.

docs.title: [#89413e]Ooze
docs.text: No apparent use found. Cold to the touch.

docs.title: [#8872da]Rift
docs.text: Refinable into Warp. Released from Aether fused with Carbolith under high heat.

docs.title: [#b460e2]Warp
docs.text:
Used in utility buildings as fuel and in higher tier unit construction.

Highly unstable

docs.title: Waste
docs.text: Slurry of unusable gunk

docs.title: Ikaru
docs.text:
A wartorn planet with scraps of usable unrefined resources. Inhabited by the Meld.

Heavy fog lingers everywhere.

docs.title: Creek
docs.text:
Incursion point for Ikaru. Practise basic production and ways to push into enemy teritory.

Objective: Attack Weather: Drizzle

docs.title: Dead End?
docs.text:
Scrapyard leaves no further routes to explore Ikaru. A new data point is encrypted inside a nearby facility, but the keys are in other locations.

Come back when either Hedge or Shear have been completed!

Objective: Explore Weather: None

-Carbolith depleted

docs.title: Hedge
docs.text:
Scrapyard leaves no further routes to explore Ikaru. Backtracking from Creek is the only way fowards. The branching path ahead will further provoke the Meld.

Aerial threats will come from the north. Use Sunder turrets to counter them.

Objective: Survive Weather: Foggy

-Carbolith depleted -3 Meld Amplifiers spotted!

docs.title: Remenant
docs.text:
Datamine!

Abandoned and entombed with crystaline megaliths.

Huge swarms of flying and artillery constructs have been recorded, along with an unknown eradication tier threat.

Dredge and process as many research materials as you can, untill the waves overwhelm you.

There is no Resonarum in this sector. Nullifiers inaccesable!

Objective: Dredge

-Resonarum depleted -2 Meld Amplifiers spotted! -Spawning pools spotted!

docs.title: Scrapyard
docs.text:
Filled with Debris and Silver, but lacking in Carbolith. Deploy new infusion technology.

The landing area is resource deprived, be ready to attack!

Objective: Survive Weather: Hazy

-Carbolith depleted

-1 Meld Amplifier spotted!

docs.title: Shear
docs.text:
Scrapyard leaves no further routes to explore Ikaru. Backtracking from Creek is the only way fowards. The branching path ahead will further provoke the Meld.

Meld attacks will switch sides after every burst, starting from the west front.

Friendly signals have been detected... be ready for anything!

Objective: ??? Weather: Australian

-2 Meld Amplifiers spotted!

docs.title: Slumber
docs.text:
This planet hasn't solidified yet...

You've done well to make it this far.

Objective: ??? Weather: ???

docs.title: [#ea9ad6]Tempest in a Teacup[]
docs.text:
Another Strata instance has already setup a base here, and moved on.

Harsh weather had been observed in response to activity, so the base lies dormant in a divot.

Ensure you don't get overwhelmed by the heavy storms, and keep your units repaired.

Objective: Weather the storm Weather: Clear, then Torrential, then Clear

-2 Meld Amplifiers spotted! -Quick Start!

docs.title: Aspect Burn
docs.text: Doubles damage taken, does a tiny bit of DoT. Applied by Aspect-based weaponary in conjunction with burning. Only affects mechanical and armored targets.

docs.title: [#cbdbfc]Aspect Channeling[]
docs.text:
Details about how to contain and channel Aspect into a variety of uses like Sonar Pings, self regeneration and even NULLIFICATION.

Contains some schematics for buildings which use Silver & Resonarum to achieve this, but the rest are scattered through other entries...

docs.title: Carbonic Barrens
docs.text:
This data point appears to mark the entrance to a large expanse of carbon stone.

There is a heavy pink fog in the area lowering visibility dramatically, though there appears to be plentiful carbolith deposits scattered throughout.

docs.title: Blackout
docs.text: Fade to nothing. Applied by the Backdrop

docs.title: Building Foundations
docs.text:
For too long structures have been made with Debris and Carbolith as foundations, only using refined materials for moving parts...

With new data about Ichor's properties, and observations about how Meld constructs form their shells, a new way to industrially cement Carbolith dust into mock Carbon Stone has been prototyped and is ready to deploy.

Brick Conglomerators and Earthen Crushers produce the bricks and motar for building foundations with a variety of materials and deposits, allowing certain buildings to take on some natural armor and be built far quicker.

Boulders are a good source of Bricks/Gloop and will return some when deconstructed.

docs.title: Creek Completed!
docs.text: What the hell was that???

docs.title: [accent]Crude Crackers[]
docs.text:
Schematics taking advantage of the badland's catalytic features.

More observation may be required to fully defragment this entry's buildings.

docs.title: Dissolving
docs.text: Small bit of DoT and doubles damage taken. Applied by Meld Beacons.

docs.title: [accent]Fissure Tapping[]
docs.text:
Schematics for buildings which can utalize Ikaru's various crevices like Vents, Fissures and Growths.

More observation may be required to fully defragment this entry's buildings.

docs.title: [accent]Fluid Extraction[]
docs.text: Filtration methods inspired off Blossoming Elderflesh give way to means of directly obtaining fluids from surface deposits with varying expirimental methods.

docs.title: Fringe
docs.text: Enlightens materials into a useable form.

docs.title: Glacier's Edge
docs.text:
This data point leads to a giant formation of crystalline megaliths.

The fog isn't as thick here, allowing full vission of the terrain.

Conversely, there seem to be trace amounts of resources available, though many friendly signals pop up within the datapoint's bounds.

docs.title: [accent]Item Logistics[]
docs.text:
Schematics for a basic item distribution system and an Item source.

This system is comprised of a system of Chute components which route items from place to place.

docs.title: Lacerated
docs.text:
Heavly reduced mobility and fireate. Increases durability slightly and encourages light regeneration.

Applied by Resonarum related sources. No effect on armored meld or inorganic targets.

docs.title: [accent]Liquid Logistics[]
docs.text:
Schematics for a basic liquid distribution network and an Aether source. The network is comprised of four components.

-Channel Nodes which form the corners and outlets of the network -Channel Faces which connect parts of the network. -Channel Directors which control the direction and pressure of fluids -Aspect Outlets which serve as the endpoint for Aether networks.

Channels can be walked on freely and are stable enough to be placed on deep patches of liquid. The Backdrop will not support Channels.

docs.title: Lonely Creek
docs.text:
This data point leads toward a secluded creek woven between monolithic rock formations.

There are hundreds, maybe thousands of heat signatures in the distance, none of which are recognisable through the fog.

What is this place?

docs.title: Refreshed
docs.text: Doubles reload speed and slightly reduces damage taken. Invokes slight regeneration.

docs.title: Infested
docs.text:
Hefty amount of DoT an' damage taken and dealt is magnified. Doubles... reload speed?

What applies this again? I don't know, but we've got to ru-

docs.title: Shattered Flame
docs.text: Sacrifice is power.

docs.title: Mercury Poisoning
docs.text: Extremely deadly to critters of Meld origin. Effects unknown. TODO: Update this for Strata

docs.title: Mercury Coating
docs.text: Coating of Mercury. Fun! Hey don't eat that-

docs.title: [accent]Mercurial Extraction[]
docs.text:
A group of schematics, all revolving around one thing: Refining raw material into Mercury over geothermal spots.

Intrestingly, there is an outlier. The Electrum Amalgamator.

docs.title: [accent]Murk Handling[]
docs.text:
The Mercury Swamp has proven to be quite hostile in numerous ways, but bessides the outright hostile threats, there have been issues reguarding excess Starving Masses and fluid filtration...

Theese schematics detail a number of ways to handle this, ranging from Compartmentalized Nodes, Filtration Units, Neutralization/Purification Chambers.

Pressurized Dispersion would be helpful to control any accidents.

docs.title: [accent]Power Transmission[]
docs.text:
Schematics for buildings which use Electrum to focus power into lasers, allowing transmission without physical connection. This entry is comprised of three buildings.

-Connectors are a stock standard power node which use Stony Gloop & Compacted Bricks as compared to more abundant materials, allowing them to be built quickly. -Substations are able to both connect over longer distances (but to fewer targets) and store small amounts of power. -Continental Links are able to bridge large sections of the sector in a cardinal direction, and can withstand a large amount of damage.

More observation may be required to fully defragment this entry's buildings.

docs.title: [accent]Pressure Control[]
docs.text: Advanced means of pressure control involving large fluid hubs, pressurized directors, and fluid siphons.

docs.title: [accent]Pressurized Dispersion[]
docs.text:
Getting fluids from point A to B was previously only possible with Channels. Any attempts to shoot Fluids out into the world only created puddles.

With advances in Pressure Control combined with observations about the Mercury Swamp's flora, fluids can now be dispersed into the world with more control over longer distances.

Further advances in technology are required to bridge gaps inside Channel networks or to utalize solid atomized jets.

Murk Handling is greatly helpful to filter out fluids for use by Fluid Sprayers.

docs.title: Ruins
docs.text:
This data point marks the last known location of a Strata instance, and seems to branch out into an almost endless amount of sector groups.

As the campaign is a WIP right now, no sector groups are accessable yet!

docs.title: Shattered
docs.text:
Doubles damage taken and reload speed. Increases damage and mobility.

Applied by Dissonitre related sources. No effect on unarmored meld.

docs.title: [accent]Storage Hubs[]
docs.text:
Details about Buffers and Unloaders, thought to be lost to time.

Plans for massive storage warehouses are encrypted for now...

docs.title: Shellshocked
docs.text: Heavly reduced mobility and fireate. Applied by most sources of EMP.

docs.title: Storm Surge
docs.text: Increased mobility, damage and reload. Applied by most sources of EMP.

docs.title: Rally
docs.text: Increased mobility and reload. Applied by Commanders and Sonars.

docs.title: Primed
docs.text: Increased mobility, damage, reload. Heavly increased health. This unit's ready to go off!

docs.title: Anchored
docs.text: Heavly increased drag and health. Heavly decreased speed. Applied by Movement Anchors

docs.title: Rebound
docs.text: Heavly increased speed, slightly increased reload speed. Decreased drag. Applied by Movement Anchors

docs.title: Strata
docs.text: Utilises Ikaru's basic resources to great effect. This is you!

docs.title: Amplified
docs.text: Amplifies mobility, durability and reload. Applied by Meld Amplifiers.

docs.title: Reconstitution
docs.text: Increases durability and drag. Slightly decreases speed. Light regeneration. Applied by Meld Beacons. Certain constructs spawn with this. Only affects biological targets.

docs.title: Sentry
docs.text: Heavily reduced mobility, but double fireate. Does constant DoT. Certain constructs apply this upon shooting.

docs.title: Surge
docs.text: Massive boost in reload speed, but heavly decreased damage. Certain constructs can intiate a surge with a long cooldown.

docs.title: Dragonfly
docs.text: Revs up a needle launcher when hovering in place.

docs.title: Gala
docs.text: Small blob carrier Caries blobs to wherever they're needed. Sometimes the construct will sacrifice itself, crashing down from the skies to release its blobs on hostiles.

docs.title: Pester
docs.text: Small sprayer flier Blasts targets with a burst of flame. Requires time to recharge. Damages units and buildings caught under its wake.

docs.title: Reef
docs.text: Mines deposits. Slowly regenerates health.

docs.title: Spillway Core
docs.text:
Projectile construct While the core looks inconspicuous at first, two eye indents have been observed.

It is not certain if the core or the spillway controls the unit, but both burst into multiple constructs on destruction.

docs.title: Spillway
docs.text:
First form projectile carrier Birthed in its final form rather than being composed of multiple units, yet bursts open into Craigs and Wubbas..

Reffer to for more information on this construct's center.

docs.title: Tracker Projectile
docs.text: Projectile construct Construct is manufactured inside Tracker constructs and is directed towards its target through some unknown guidance mechanism.

docs.title: Zip
docs.text: Light spawner missile Spotted in swarms that flock between colonies. Beware the Jilla they cary.

docs.title: Afraig
docs.text:
First form bezerking scrap heap When splurging flame, the construct launches itself towards the direction of shooting. Beware Amplified Afraigs.

Armored

docs.title: Allegro
docs.text:
Guardian phalanx nest construct Construct comes with a localised storm projector organ which bursts a cloud of vaporous meld periodically.

Reconstitutes all constructs in range and dissolves nearby enemy units with its spewers, recoiling backwards to stick in front of a defensive perimeter.

FOCUS FIRE AND DESTROY ON SIGHT. DO NOT GET ENGAGE IN CLOSE COMBAT. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED

docs.title: Astrea
docs.text: Launches armor-piercing spines at targets. Crawls over obstructions.

docs.title: Blob
docs.text:
Blob! A blob. What more is there to say?

Blob blob blob blob blob.

Blob!

It explodes after a delay, dealing massive damage. Don'y you remember what happened last time we got near one of tho-

docs.title: Braig
docs.text:
Second form artillery scrap heap The construct stays at range to shoot, while being armed with a Craig's blaster.

Acts as a small seige engine, able to take cover in Meld Capsules & Beacons.

docs.title: Bulwark
docs.text:
First form shielding fulgurian Construct has a small capsule construct encased in a layer of metal. I wonder how it's fueled...

Lightly armored & Mechanical!

docs.title: Craig
docs.text: First form scrap heap Low durability and an unstable weapon, but often comes in swarms.

docs.title: Enforcer
docs.text: Commander of squads during the incursion. Launches sprays of pellets towards targets and missiles with heavy knockback. Can reconstitute itself using appropriate liquids.

docs.title: Fletch
docs.text: First form hovercraft mimic This construct appears to mimic Shark units? Im not sure what it's suposed to be other than that...

docs.title: Gilla
docs.text: Second form crystal bug Bulky form allows the construct to survive longer while spurting flame.

docs.title: Globkin
docs.text:
Guardian skirmisher nest construct

Construct jolts backwards after launching a blast of shrapnel from its cannons, containing several blobs that detonate if not dealt with.

Distract with moble units or drop overseer pings on it to prevent it from recoiling past defensive lines.

Plated!

docs.title: Graig
docs.text:
Megalith nest scrap heap? Observed to birth Craigs en-masse. Armored with multiple of Braig's and Craig's weapons, the construct can defend itself well.

Theorised to be a fragment off of a larger scrap heap.

Heavly armored

docs.title: Hammerhead red[]
docs.text:
Launches piercing shards at enemies, making them take more knockback from other sources. Slowly regenerates from combat.

Can be affected by most helpful effects.

Biological!

PLACEHOLDER SPRITES

docs.title: Iguana
docs.text:
Commander of the Bunker core. Launches out sap vortexes which prime after a short delay. Rallies nearby allies. Quick omnidirectional movement.

Plated

docs.title: Impaler
docs.text:
Pierces targets with shrapnel blasts at short range. Deploys autoturrets from its thorax.

Plated

docs.title: Impovrished
docs.text:
Guardian battery nest construct Construct is an amalgamation of common combat scrap heaps.

Often hides behind other artillery units while using its cannons/snipers to provide fire support. Scatters miniturized Meld Capsules from its tip.

Construct is a dangerous source of attrophy, engage in flanking manuvours and DESTROY on identification.

Plated!

Biomechanical!

docs.title: Inator
docs.text:
First form skirmishing fulgarian Construct is the first observed which has no visible forms of Meld protrusions. Im not sure how it operates...

Fully mechanical!

docs.title: Jilla
docs.text: First form worm/crystal bug Stabalized crystal enables spurting flame indefinitely with no reprecussion.

docs.title: Kathid
docs.text:
First form nestling crystal bug Theories about how Meld forms colonies have circulated around since its discovery.

One theory is armored constructs like Kathids use their piercing flame to penetrate stone, like they do to metal. That woudn't account for the giant rock formations spotted around.

Armored

docs.title: Katika
docs.text:
First form hydra crystal bug Construct appears to be a malformed Kathid without a hardened shell with multiple heads, though there is little evidence to go off of.

Maybe an error in creation propagated by its usefulness?

Despite the appearence, the blob controlling the construct acts as one whole entity.

docs.title: Killa (Armored)
docs.text:
Second form crystal bug Observed to launch dissolving globules at hostile targets, being catapulted away from the threat.

Lightly armored

docs.title: Killa
docs.text: Second form boosting crystal bug Thrusters enable quick movement and resistance to being swept back by wind.

docs.title: Kithlid
docs.text:
Megalith nest crystal bug Construct has been observed constantly pumping out Jilla constructs in missile form when engaging threats.

Whilst Kithlid often turn quickly to face their targets, their ability to do so is hindered when charging up a barage of flame.

Ensure that all parts of a Kithlid are thoughroughly dealt with after breaching the construct's shell.

Heavly armored

docs.title: Narwhal
docs.text:
Launches short-ranged orbital strikes. Hovers over deep bodies of liquid. Charges an energy field channeled from its spike when moving quickly which bounces units away.

If only there was some way to launch them as missiles...

Plated

docs.title: Observer
docs.text: Commander of the Dormant Raft core. Fields a large build radius and Rallies nearby allies. Cannot mine resources, and comes with a reduced build speed.

docs.title: Omega
docs.text:
Commander of the Omega pad. Launches canisters of shrapnel and Rallies nearby allies.

Has a personal shield generator feeding into a force projector which gets faster at lower shield integrety. Can reconstitute itself using appropriate liquids.

docs.title: Ontragga
docs.text:
Second form seige worm Construct creeps foward shielding numerous wuba inside from harm whilst sporting a heavy aether cannon which fires in three round bursts.

This construct is a high priority target and must be taken out before it breaches a defensive perimeter, DO NOT LET IT LEAK.

Plated!

Biomechanical!

docs.title: Outcast
docs.text: Old commander of the Bunker core. Drops whirling mines that sap health from targets hit.

docs.title: Phi
docs.text:
Commander of the Phi pad. Launches armor-piercing spines which release ooze foam upon hitting the ground, and Rallies nearby allies.

Can reconstitute itself using appropriate liquids, or with enough time.

Lightly armored

docs.title: Pointago
docs.text:
Second form incubating scrap heap Construct stays at range after shooting, but will often run fowards afterwards.

Observed to cary an incubator that can form crystals, which the heap consumes for a burst of energy.

docs.title: Poisag
docs.text:
Second form shielding scrap heap Observed launching miniturized Meld Capsules, deploying on hit/near to units.

Dangerous when combined with constructs that can effectively use the protection, or when ammo is limited.

Lightly armored

docs.title: Psi
docs.text:
Commander of the Psi pad. Charges up and fires beams of Aspect, doing devistating damage, and Rallies nearby allies.

Has a personal shield generator which gets faster at lower shield integrety. Can reconstitute itself using appropriate liquids.

docs.title: Purifier
docs.text: Drills through enemy structures and units alike. Can reconstitute itself using appropriate liquids.

docs.title: Remora
docs.text: Launches homing spears which sap target's health, pulling targets further back after traveling a certain distance.

docs.title: Scorcher
docs.text: Small swarmling crystal bug Construct observed to take constant damage while spurting its flame.

docs.title: Shark
docs.text: Launches missiles which sap target's health. Hovers over deep bodies of liquid. An excellent scout. Struggles against force fields.

docs.title: Splurger
docs.text:
Tiny shelled blob They gave the dam blobs armor, why the hell would you give it armor?

If this is some sort of prank like last time I swear ill-

Plated!

docs.title: Stoner
docs.text:
Bulky incindary artillery fulgurian

Construct needs to steady itself in place before unsheathing its weapon. I can't tell if it's impressive that it works or if it's concerning that it has a giant chunk of Dissonitre embedded into it.

Fully mechanical!

docs.title: Time Keeper
docs.text:
Lacerates targets with a spray of particulate resonarum. Slowly regenerates health over time.

Lightly armored

docs.title: Tracker
docs.text:
First form artillery support primitive scrap heap

Construct appears to be a mobile form of an incubator, who's sole purpose is to form projectiles and guide them towards targets.

docs.title: Uwubba
docs.text:
First form kamekaze worm A wuba encased in a stony shell, not too different to an armored killa.

Heavly Armored!

docs.title: Wuba red[]
docs.text:
A large, volatile blob, soon to detonate.

Blob!

docs.title: Wuba
docs.text: First form kamekaze worm When threatened or means of protecting its colony, the construct blasts off its shell and attempts to detonate.

docs.title: Bulbhead
docs.text: Commander of the Raft core. Shoots sonar pulses and Rallies nearby allies. Repairs allied structures. Can reconstitute itself using appropriate liquids, or with enough time.

Before you'll play this mod, let me tell you that skill and patience are highly required.

You need to learn from your mistakes and lost battles in order to complete some sectors.

Welcome to the Frozen farlands,

here, where there is no such thing called heat, Serpulo's Moon Awaits you!

Zilo, a place colonized by Bushark the fraction from Tantros,

Even if that's only a moon there are many new things, new resources, blocks, units, turrets, just everything.

There is one more place we would like you to visit... Gheţar

A Lonely Asteroid orbiting behind Zilo,

Maybe it's a small place but it doesn't means it is going to be easy in there, but surely you'd be having fun...

This mod contains custom soundtracks, please do not steal them... instead get a better vibe while playing

And Thanks to Świrek for helping us with code.

We hope you'll enjoy our mod

This Isn't our last creation, we have a huge plans upcoming, if you are interested in our plans, concepts and updates join our discord server

Our contributtors: RouterXdd, Silin Veredno and Catana8735

link: https://discord.gg/TQTW3mfYyf

We also have it on a disboard.

docs.title: Arcalith Synthesizer

docs.title: Arcanthium Mixer
docs.text: Fabricates Arcanthium from various materials.

docs.title: Cryofabricator

docs.title: Large Arcanthium Wall

docs.title: Large Cryogenium Wall

docs.title: Moonstone Conveyor

docs.title: Inverted Overflow Yttrium Gate

docs.text: A river of Cryofluid with remnants of an old enemy base. Capture it to push back our enemies.

docs.title: The Fortress
docs.text: The greatest base that Bushark has ever built. Many attacks were already launched here, none of which were successful. They have an unimaginably powerful super weapon guarding their main entrance, this base is extremly guarded. The more time you spend defending, the harder it gets. Your base will be constantly attacked, you have to launch succesful counter attacks in order to survive. If you manage to capture this base, the whole of Zilo will be under our control.

docs.title: Frontline
docs.text: We are preparing for our final target, main base of Bushark on Zilo, also known as The Fortress, they already know our plans and they are throwing everything at us, if you will be able to defend yourself, we can launch an attack on The Fortress.

docs.title: Ground Sub Zero
docs.text: The perfect place for your first steps on Zilo, collect new materials, research new technology and destroy the enemy outpost nearby.

docs.title: Lonely Lake
docs.text: A öake of cryofluid located around mountains, Maybe we can use it to research new technologies?

docs.title: Secret Passage
docs.text: Our next primary target is another enemy base located along the sunny mountains, sadly the terrain does not allows us to attack it straight up, we have to get through this claustrophobic ravine...

docs.title: Solar Peaks
docs.text: One of 2 main bases of Bushark on Zilo, their technology far surpasses yours but there is no turning back now, eradicate everything and steal their technology.

docs.title: The Asylum
docs.text: A vast place located on an asteroid. Here, Bushark from Zilo has teamed up with the Crux from Serpulo to get revenge on you. Once you defeat them, the whole asteroid will be under your control. These two factions will not give you an easy victory, you have really made them mad...

docs.text: A cave used for transporting resources and goods, we have to weaken our enemies. Take over this place and eradicate every enemy in your path.
