A personal Serpulo campaign rework map pack with personal minor rebalancing on few blocks.

This mod's gameplay is based on NORMAL difficulty and cannot be changed.

Contains 45+ sectors!

All maps are created under Serpulo environment and are vanilla compatible on terrain , wavesets and most contents.

Have fun.

Update log: V0.5 -- Stage 5-1 to Stage 5-5 added.

--Credits--

Coding:Everdusk22

Sector icon:Seabed

Music selection:しかみど☆

Bundle Polish:Gort
Everything Begins Welcome to Rospule, this is a parallel universe of Serpulo. Collect resources and grasp technologies to gain footstand.

Disadvantage The previous sectors' captures aroused enemy's attention. An immense enemy unit force is heading directly to reclaim control of these sectors. A tough fight is estimated in the chilling valley's exit. Prepare for the worst and survive from the flooding attacks at all costs. 「⚠Massive Enemy Offense⚠」
Frozen Passage This chilling place is closer to enemy activities. Set up automated defenses to ward off enemy patrols.
Taiga A massive frozen pinewood forest lies here. Hostile aerial units detected in the approaching attack. 「Guardian Presence」
Lowlands A low-altitude riverbed with fossilized coals nearby. Gather coal and start to learn the usage of graphite press.
Crossing Point Two different paths cross together, forming into an unpredictable terrain. Learn to use new turrets, figure out enemy paths and successfully defend the sector.

Snowpiled Coalfield Ages ago, the remains of rich plants near the riverbed transformed into gigantic patches of coal. Start using coal to generate power and learn how to use the arc turret. 「Guardian Presence」
Headwaters The headwaters of a flowing stream. Use kilns to produce metaglass, make usage of water via pumps.

Nonfreezing Lake This place is closer to warmer sections. A big round lake that never freezes lies here. Resources are scarcer than previous sectors. Try using pumps to boost the drills to make them mine faster.
Gusty Canyons Multiple rivers flow through this sector, forming into a complex terrain. Use menders to repair damaged blocks. Produce pyratite as advanced ammo for hails. 「Guardian Presence」
Transition Section Closer to warmer areas, the chilling valley's exit leads to a tight sandy passage. Use silicon smelters to refine silicon from sand and coal.

Retaliation The recent sectors' captures completely irritated the enemies. The destruction of their cores has resulted in them sending a huge wave of retaliation units to retake previous sectors. It must be stopped before the units succeed. Prepare for an immense battle at the foot of the mountains. 「⚠Massive Enemy Offense⚠」
Scrapyard Remnants of once several large structures detected. No enemy patrols detected around this sector. Produce enough silicon to depart further. 「Production Sector」

Karst Landscape A sector with moderate enemy amounts. Waters eroded the walls and turned this valley into a beautiful scenery. Some advanced units are coming to this sector. Set up stronger defenses. 「Guardian Presence」
Initial Conflict Enemy bases detected in this sector. Start constructing units to attack enemies proactively. Destroy the enemy cores to take them down.

Ancient Rampart During old times, several conflicts took place here. A frontier rampart was set up for defense, reduced into scraps nowadays. Melt scrap into slag and use it as liquid ammo for wave turret.

Tributary Traveling through the dark sand valley, a long river flows through this sector. Advanced generator unlocked, capable of generating more power. Rospule is getting night times, solar panels are less efficient now. 「Guardian Presence」 「Night Times」
Micro Outpost A set of multiple enemy bases blocked the way to proceed. Use air factory to produce flares to take out the cores.

Outbreak Incubator Once a gigantic facility that produces synthesised bioproducts. During the old war ,this place was abandoned, the spores went out and spread widely. Retake the ancient biomass technologies. Scanners detected only air units in the upcoming attacks. Survive without scatter's assistance.

Exhausted Quarry Mass extractions of this sectors' ore resources resulted in the exhaustion of copper and lead. Produce monos to drill the basic resources automatically. Insectoid units detected, capable of directly walking through thin walls. 「Guardian Presence」

Minefield During old wars, a vast minefield was deployed at the entrance of the mountains. Repair them to use as defense against enemies. All turrets are unavailable , try to survive using shock mines and units only.

Dilemma Looks like the enemies have taken one step ahead this time. An enormous large troop of enemy units have arrived at the sandy karst in advance. They are indeed going to take revenge this time. Another troop of enemy reinforcement is approaching from rear. Prepare for a terrible pincer attack from 2 sides. 「⚠Massive Enemy Offense⚠」
Sharp Crevice Deeper into the mountains, spaces are tighter in this crevice. Titanium ores detected. Use pneumatic drills to mine titanium. 「Night Times」

Leeward Side The ridge blocks the gales on the other side. This mountainside's resources are scarce and far away from estimated landing area. Monos are dispatched to help gather basic resources. A higher level core upgrade is available. 「Guardian Presence」

Giant Dam A giant Gravity Dam was established here ages ago. Enemies took over the region and set up defenses across the dam. Reconstruct the dagger units into stronger maces to destroy enemy defenses. 「Night Times」

Rusty Railtrack A long railway was set up here with unknown purpose. Sensors detected enemies are splitting into 2 paths trying to siege the sector. Naval unit presence detected. Secure the sector with great caution ,use salvo turrets to fend off enemies.
Hotsprings Strong thermals from underground erupted into hotsprings. Sensors detect scarcity in coals. Use salvo and parallax turrets to fend off enemies. 「Guardian Presence」

Observatory A flat space near the summit. Once there was an observatory used for watching stars, now abandoned. Enemies took over this relic and built a base away from low grounds. Heavy anti-air defenses detected. Produce Novas to boost across the terrain to launch a surprise attack.

Petroleum Chasm Shales are rich in petroleum resource here. Coals are absent. Centrifuge coals from oil. Advanced graphite processing technique unlocked. Polies are deployed to assist for building. 「Production Sector」

Collapsed Massifs During an earthquake, a landslide covered some derelicts beneath. Larger quantites of enemies are approaching. Do not underestimate them. Resources are scattered, hard to route to core, polies will be helpful here. 「Guardian Presence」
Wavecut Cliff Strong waves of sea eroded the shores and formed a sharp steep cliff. Larger quantites of enemy naval units are approaching. A larger version of drill unlocked.

Turbulence These damp islands will be a cruel battleground against the enemies' prime naval fleet. The invasion behaviour aroused enemy to deploy all naval units patrolling globalwise. This will be an unprecedented harsh cruel battle, stay attentive and fully focused. 「⚠Massive Enemy Offense⚠」

Tidal Flat A narrow delta lies at the downstreams with damp grounds. Naval units are coming, use containers to work as ammo buffer and use them to increase core storage capacity. Learn the usage of unloaders.

Seaside Promenade Following along the coastlines, a narrow sandy passage provided a path for enemies to approach towards the estimated core landing position. Resources are hard to gather and transfer across islands. Ripple turrets will help with long-range firepower. 「Guardian Presence」
Archipelago Takeover Several islands are under enemy control for now. These bases have fatal weakspots. Construct naval units and horizons to take out them. 「Night Times」

Forsaken Shipyard Once one of the largest shipyards in the seas, now abandoned. This pier has no titanium ores around at all. Construct Separators to refine titanium out of scrap. 「Production Sector」 「Night Times」

Floating Wreckage Remnants of broken metal structures are floating in the middle of ocean. The barren metal pieces are the only option to land on. No resources detected, use loadouts from launched core to make units to defend. 「Guardian Presence」
Quay Skirmish The enemy's biggest transport dock is located in this sector. A gigantic defense base detected, prepare for a long battle. Cryofluid and Plastanium technologies acquired.

Twin Channels Two parallel channels split this region into 3 sections. Enemy units are approaching in multiple directions. Take advantage of the terrain to set up defenses. Plastanium conveyors and Plastanium walls unlocked. 「Night Times」

Uninvited Guest A gigantic exponential tier unit detected in the upcoming attack. Advanced turret and generator unlocked. This unit has equipped with energy laser weapon. Plastanium Walls will be essential to prevent it piercing through. 「Guardian Presence」 「Night Times」
Eastern Coast A gigantic enemy coastal defense array is located at the edge of a barren desert. Produce minkes and oxynoes to help clear out threatening enemy turrets.

Arid Streambed Ages ago, a stream travelled through this place, now vaporized due to drought. Some ancient facilities was set up around the riverbank. Waters have been vaporized in this place. Use Water Extractors to extract groundwater.

Barren Saltmarsh A tremendous salt flat with no ground water. Thoroughly desolated sector with heavy resource poverty. Advanced silicon production technique acquired. A new resource is sensored in this barren desert.
Storage Gateway This place is taken over by the enemies as a resource transport hub. Sabotage the gates with hail turret and demolish the enemies' transport facilities.

Asphalt Deposits Deeper into the deserts, abundant asphalt has formed into tar lakes in this sector. Gather as much resources as possible. Silicon crucibles gain extra effiency when placed on thermal tiles. Take advantage of abundant oil and magma resources.

Property Value Repository https://github.com/3snake3/sapphirium Stars 135 Last updated 2026-06-19T14:18:40Z

Adds a lot of additional content like turrets, factories and other.

docs.title: Blast Workshop
docs.text: The flammable structure of creostone, with the addition of oil with a catalyst, can become a good substitute for blast compounds.

docs.title: Big Dense Smelter
docs.text: A more advanced smelter that uses the blast power of an explosion to increase pressure. It is produced by slag as a by-product.

docs.title: Creostone Crucible
docs.text: With help of creotine, melts silicon into creostone.

docs.title: Creostone Smelter
docs.text: Melts silicon and mixes it with creotite, producing creostone.

docs.title: Creotite Converter
docs.text: Melts silicon and mixes it with creotite, producing creostone. It is produced by metal as a by-product.

docs.title: Creotite Megamixer
docs.text: Updated technologies allow you to get creotite from ledonite, but for this you will have to make a quick temperature jump.

docs.title: Creotite Mixer
docs.text: Melts several thorium isotopes. The molten mass is diluted with cryofluid and does not allow to solidify, then adding powdered pyratite to the mass and heats it up to high temperatures, obtaining creotite.

docs.title: Cryochamber
docs.text: Converts cryofluid into a solid aggregation state. Increases efficiency in moisture areas.

docs.title: Cryofluid Megamixer
docs.text: Mixes water and fine titanium powder, adding ice cubes, producing cryofluid.

docs.title: Dense Smelter
docs.text: Melts copper and lead, producing a dense alloy.

docs.title: Diamond Press
docs.text: Under the influence of high pressure, the carbon compounds transform their crystal lattice to form a diamond.

docs.title: Electromixer
docs.text: Melts surge alloy using slag, obtaining a charged surge mass.

docs.title: Freezer
docs.text: Freezes water obtaining ice.

docs.title: Globium Smelter
docs.text: Melts lead, titanium and thorium, producing globium.

docs.title: Hypercharge Transformer
docs.text: Brings a stone to a hypercharged state using surge mass.

docs.title: Pulse Surge Smelter
docs.text: An improved version of the surge alloy foundry. Uses creotite to increase production efficiency.

docs.title: Glaciation Chamber
docs.text: Transforms Ledonite into its solid aggregation state. Optionally uses ice cubes. Increases efficiency in moisture areas.

docs.title: Ledonite Mixer
docs.text: Mixes cryofluid and fine titanium powder together with ice cubes, producing ledonite.

docs.title: Average Charger
docs.text: Uses surge mass to convert graphite into rods with a significant amount of charge. Elemental Faction: Lightning

docs.title: Mighty Charger
docs.text: Uses surge mass to transform titanium pieces into supercharged ingots. Elemental Faction: Lightning

docs.title: Multicharger
docs.text: It is capable of producing charged wiring using surge mass and a specific resource for a specific wiring.

docs.title: Neoplasm Converter
docs.text: Converts neoplasm and slag into creotine.

docs.title: Neoplasm Furnace
docs.text: Combines tungsten and surge alloy into a carved alloy. Requires argon and heat to work. Produces a huge amount of neoplasm as a byproduct. Explodes violently of neoplasm is not removed from the furnace via conduits.

docs.title: Phase Sewing Synthesizer
docs.text: Synthesizes phase fabric from tinorium and sand. Requires ledonite liquid to work.

docs.title: Plastanium Press
docs.text: It produces plastanium from globium and oil. Uses a blast compound to increase the intensity of production. It is most effective in oil fields.

docs.title: Sapphire Synthesizer
docs.text: Synthesizes tungsten into sapphire. Requires heat to work.

docs.title: Solidification Chamber
docs.text: Cools the slag with water, forming a rocky breed.

docs.title: Surge Mass Synthesizer
docs.text: Melts surge alloy using slag, obtaining a charged surge mass. Uses scrap to melt into slag, which concentrates its amount, increasing production efficiency.

docs.title: Tinorium Crystallizer
docs.text: Crystallizes isotopes of carbon and thorium into a massive radioactive substance «Tinorium».

docs.title: Weak Charger
docs.text: Uses surge mass to convert lead into a charged form. Light wire kind. Elemental Faction: Lightning

docs.title: Armed Creostone Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Burns all enemies nearby when power is provided.

docs.title: Armed Cryo Cube Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Shoots clots of cryofluid at enemy targets when power is provided.

docs.title: Armed Graphite Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Shoots a piercing laser when power is provided.

docs.title: Armed Ice Cube
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Fires at enemies with ice spikes when power is provided.

docs.title: Armed Silicon Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Fires a homing missiles at enemy targets when power is provided.

docs.title: Armed Stone Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Continuously shoots piercing bullets at enemy targets.

docs.title: Armed Surge Stone wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Shoots an explosive shock sphere at enemy targets when power is provided.

docs.title: Carved Monolith
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Absorb lasers and electric arcs. Heals when damaged. Periodically releases 6 piercing blasts around itself upon contact.

docs.title: Large Carved Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Absorb lasers and electric arcs. Heals when damaged.

docs.title: Carved Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Absorb lasers and electric arcs. Heals when damaged.

docs.title: Charged Lead Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Provides power from sun. Periodically releases electric arcs upon contact.

docs.title: Huge Creostone Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Protects a small area around itself with a shield when power is provided.

docs.title: Creostone Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Increases the speed of nearby buildings when power is provided.

docs.title: Cryo Cube Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Freezes all enemies nearby when power is provided.

docs.title: Large Dense Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Armored. Deflect most of enemy bullets.

docs.title: Dense Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Armored.

docs.title: Large Emerald Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Periodically releases upon contact laser bolts that damage enemy targets and repair allied structures.

docs.title: Emerald Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Periodically releases upon contact laser bolts that damage enemy targets and repair allied structures.

docs.title: Large Globium Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Unfolds a square shield that absorbs enemy projectiles when power is provided. Periodically releases electric arcs upon contact.

docs.title: Globium Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Unfolds a square shield that absorbs enemy projectiles when power is provided. Periodically releases electric arcs upon contact.

docs.title: Graphite Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Repairs blocks in its vicinity at high speed when power is provided.

docs.title: Ice Cube Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Absorbs enemy lasers.

docs.title: Reinforced Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Blocks automatic power connections. Absorbs enemy lasers and electric arcs. Periodically releases electric arcs upon contact.

docs.title: Large Ruby Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Throws away the shards with Bloodrage virus after losing a certain amount of health.

docs.title: Ruby Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Throws away the shards with Bloodrage virus after losing a certain amount of health.

docs.title: Large Sapphire Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Absorb lasers and electric arcs. Blocks automatic power connections.

docs.title: Sapphire Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Absorb lasers and electric arcs. Blocks automatic power connections.

docs.title: Silicon Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles.

docs.title: Stone Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles.

docs.title: Surge Stone Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy shells. Periodically releases electric arcs upon contact.

docs.title: Compact Mass Driver
docs.text: Collects items in a small capsule and shoots it at other compact mass drivers.

docs.title: Creostone Bridge Conveyor
docs.text: It moves items over terrain for longer distances than conventional bridge conveyor.

docs.title: Creostone Conveyor
docs.text: Moves items forward. Faster and stronger than titanium conveyor.

docs.title: Creostone Junction
docs.text: Acts as a bridge for two intersecting conveyor belts.

docs.title: Creostone Router
docs.text: Evenly distributes incoming items in 3 output directions.

docs.title: Globium Conveyor
docs.text: Moves items forward at the same speed as the creostone conveyor, but does not accept non-conveyor inputs to the sides.

docs.title: Globium Stack Conveyor
docs.text: Transports items forward in bundles, accommodates up to 25 items.

docs.title: Strong Conveyor
docs.text: Moves items forward. Faster than a standard conveyor, but slower than a titanium one. Has a large amount of health.

docs.title: Strong Junction
docs.text: Acts as a bridge for two intersecting conveyor belts. Stronger than a standard junction.

docs.title: Strong Router
docs.text: Evenly distributes incoming items in 3 output directions. Stronger than a standard router.

docs.title: Teleporter
docs.text: Technology for instant movement of items. Transports items from one teleporter to another.

docs.title: Armored Container
docs.text: Stores a small number of items of each type. Items can be removed using an unloader. Well fortified.

docs.title: Armored Storage
docs.text: Stores a large number of items of each type. Items can be removed using an unloader. Well fortified.

docs.title: Core: Cage
docs.text: Core of the base. It is more heavily armored than all previous iterations. It stores more items than Nucleus. Provides power.

docs.title: Core: Energon
docs.text: Core of the base. Heavily armored. Stores the largest amount of resources. Fires charged shells at enemy targets. Periodically releases a piercing blasts upon contact. Equipped with an energy field. Branch: Carved alloy

docs.title: Core: Ocean
docs.text: Mobile core of the base. Can be build regardless of the main core. Elemental Faction: Water

docs.title: Core: Purple Night
docs.text: Core of the base. Very well armored. Stores a large number of items. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Core: Triumph
docs.text: Core of the base. Stores items.

docs.title: Core: Victory
docs.text: Core of the base. Stores items. Elemental Faction: Lightning

docs.title: Creostone Mine
docs.text: Explodes upon contact with an enemy unit.

docs.title: Creostone Storage
docs.text: Stores items. Very durable.

docs.title: Crystal Accelerator
docs.text: Increases the speed of nearby buildings. Requires phase fabric and ruby to operate. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Emerald Core
docs.text: Mobile core of the base. Can be build regardless of the main core. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Energy Field Projector
docs.text: Hits enemy targets with electric arcs in a radius. Produces «Thunderbolt» units.

docs.title: Energy Field Projector
docs.text: Stuns all enemies trapped in the radius of the energy field.

docs.title: Flashlight
docs.text: Emits bright light over a large radius.

docs.title: Indigo Barrier
docs.text: Unfolds an octagonal shield protecting buildings and units from enemy projectiles. Overheats when receiving a large amount of damage. Optionally uses coolant to prevent overheating. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Sapphire Restorer
docs.text: Repairs blocks in its vicinity. Optionally uses phase fabric to boost range and efficiency. Branch: Sapphire

docs.title: Scarlet Gem
docs.text: Mobile core of the base. Can be build regardless of the main core. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Core: Snow Monolith
docs.text: Mobile core of the base. Can be build regardless of the main core. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Core: Tesla
docs.text: Core of the base. Armored. Generates a small amount of power. Heals if damaged. Branch: Sapphire

docs.title: Armored Liquid Container
docs.text: Stores a small amount of liquid. It outputs liquids in all directions, like a liquid router. Well fortified.

docs.title: Armored Liquid Tank
docs.text: Stores a large amount of liquid. It outputs liquids in all directions, like a liquid router. Well fortified.

docs.title: Creostone Bridge Conduit
docs.text: It moves liquids over the terrain for longer distances than a standard bridge conduit.

docs.title: Creostone Conduit
docs.text: Moves liquids forward. Faster, stronger and accommodates more than a pulse conduit.

docs.title: Creostone Liquid Junction
docs.text: Acts as a bridge between two crossing conduits.

docs.title: Creostone Liquid Router
docs.text: Accepts liquids from one direction and distributes them evenly to 3 others. It can also store a certain amount of liquid. It is possible to build on deep water. Has a large amount of health.

docs.title: Globium Conduit
docs.text: Designed for high-speed movement of a large amount of liquid.

docs.title: Strong Conduit
docs.text: Moves liquids forward. It works faster and accommodates more than a standard conduit, but less than pulse one.

docs.title: Topaz Bridge Conduit
docs.text: Moves liquids over any terrain or buildings. Has a smaller capacity and greater strength than a reinforced bridge conduit. Distributes the liquid output evenly to the sides. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Topaz Conduit
docs.text: Moves liquids forward. Faster, stronger, and accommodates more than reinforced conduit. Accepts input/output from the sides. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Topaz Liquid Junction
docs.text: Acts as a junction for two intersecting conduits. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Topaz Liquid Router
docs.text: Distributes liquids evenly in all directions. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Upgraded Pump
docs.text: Pumps and removes liquids.

docs.title: Charge Reactor
docs.text: Accelerates, generating a huge amount of power using a charge of surge mass. The stronger the acceleration, the more power is generated. It will explode with great power with sufficient damage. Uses ice cubes for cooling.

docs.title: Copper Transformer
docs.text: Transforms copper into power particles.

docs.title: Creostone Battery
docs.text: Accumulates power in times of its excess. Removes power in times of scarcity. Stores a significantly large amount of power, has quite a few health units.

docs.title: Creostone Beam Node
docs.text: Transmits power to other blocks orthogonally. Stores a decent amount of power.

docs.title: Creostone Beam Tower
docs.text: Transmits power to other blocks orthogonally. Stores a huge amount of power. Larger distance of transmission.

docs.title: Large Creostone Power Node
docs.text: Transmits power to the connected nodes. Larger distance of transmission.

docs.title: Creostone Power Node
docs.text: Transmits power to the connected nodes. Transmission distance is greater than the usual power node.

docs.title: Creostone Power Tower
docs.text: Transmits power to the connected nodes. Very large transmission distance, fewer connections.

docs.title: Creostone Reactor
docs.text: Generates significant amounts of power from creostone. Requires constant cooling. Will explode violently if insufficient amounts of coolant are supplied.

docs.title: Creostone Solar Panel
docs.text: Provides power from sun and wind.

docs.title: Creotine Combustion Chamber
docs.text: Uses creostone and creotine to generate power. Requires placement on the vents.

docs.title: Hidden Power Node
docs.text: Transmits power to the connected nodes. Hidden from enemy attacks.

docs.title: Hydrogenerator
docs.text: Generates power when placed in wet places.

docs.title: Matter Collapser
docs.text: A reactor operating with a cost of each resources and liquids temperature. Higher items cost and liquids temperature, the higher power generation. Requires a lot of time to accelerate to max power generation. Due to the very high voltage, the reactor emits electric arcs, which damages reactor and can lead to an explosion. To prevent an explosion, reactor needs constant monitoring, repair, and isolation from nearby buildings. Will explode with great power upon destruction.

docs.title: Mineralizer
docs.text: Accelerates amethyst particles using ozone to generate a considerable amount of power. Get damaged in the process, needs constant repair. Will explode with great power when destroyed.

docs.title: Oil Transformer
docs.text: Generates power when placed in oil-containing places.

docs.title: Rift Borehole
docs.text: Generates power when placed on gas rifts. Produces a small amount of argon.

docs.title: Ruby Cleaver
docs.text: Splits ruby to an atomic state, generating a large amount of power. Uses argon as a stabilizer.

docs.title: Medium Solar Panel
docs.text: Provides power from the sun.

docs.title: Spore Generator
docs.text: Generates power when placed in spore-containing areas.

docs.title: Strong Power Node
docs.text: Transmits power to the connected nodes. Stronger than a large power node, but the transmission distance is smaller.

docs.title: Argon Borehole
docs.text: Extracts argon from the rifts and place it to a gas tank.

docs.title: Incandescent Drill
docs.text: A special drill for extracting pieces of creostone. It is also capable of extracting ordinary ore. Uses the heat of the creotite as an accelerator.

docs.title: Emerald Extractor
docs.text: Extracts emerald from the ground. Requires cryofluid and cryo cube for extraction.

docs.title: Light Drilling Rig
docs.text: Has a built-in light plant, which, from the absorption of electromagnetic waves, accelerates to a tremendous speed, extracting a huge amount of resources. Uses ledonite liquid as a mandatory component for cooling.

docs.title: Lightning Drill
docs.text: Mines ore. It requires a fairly large amount of power. Optionally uses ledonite for coolant.

docs.title: Oil Pump
docs.text: Pumps oil out of the ground, improves efficiency in oil fields.

docs.title: Ruby Drill
docs.text: A new type of drill, capable of synthesizing rubies under impacts, requires flow cooling and fuel for operation.

docs.title: Sand Mine
docs.text: Drills and extracts sand from the ground. Requires water to work.

docs.title: Small Drill
docs.text: When placed on ore, outputs items at a slow pace indefinitely. Only capable of mining basic resources. Does not require cooling.

docs.title: Spore Extractor
docs.text: Grows tiny concentrations of atmospheric spores into spore pods. Uses ice cubes to increase the efficiency of cultivation.

docs.title: Thorium Mine
docs.text: The explosion extracts thorium from the ground, using a blast compound as an explosion reactor. Uses cryofluid for cooling.

docs.title: Titanium Extractor
docs.text: Extracts titanium from the ground. Requires water for extraction.

docs.title: Topaz Mine
docs.text: Extracts topaz from underground along with impurities in the form of sand and beryllium. Requires placement on topaz veins, and argon for operation.

docs.title: Abyss
docs.text: Sapping and damages all enemy targets. Spawns auxiliary creatures. Bigger target - higher damage. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Addiction
docs.text: Fires a burst of piercing projectiles, unmoving all enemies in a row with a laser. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Adynamia
docs.text: Fires a charged thorium or tinonium laser bullets. Spawns an Absorbtion unit, protecting it self with an arc shield. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Aorta
docs.text: Opens and fires an exploding sphere, next releasing a huge accumulation of shells of various types, causing huge damage to enemy targets. Infects enemy units with the Bloodrage virus. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Bloodlust
docs.text: Fires a large ruby bolts over long distances. Fires a bloody beams at enemy targets, repairing itself in the process. Infects enemy units with the Bloodrage virus. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Bow
docs.text: Fires a homing piercing arrows at enemy aircraft. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Brazier
docs.text: Transforms power into a beam charge containing particles of gold dust, and burns out all enemies that fall under its action. Transforms surge mass into energy clumps, directing them along the beam and causing additional damage to enemy targets. Faction: Golden Thread

docs.title: Cast
docs.text: Fires a piercing bullets at enemies. Faction: Dart

docs.title: Cloud Breaker
docs.text: Fires an explosive shells at enemy targets. Commits fire punch at enemy targets in radius, spawning creatures named glaive of fire. Elemental Faction: Fire

docs.title: Corroding
docs.text: Fires a burst of acid homing shells at enemy targets. Pierce enemy sheilds and armor. Elemental Faction: Acid

docs.title: Crackle
docs.text:
Sapphire: Shoots pairs of homing shells at enemy targets. Carved Alloy: Shoots pairs of long-range shells that shatter upon contact into two super-piercing fragments. Periodically stops enemy units at the short time.

It has a built-in repair projector. In passive (inactive) state, repairs allied buildings and units in radius, while in the active state accumulates additional percentages for repairs. Requires hydrogen to work. Branch: Sapphire

docs.title: Cruelty
docs.text: Shoots a barrage of tungsten armor-piercing shells, periodically releasing a shell, which increases its damage with each shot that resets by reaching certain point. Requires a lot of heat and creotine to work. It gets damaged in the process. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Curvature
docs.text: Shoots a piercing blast at enemy targets. Throws piercing diamond shards at enemy targets, pulling the shards back. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Dawn
docs.text: Surge Alloy: Fires a shell releasing piercing blasts at enemy targets. Carved Alloy: Fires a massive explosive ball releasing a lot of energy particles. Branch: Carved alloy

docs.title: Decay
docs.text: Fires a clusters of shells at ground targets. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Devotion
docs.text: Shoots an explosive energy ball at enemy targets. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Discharge
docs.text: Shoots high-speed shock bullets at enemy targets. Overdrive nearby buildings and units. Faction: Beam

docs.title: Draw
docs.text: Makes a hit with blades, creating a piercing enemy targets blow. Breaking in the blade, the light takes the shape of the past. At the moment of impact, tearing the metal, inside the gap of the sword, you can see hundreds of battles that we will never remember. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Dublicity
docs.text: Shoots long-range erupting projectiles at enemy targets. Branch: Creostone

docs.title: Dune
docs.text: Fires a bouncing shells from silicon or creostone at enemy targets. Sand shells crumble at the first impact, slowing down enemy units. Faction: Sandbank

docs.title: Electron
docs.text: Causes overload on the attacked enemy unit, damaging it in the process. Faction: Beam

docs.title: Elimination
docs.text: Fires an armor-piercing supersonic frag shell at enemy targets. Branch: Carved alloy

docs.title: Emerald EMP Cannon
docs.text: Fires explosive EMP projectile, dealing significant damage to enemy targets and repairing allied structures. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Endoxin
docs.text: Fires a large acid homing missiles at enemies. Elemental Faction: Acid

docs.title: Enlightenment
docs.text: Shoots a homing missile, spraying nearby gold dust on enemy targets. Faction: Golden Thread

docs.title: Erazor
docs.text: Fires a high-speed piercing energy blade at enemy targets. Branch: Carved alloy

docs.title: Combat Plant: Everfrost
docs.text: Fires a converted into a solid single-target crystal substance ledonite at ground targets. An impact mechanism is installed in the center, covering the area with a very cold frost. Creates a drone Shielder. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Executioner
docs.text: Prototype of a heavy ion weapon, high frequencies of radiation pass through the bodies of enemies and cause serious damage to electronics, disabling it.

docs.title: [#f25555]Failure[]
docs.text: Fires homing piercing ruby shard at enemy targets. Open the gate summoning special «Extinction» units with a certain chance.

docs.title: Fallen
docs.text: Transforms creotite substance into a steel-burning jet of the flame, directing it at enemy targets. Elemental Faction: Fire

docs.title: Flame
docs.text: Fires a burning bullets at enemy ground and aircraft, releasing a small fiery stream from the center. Elemental Faction: Fire

docs.title: Flight
docs.text: Fires a a swarm of small homing missiles at enemy targets. Prioritizes farthest enemies. Faction: Dart

docs.title: Frostbite
docs.text: Creates frag missiles from pieces of frozen liquid and fires at enemies. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Glow
docs.text: Crystallizes atmospheric moisture into ice pins and fires them at enemies, piercing them. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Golden Horn
docs.text: The middle turret with a funny attack mechanism is effective against the crowd and is necessary to break through the back rows of enemy structures. Faction: Golden Thread

docs.title: Greed
docs.text: Creates an energy needle piercing enemy targets, gradually increasing damage to a certain point and resetting it to its initial values. Damaged in the process. Requires argon to work. Branch: Topaz

docs.title: Hawk
docs.text: Fires a long-range laser shell at enemy aircraft. Infects enemy units with the Bloodrage virus. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Heat
docs.text: Fires a burst of explosive projectiles at enemy targets. Elemental Faction: Fire

docs.title: Hoarfrost
docs.text: Fires an energy homing projectiles that cut through the air, create hoarfrost and pierce enemies. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Icicle
docs.text: Crystallizes moisture into a freezing and piercing enemies beam. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Impaler
docs.text: Charges chunks of frozen liquid and launches at enemies, piercing them. Crystallizes atmospheric moisture into a fragment that pierce and overfreeze enemies. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Inevitability
docs.text: Creates heavy amethyst needles capable of tearing and binding space itself. Branch: Amethyst

docs.title: Infinite Laser Array
docs.text: Continuously fires a laser beam at nearby enemies. Faction: Golden Thread

docs.title: Injection
docs.text: Fires a piercing bullets at enemies. Periodically fires a piercing laser. Infects enemy units with the Bloodrage virus. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Launch
docs.text: Fires a homing high-speed missiles at enemies. Uses standard resources as ammunition. Faction: Dart

docs.title: Melinite
docs.text: Fires an acid bullets at enemies. Elemental Faction: Acid

docs.title: Multimortar
docs.text: Fires an artillery volley at ground targets. Branch: Carved alloy

docs.title: Needle
docs.text: Fires a long-range piercing railgun bolt at enemy targets. Elemental Faction: Fire

docs.title: North
docs.text: Fires freezing streams of energy at enemies. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: [#fc8e6d]Oblivion[]
docs.text: Charges and fires a destructive sphere, hitting a large area. Open the gate summoning special units «Loss».

docs.title: Perfection
docs.text: Fires a high-energy erupting projectile, piercing enemies.

docs.title: Pierce
docs.text: Fires a burst of spheres, releasing a powerful piercing energy beam. Spawns Jerk units. Overdrive nearest buildings and units. Faction: Beam

docs.title: Pulse
docs.text: Fires a laser bolt that damages enemies and repairs allied buildings. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Punch
docs.text: Fires a sapping explosive spheres at enemy targets. Elemental Faction: Shadow

docs.title: Pyramid
docs.text: Fires a barrage of heavy frag artillery at ground targets. Faction: Sandbank

docs.title: Radiance
docs.text: Creates a mini-star that explodes on the spot several times.

docs.title: Rainfall
docs.text: Fires a homing armor piercing missiles formed from the water at enemy aircraft. Elemental Faction: Water

docs.title: Reagent
docs.text: Fires an acid piercing shells and missiles at enemy targets. Elemental Faction: Acid

docs.title: Release
docs.text: Fires a sphere at enemy targets. The sphere is unstable, without reaching the target, it explodes and regenerates again, reaches the target and damages it, if the target is allied, repairs it. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Reproduction
docs.text: Fires a bullets from pieces of frozen liquid at enemies. Faction: Indigo

docs.title: Revival
docs.text: Fires a long-range emerald projectile that damages and immobilizes one target, and repairs allied buildings. The projectile splits into several homing energy clusters with repairing properties upon contact. Faction: Emerald Light

docs.title: Sand Thrower
docs.text: Fires a heavy shells from sand or stone at enemy targets. Faction: Sandbank

docs.title: Sand Turret
docs.text: Shoots clusters of shells from sand or coal at ground targets. Faction: Sandbank

docs.title: Scarlet Star
docs.text: Charges and fires an energy sphere at ground targets. Infects enemy units with the Bloodrage virus. Faction: Crimson Agate

docs.title: Shelter
docs.text: Shoots continuous streams of flame at enemy targets. Pierce armor. It has a built-in repair projector, which in a passive state repairs nearby allied buildings and units, and in active state accumulates additional percentages for repairs. Branch: Sapphire

docs.title: Shine
docs.text: Fires a pieces of lead or diamond at enemies. Creates a Diamond Drone. Elemental Faction: Light

docs.title: Shock
docs.text: Fires a pairs of electric bullets at enemies. Overdrive nearby buildings and units. Faction: Beam

docs.title: Skull

docs.title: Silisteel Tank
docs.text: Double hollow insulated housing for safer storage of large quantities of hazardous liquids.

docs.title: Tidal Pump
docs.text: Step-by-step liquid pump, a miracle of gravitational engineering.

docs.title: Arc Fission Reactor
docs.text: Forcibly tears out the radioactive energy that should be released slowly in a short period of time, which brings extremely high energy peaks in a short period of time, but is not suitable as the main facility for long-term energy supply.

docs.title: Reinforced Discordance Capacitor
docs.text: A advanced battery with higher power capacity and heavy armor.

docs.title: Plated Node
docs.text: A chromium coated node with more links and longer reach. Can placed on water.

docs.title: Coal Pyrolyzer
docs.text: Coal is gasified using water and high-temperature pyrolysis to output a small amount of gas.

docs.title: Discordance Tower
docs.text: Long-distance transmission with UHV effectively reduces power loss.

docs.title: Fermium Reactor
docs.text: Uses the strong radioactivity of fermium to produce energy. Requires constant cooling. Overheating or being destroyed can cause a violent explosion.

docs.title: Fission Reactor
docs.text: Powerful reactor that creates a vacuum inside to start a chain reaction to harvest large amounts of energy Please keep their location safe! Otherwise, all traces of both the enemy and ourselves in the vicinity will be erased.

docs.title: Gas Generator
docs.text: Excess gas is recovered to produce a small amount of electricity.

docs.title: Gas Turbine
docs.text: Needs warmup, produce more power when fully booted.

docs.title: Geothermal Generator
docs.text: Large geothermal generator that very efficiently uses geothermal energy.

docs.title: Environmental Radiation Generators
docs.text: Similar to geothermal generators, but it uses a radiant environment to generate electricity.

docs.title: Air Collector
docs.text: Slowly collect the atmosphere and compress it to extract nitrogen gas for industrial scale.

docs.title: Blasting Drilling Rig
docs.text: Injected blast-reagent into the formation for blasted mining, and output in batches at medium speeds. Warning: It is strictly forbidden to mine radioactive ores in a high-density state!

docs.title: Pressure Energy Drill
docs.text: Basic electric drill bit with a large volume. The more surplus energy available in the grid, the faster it can be drilled. When the surplus power in the grid is greater than required for normal operation, the efficiency of the drill bit will gradually increase.

docs.title: 岩隙提气机
docs.text: 在含油裂隙上提取燃气，需要消耗电力。

docs.title: Crankshaft Drill
docs.text: Generates huge torqe by high-power motor. Can crush and extracte even harder minerals like chromium. Needs more time to warmup. When the surplus power in the grid is greater than required for normal operation, the efficiency of the drill bit will gradually increase.

docs.title: Pneumatic Oil Pump
docs.text: Inject high-pressure nitrogen into oil-bearing formations to quickly extract a lot of oil.

docs.title: Quantum Ore Extractor
docs.text: Transferres minerals directly from the ground with a longer warm-up time. Constantly supply of coolant is required. Can be placed on water.

docs.title: Greenhouse Petri dishes
docs.text: The gaseous composition produced by combustion seems to favor the life activity of the spores, which can be rapidly propagated in large quantities in a closed greenhouse environment.

docs.title: Heavy Water Extractor
docs.text: Needs more power and time to warmup.

docs.title: Frostorm
docs.text: Shoots cryogenic projectiles that inflict freezing at enemies.

docs.title: Spear
docs.text: Launches homing missiles or impact rockets at enemies.

docs.title: Bugtide
docs.text: Releases a unstable nanoenergy bomb at the weakest enemies within its range, healing damaged buildings and scrambles enemies. Ammo will passes through the force shield.

docs.title: Cloudbreaker
docs.text: Fires high-velocity armor-piercing shells at enemy targets over long distances.

docs.title: Rapier
docs.text: Rapidly fires moderate-ranged shield-piercing blasts at enemy targets.

docs.title: Hazexcluder
docs.text: Fires phased-bond armor-piercing shells at enemy targets. Requires exotic material for ammunition and has a high ammo consumption rate. Can destroy a heavy-armored unit in a blink of an eye.

docs.title: Stabber
docs.text: An anti-air shotgun that fires hitscan blast flak at enemy air targets.

docs.title: Dislocation
docs.text: Releases powerful phasic shockwaves that can easily shred shields and enemy units.

docs.title: Arrow
docs.text: Fires heat cannon.

docs.title: sfire-mod-dianji
docs.text: Use the Ion Focus Generator to continuously bombard enemies.

docs.title: Tyndall
docs.text: Anti-air turret that rapidly fires piercing energy bullets.

docs.title: Caelum
docs.text: Launches long-range anti-air missiles at enemy air targets. The missile can continue to fly for some distance after leaving range, and can assist in guidance.

docs.title: Violence
docs.text: Fires a massive hail of energy projectiles that disrupts enemy weapon systems and temporarily disarm them. Requires cryofluid to operate.

docs.title: Gauss
docs.text: Fires plasma shells to slow down the target and deal damage.

docs.title: Chronoma
docs.text: Fires bursts of powerful energy projectiles at enemies that explodes on impact and inflicts breakdown debuff.

docs.title: Buster
docs.text: Fires medium-range guided rockets at enemies over long distances.

docs.title: Broadsword
docs.text: Powerful short-range fragmentation turret that effectively knocks back enemy units.

docs.title: Anarchy
docs.text: Fires a large energy round that explodes into a cluster of exploding energy encompassing a very wide area. Has very slow fire rate. Recommend to use with coolant.

docs.title: Thunder
docs.text: Fires long-range missiles in bursts of 6 at enemy ground targets. Defenseless against close-range targets.

docs.title: Impactor
docs.text: Chrage and fires scrambled bullets.

docs.title: Hyacinth
docs.text: A heavy multibarrel artillery.Releases a burst of inaccuate impact shells to enemies. Effective against groups of low-tier units. Ammo will passes through the force shield.

docs.title: Tempest
docs.text: Fires two large charged orbs that move in a sine wave pattern while sweeping the area infront of them with sub-projectiles. Has varying effects depending on loaded ammunition.

docs.title: Incineration
docs.text: Spews a stream of flame at enemies nearby.

docs.title: Lightpiercer
docs.text: Hurls a massive deadly armor piercing shell to enemies.

docs.title: Wanderer
docs.text: Experimental proton cannon. Launches hydrogen ions cased in pure energy to trigger particle collapse to melt enemies.

docs.title: Mammoth
docs.text: Fires medium shells at ground targets.

docs.title: Minigun
docs.text: Liquid-cooled dual machinegun turret.

docs.title: Dawnbreak
docs.text: Charges and fires a massive laser blast. Cannot effectively damage enemy structures.

docs.title: Tranquillity
docs.text: Shoots a pair of scrambling frag bullets at enemies. Can disrupt enemies' weapon system for a short period of time.

docs.title: Prognostic
docs.text: Charges and fires a concentrated energy beam that explodes on hit.

docs.title: Deathstroke
docs.text: A technologically sophisticated railgun that shoots a precise lethal single target bolt over emmence distance.

docs.title: Stream
docs.text: Jet short-range armor-piercing metal jet

docs.title: Turbulence
docs.text: Sprays turbocharged, knockbacking streams of liquids at enemies. Automatically extinguishes fires when supplied with water. Using nanofluidas ammo will fires actived nanofluid!

docs.title: Harbinger
docs.text: Fires small energy rounds that inflict scramble at the enemy.

docs.title: Phantasm
docs.text: Fires huge bullets at air and ground targets that also knockbacks them.

docs.title: Oracle
docs.text: Charges and rapidly fires a massive volley of fission bombs.Requires large amounts of power and coolant to operate.

docs.title: Electrodile Assembler
docs.text: Assembles Electrodile unit

docs.title: Unit Maintenance Depot
docs.text: Quickly repairs nearby damaged unit within it vicinity. Needs Nanafluid to operate.

docs.title: Containment Forge
docs.text: Forges containment blocks for unit construction.

docs.title: Pentative Reconstructor
docs.text: Upgrades inputted units into the sixth tier.

docs.title: Specialist Factory
docs.text: Produces advanced combat units. Outputted units can be used directly or moved into reconstructors for upgrading.

docs.title: Terrascape Construction Bay
docs.text: Assembles "Terrascape"

docs.title: Chromium
docs.text: It is hard but partially brittle, and is often used in high-grade metal processing or heavy-duty armor fragmentation.

docs.title: Cluster Explosive
docs.text: Used as weapon ammunition only. Flammable and explosive.

docs.title: Crystal Gallium
docs.text: 过冷制成固态的镓。用于制造先进电气元件，柔性结构，导热器以及特殊保护涂层。

docs.title: Discordance Phase Energy
docs.text: Over-energized and unstable, used as long-range teleportation or high-energy armor-breaking bullets. It is highly compatible with the energy container of Taylor carriers and can be used to increase the energy density of Taylor carriers.

docs.title: Fermium
docs.text: Used in highly durable structures with high heat resistant armor, penetrating chemical incendiary munitions and fission reactors.

docs.title: Leippium Alloy
docs.text: Alloys with extremely high relative hardness. Used for advanced armor, ammunition and permanent building structures.

docs.title: Lens
docs.text: Used in high-grade lasers or semiconductor photosensing elements. Commonly found in weapons-grade laser deflectors.

docs.title: Memory Alloy
docs.text: 柔韧坚固，用于先进自维持结构与柔性保护层。

docs.title: Nanocore
docs.text: Fine nanomaterials, used to repair and strengthen buildings and jamming type munitions.

docs.title: Rare Earth
docs.text: It is used to refine a variety of rare metal elements or porous adsorption fillers.

docs.title: Rubidium
docs.text: High-quality natural metal with strong electromagnetic properties, which enables it to be applied to some high-risk fluid industries. It is used as a magnetic part such as a large magnetic stirrer and a blocking lock.

docs.title: Silisteel
docs.text: An inexpensive alloy with low flux, high magnetic permeability, and certain plasticity. Versatile.

docs.title: Strontium
docs.text: Flammable metal elements, used for reaction armor, special warheads, and ignition components.

docs.title: Tayrium Alloy
docs.text: A dense and hard alloy with strong electromagnetic properties. Used as a short-term high-energy capacitor.

docs.title: Wavesteel
docs.text: High-performance lightweight structural materials that can maintain strength over a wide range of temperatures without metal fatigue after a period of use. Versatile.

docs.title: Actived Nanofluid
docs.text: An extremely dangerous material, can assimilate nearby cryofluid and slowly erode buildings. Need to be controlled in time.

docs.title: Blast Reagent
docs.text: It can be molded and stabilized explosives, used as ramjet fuel or filled with explosive warheads.

docs.title: Gas
docs.text: Combustible gas, not easy to explode in high-purity storage, compressed for cutting and welding and other high-temperature hot operations.

docs.title: Nanofluid
docs.text: Used as a rapid heat dissipation for reactors and casemates and well as paralyzing ammunition and repair mechanisms.

docs.title: Nitrate
docs.text: Strong acid, used for metal etching to soften or as a weapon ammunition to spray at the enemy.

docs.title: Nitrated Oil
docs.text: Used for industrial production to extract explosive substances in it.

docs.title: Frozen Front
docs.text: todo

docs.title: Deconstruction
docs.text: Nanocores, son!

docs.title: Fast Build
docs.text: Nanocores, son!

docs.title: Over Load
docs.text: Energy system overloaded, weapon firepower upgrade, system stability offline

docs.title: Fast Repair
docs.text: Nanocores, son!

docs.title: Repair
docs.text: Nanocores, son!

docs.title: Siege
docs.text: Technically a weaker version of boss.

docs.title: Silence
docs.text: A scout drone with quad machine gun. Has a small force field.

docs.title: Blade
docs.text: Standardized light escort ships equipped with laser illumination cannons and cruise missile systems. Able to intercept nearby entity ammo and repair nearby units.

docs.title: Porter
docs.text: Carries large payloads over the battlefield. Equiped with a acid sprayer.

docs.title: Circulation
docs.text: Rapidly fires energy and pulse projectile volleys at enemies.

docs.title: Cirrus
docs.text: Launches electromagnetic energy bombs and thunderstorm generators. Has a small force shield.

docs.title: Convection
docs.text: 发射磁扰波束。

docs.title: Cumulus
docs.text: Launches high-energy beams with incendiary missiles.

docs.title: Engineer
docs.text: Automatically rebuilds destroyed structures and assists other units in construction. Fires paralyzing laser and nanoshots at enemies. Slowly repairs nearby units.

docs.title: Antagonist
docs.text: Elite bombardment unit. Carries multiple missile launchers.

docs.title: Hepta
docs.text: Heals allied units and shocks enemy units in its resurrection field. Has a huge payload cargo.

docs.title: Omega
docs.text: Protection of the Supreme Command Center. Rapid construction capabilities. Fires armor-piercing incendiary bullets and missiles.

docs.title: Sleet
docs.text: Fires a cryogenic beam that slows enemies in their path and deals minor damage.

docs.title: Stratosphere
docs.text: Drop heavy EMP bombs and heavy incendiary bombs. Equipped with autonomous cryo-beam autocannons. Able to carry units for airborne operations.

docs.title: Sundown
docs.text: Fires frag flak barrage and Long-range cruise missiles at enemies.

docs.title: Tau
docs.text: Defends the Core Industry from enemies. Builds structures.

docs.title: 阔野
docs.text: 投送超载引力发生器与光子导弹。间歇性发射冲击束，配备空域静电场。

docs.title: Thunder
docs.text: Fires pulsing projectiles and lightning sphere generators. The armor is heavy but the body is a bit fragile, so watch out for the enemy's heavy anti-air turrets.

docs.title: Artillery UTV
docs.text: UTV-base artillery with a nano-regen system. Can't cross deep liquids. A powerful ground-ground firepower.

docs.title: Commander UTV
docs.text: UTV-base portable radar. Can cross deep liquids. Buffs nearby units. Being destroyed will cause us to lose control of the battlefield in the area, so be sure to protect it!

docs.title: Defender UTV
docs.text: UTV-base point defense with a regenerating shield. Can cross deep liquids. Apply defense to nearby units.

docs.title: AA UTV
docs.text: UTV-base anti-air missile launcher with a nano-regen system. Can cross deep liquids. A powerful anti-air firepower.

docs.title: UTV
docs.text: A universal transport vehicle. Equipped with self-defense proton autocannon and extra armor plating. Can cross deep liquids.

docs.title: Agelenid
docs.text: Launches dragon rocket and laser barrage at enemies, repair itself in the process. Good at sustained combat.

docs.title: Swamp
docs.text: Fire lasers and impact cannon. Apply shielded to nearby units. Can cross liquids.

docs.title: Electrodile
docs.text: A swifty hover artillery platform. Equiped with a tri-barreled electroartillery.

docs.title: Enforcer
docs.text: Fires ultra-long-range armor-piercing shock shells. Able to crush buildings.

docs.title: Executioner
docs.text: Fires bursts of powerful energy projectiles at enemies that explodes on impact and inflicts breakdown debuff. Able to crush buildings.

docs.title: Flamer
docs.text: Fires pyro-grenades and ethylene-powered flamethower.

docs.title: Flanker
docs.text: Fires AP shock shells. Able to crush buildings.

docs.title: Hammer
docs.text: Fires large-caliber howitzers at ground targets. Can step over most terrain and water.

docs.title: Gatebreaker
docs.text: A missile with legs. Launches itself towards your defence line and take down menders.

docs.title: Libra
docs.text: Jumps energy bombs and fires massive laser beams to destroy enemies and repair friendly buildings. Buffer allied units. Good at breaking large blocks.

docs.title: Ordinance
docs.text: Fires giant armor-piercing explosive shells to penetrate enemies and buildings. Equiped with a pair of shock guns for close-range self-defend. One of the core strengths of a frontal assault and airborne operations.

docs.title: Partiality-A
docs.text: Elite mobile assaulter unit. Launches barrage across most terrain.

docs.title: Partiality-B
docs.text: Elite mobile artillery unit. Launches explosive shells across most terrain. More lethal to buildings.

docs.title: Partiality-C
docs.text: Elite mobile missile unit. Launches proton missiles across most terrain. More lethal to aircrafts.

docs.title: Partiality-D
docs.text: Elite mobile auxiliary unit. Repair nearby friendly units. Powered by a internal nuclear reactor, can detonate itself in extreme situations. DO NOT let them get close to the defense line!!!

docs.title: Skyfire
docs.text: Launches 50 thermobaric rockets to long-range ground targets, have excellent effect on building demolition.

docs.title: Striker
docs.text: Launches rockets. Have sealed cabin to support to cross deep water.

docs.title: Titan
docs.text: Standardized heavy ground combat mechs with medium-range large-caliber shotguns and plasma cannons. Apply shielded and override to nearby units.

docs.title: Vanguard
docs.text: Fires machinegun bullets at nearby enemies.

docs.title: Alioth
docs.text: Fires pulsing fusion projectiles, causing severe damage to enemy power devices. Intercepts incoming enemy projectiles.

docs.title: Alnitak
docs.text: Fires small-caliber bullets and medium-range homing torpedoes at enemies.

docs.title: Antares
docs.text: Equipped with a universal vertical launcher unit to fire small proton rockets and ballistic missiles.

docs.title: Cerberilla
docs.text: A dreadnaught equiqed with light spear cannons and EMP bomb launchers. Deals extra damage to power networks. Protects and repairs nearby allied units.

docs.title: Dorudon
docs.text: Naval flagship. Equiped with discordance railgun and missile launchers. Can breakdown shields in seconds.

docs.title: Merak
docs.text: Launches dense anti-air missile barrages, equiped with prototype cannon.

docs.title: Polaris
docs.text: Launches small cruise missiles and shock beams at enemies, repair itself in the process. Equipped with a cruise system for a greater field of view.

docs.title: Regulus
docs.text: Fires large proton torpedoes. Carry 4 autonomous anti-aircraft missiles.

docs.title: Vast
docs.text: Standardized heavy surface combat ship with a composite vertical launch system and a short-range laser. Able to intercept nearby physical munitions. Saturatio-Attack against hard targets.

docs.title: Labirinto Abandonado
docs.text: Here lies a giant derelict structure, function still unclear. Various pitfalls can be found, with some reaching hot bedrock. Use the new sources of Slag to uncover and explore new technologies.

docs.title: Bay of Embers
docs.text:
The source of the nearby body of solvent can be found here, feeding it through this bay. Untouched by The Maze.

The Enemy has a strong presence due to the exposed aluminium and slag, which made them create new technologies that may be of interest.

Research Bloom and its related tech to remove the Enemy presence.

  • The Enemy may bring reinforcements coming from the bay as their cores are destroyed.

docs.title: Broken Corridors
docs.text:
A small grid of Slag Plugs cuts across the terrain. Even if most ofthe facility was destroyed, some sets of plugs remain and could be helpful to gather resources. Scraps of payload transport technology are present, researching it allows access to the plugs of the collapsed facility.

  • The initial area has a low concentration of both Verdigris and Iron.

docs.title: Cavern
docs.text:
This is a piece of a larger facility, cut off by collapsed blocks of concrete. The structure is slowly decaying due to the infiltration of water. Enemy activity has been found here, though it's limited and sensitive to some external phenomena.

  • Enemy units receive damage from light sources.
  • Reduced visibility due to the lack of light sources.

docs.title: Crevasse
docs.text: The geometry of this place allows for temporary cover of the scout helicopters. Research some basic infrastructure while the enemy doesn't know about your presence.

docs.title: Live Storm
docs.text:
A facility surrounded by a giant body of solvent. Function unknown.

This island is a point of interest of the enemy despite its relatively common resources, as evidenced by the existing remains. They developed a machine capable of patching up damages in nearby buildings, recovering that technology can be useful, because it seems to be what allowed the remains to barely withstand something that came out of the lightning rod matrix within this island's facility.

Extreme weather may be found within these lands. Be careful.

docs.title: The Delta
docs.text:
An enemy base sits deactivated next to the delta.

It will take some time for its unit factory to start up, giving you time to set up defenses.

Research the Mechanical Assembler and use it to create your own helicopters to take down this base.pt:
